description: 山野菜拌豆腐是一道简单的家常菜，以新鲜山野菜和嫩豆腐为主要食材。山野菜的清香与豆腐的软嫩完美结合，口感清爽，营养丰富。
description_en: Mixed Mountain Greens with Tofu is a simple homely dish made with fresh mountain greens and soft tofu. The fragrance of the mountain greens perfectly complements the softness of the tofu, resulting in a refreshing and nutritious dish.

name: 茄子炖土豆
description: 茄子炖土豆是一道以茄子和土豆为主要食材的家常菜，色泽鲜亮，口感软糯，营养丰富，做法简单。
description_en: Eggplant and Potato Stew is a home-cooked dish mainly made with eggplant and potatoes, featuring bright color, soft texture, rich nutrition, and simple preparation.

name: 酱烧蘑菇
description: 酱烧蘑菇是一道以蘑菇为主要食材，通过酱烧的方式烹饪而成的美味菜肴。蘑菇经过高温油炒后，加入特制的酱料，使其味道浓郁，口感滑嫩，是一道受欢迎的素食菜品。
description_en: Braised Mushrooms in Soy Sauce is a delicious vegetarian dish prepared by braising mushrooms in a special sauce. After sautéing in hot oil, mushrooms are cooked with the sauce to achieve a rich flavor and smooth texture, making it a popular dish.

name: 粉条焖茄子
description: 粉条焖茄子是一道家常菜，主要食材为茄子和粉条，通过焖制的方式使茄子软烂入味，粉条吸收了茄子的香味和肉汁，口感丰富。
description_en: Braised Eggplant with Glass Noodles is a home-style dish, mainly made with eggplants and glass noodles. The eggplants are cooked until tender and flavorful, while the noodles absorb the aroma and meaty essence from the eggplants, resulting in a rich texture.

name: 腌制酸黄瓜
description: 腌制酸黄瓜是一道以新鲜黄瓜为主料，通过腌制工艺制作的开胃小菜。它的口感爽脆，味道酸甜，可搭配多种食物食用。
description_en: Pickle Cucumber is an appetizer made from fresh cucumbers through pickling. It has a crunchy texture and a sweet and sour taste, which can be paired with various foods.

name: 木须肉
description: 木须肉是一道经典的北方菜，主要食材包括猪肉、鸡蛋和木耳，搭配黄瓜和黄花菜。这道菜以猪肉丝为主，辅以其它食材，炒制时加入调料，呈现出咸鲜的口感。
description_en: Moo Shu Pork is a classic Northern Chinese dish that primarily consists of pork, eggs, and wood ear mushrooms, accompanied by cucumber and daylily flowers. The dish is characterized by its main ingredient of pork shreds complemented by other ingredients, and seasoned when stir-fried to create a savory flavor.

name: 锅包虾仁
name_en: Pan-Fried Shrimp with Sweet and Sour Sauce
description: 锅包虾仁是一道以虾仁为主料的海鲜菜肴，通过油炸后再进行炒制，外层金黄酥脆，内里虾仁鲜嫩，搭配酸甜口的酱汁，味道层次丰富。
description_en: Pot-fried Shrimp is a seafood dish made with prawns as the main ingredient, which is first deep-fried and then stir-fried. The outer layer is golden and crispy, while the inside of the shrimp remains tender. It is served with a sweet and sour sauce, offering a rich variety of flavors.

name: 酱炒苋菜
description: 酱炒苋菜是一道以苋菜为主要食材，辅以豆瓣酱等调料，通过快速翻炒的方式烹饪而成的简单家常菜。口感鲜嫩，酱香浓郁，营养丰富。
description_en: Sautéed Amaranth with Sauce is a simple home-cooked dish that uses amaranth as the main ingredient and is cooked with soybean paste and other seasonings by quick stir-frying. It has a tender texture, rich sauce aroma, and is nutritionally rich.

name: 干炸黄花鱼
description: 干炸黄花鱼是一道以黄花鱼为主料的海鲜菜肴。将黄花鱼去鳞、去内脏后洗净，用调料腌制，然后裹上面糊或者干淀粉，放入热油中炸至金黄酥脆。这道菜外皮酥脆，内肉鲜嫩，是沿海地区常见的下酒菜。
description_en: Deep-Fried Yellow Croaker is a seafood dish made with yellow croaker as the main ingredient. After scaling and cleaning the fish, it is marinated with seasonings and then coated with batter or dry starch before being deep-fried until golden and crispy. This dish has a crispy exterior and tender interior, making it a common accompaniment for alcohol in coastal areas.

name: 酸菜炒粉
description: 酸菜炒粉是一道以酸菜和粉条为主要食材的中式菜肴，口感酸爽开胃，粉条滑嫩，适合作为下饭菜品。
description_en: Sour Cabbage Stir-Fried Glass Noodles is a Chinese dish made with sour cabbage and glass noodles as the main ingredients. It has a tangy and refreshing flavor, and the noodles are smooth and tender, making it a great accompaniment to rice.

name: 干豆腐炒肉丝
name_en: Fried Shredded Pork with Dried Tofu
description: 干豆腐炒肉丝是一道以干豆腐和猪肉为主要食材的家常菜。干豆腐质地柔韧，肉丝软嫩，两者搭配炒制，口感丰富，味道鲜美。
description_en: Fried Shredded Pork with Dried Tofu is a home-cooked dish made with dried tofu and pork as the main ingredients. The texture of dried tofu is flexible, while the shredded pork is tender, resulting in a rich texture and a delicious taste.

name: 猪肉炖榛蘑
description: 猪肉炖榛蘑是一道东北名菜，以猪肉和榛蘑为主要食材，辅以土豆、洋葱等蔬菜，慢火炖制，肉质鲜嫩，蘑菇鲜香，汤汁浓郁。
description_en: Pork Stew with Hazel Mushrooms is a famous dish from Northeast China, featuring pork and hazel mushrooms as the main ingredients, complemented by potatoes, onions, and other vegetables. It is slowly stewed to yield tender meat, fragrant mushrooms, and a rich broth.

name: 酱炒平菇
description: 酱炒平菇是一道以平菇为主要食材的家常菜，通过加入特制酱料快速翻炒而成，色香味俱全，是一道简单易做的下饭菜肴。
description_en: Sautéed Oyster Mushrooms in Sauce is a home-cooked dish made with oyster mushrooms as the main ingredient, quickly stir-fried with special sauce, rich in color, aroma, and taste, making it an easy-to-make dish that goes well with rice.

name: 土豆炖排骨
description: 土豆炖排骨是一道家常菜，主要食材是土豆和排骨。这道菜以土豆的软糯和排骨的鲜美相结合，加入酱油、料酒等调料，经过慢火炖煮而成，味道鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Potato Stew with Pork Ribs is a homely dish that combines the softness of potatoes with the deliciousness of pork ribs. Seasoned with soy sauce, cooking wine, and other condiments, it is slowly simmered to perfection, offering a delightful taste and rich nutrition.

name: 酸菜炖血肠
description: 酸菜炖血肠是一道东北地区的传统菜肴，以酸爽的酸菜搭配鲜香的血肠，汤汁浓郁，口感鲜美。
description_en: Sour Cabbage Stewed Blood Sausage is a traditional dish from the Northeast region, featuring tangy sour cabbage and fragrant blood sausage, with a rich soup and a delicious taste.

name: 宽粉拌辣椒油
name_en: Wide Rice Noodles with Chili Oil
description: 宽粉拌辣椒油是一道以宽粉条和辣椒油为主要食材的凉拌菜。这道菜肴将煮熟的宽粉条搭配自制辣椒油，辅以葱、姜、蒜等调料拌匀而成，口感爽滑，香味浓郁，带有微辣。
description_en: Wide Rice Noodles with Chili Oil is a cold dish mainly made of wide rice noodles and chili oil. Cooked wide rice noodles are mixed with homemade chili oil and seasoned with onions, ginger, garlic, etc., resulting in a smooth and fragrant taste with a mild spiciness.

name: 酱牛肉干
description: 酱牛肉干是一道以牛肉为主料，加入秘制酱料进行腌制和风干的肉类小吃。它口感韧劲十足，味道浓郁，适合作为零食或下酒菜享用。
description_en: Beef Jerky in Sauce is a savory snack made from beef marinated in a special sauce and dried. It has a chewy texture and rich flavor, making it suitable for enjoying as a snack or with a drink.

name: 溜肝尖
description: 溜肝尖是一道经典的中式菜肴，主要是用猪肝切片，经过快速的炒制和调味，使其口感鲜嫩、味道浓郁。猪肝含有丰富的铁质和维生素A，对身体有很好的滋补作用，适合多种烹饪方式。
description_en: Quick-Fried Liver Tips is a classic Chinese dish made by quickly stir-frying liver slices and seasoning them, resulting in tender texture and rich flavor. Liver is rich in iron and vitamin A, which is beneficial for health and can be prepared in various ways.

name: 干煸酸菜
description: 干煸酸菜是一道川菜中的家常菜，主要食材是酸菜，通过干煸的方式烹饪。它的味道酸辣可口，口感爽脆，是下饭的好菜。
description_en: Stir-fried Pickled Cabbage is a home-style dish in Sichuan cuisine, mainly made with pickled cabbage. It has a spicy and sour taste, and a crispy texture, making it a great accompaniment to rice.

name: 粉条炖羊肉
description: 粉条炖羊肉是一道以羊肉和粉条为主要食材的菜肴。这道菜以其独特的鲜香和软嫩的肉质而受到欢迎，通常在冬季食用，可以帮助温暖身体。
description_en: Braised Mutton with Glass Noodles is a dish mainly composed of mutton and glass noodles. Known for its unique fragrance and tender meat texture, it is popular, especially during the winter season, for its warming properties.

name: 酱焖鳊花
description: 酱焖鳊花是一道以鳊鱼为主要食材，通过酱料腌制后焖煮而成的美味菜肴。鱼肉细腻，味道鲜美，酱香浓郁，是典型的中式海鲜菜肴。
description_en: Braised Mandarin Fish in Sauce is a delicious dish made primarily with mandarin fish, marinated with sauce and then braised to perfection. The fish has a delicate texture and rich flavor, making it a typical Chinese seafood dish.

name: 铁锅炖大鹅
description: 铁锅炖大鹅是一道典型的东北菜肴，选用肉质鲜美的大鹅，经过慢火炖煮，肉质鲜嫩，汤汁浓郁。这道菜通常辅以土豆、粉条等配菜，增加了菜肴的口感和营养。
description_en: Braised Goose in Iron Pot is a typical Northeastern Chinese dish, using succulent goose meat that is slow-cooked until tender, resulting in a rich broth. The dish is often accompanied by ingredients such as potatoes and glass noodles, enhancing both the taste and nutritional value of the dish.

name: 凉拌刺嫩芽
description: 凉拌刺嫩芽是一道以刺嫩芽为主要食材的凉菜，通常辅以蒜末、辣椒油、醋、盐和糖等调料。这道菜口感鲜嫩，味道酸辣开胃，是夏季消暑的理想小菜。
description_en: Cold Dressed Young Fern Shoots is a cold dish mainly made with young fern shoots, usually seasoned with garlic, chili oil, vinegar, salt, and sugar. This dish has a tender texture and a tangy, spicy flavor, making it an ideal appetizer for summer cooling.

name: 酱豆角
description: 酱豆角是一道以豆角为主要食材的家常菜，通过与酱油、豆瓣酱等调料混合烹饪而成，口感鲜嫩，味道咸香。
description_en: Soybean Paste Green Beans is a home-style dish made primarily with green beans, cooked with soy sauce and bean paste to create a tender texture and savory flavor.

name: 酱黄瓜条
description: 酱黄瓜条是一道简单的凉拌小菜，主要由黄瓜条经过腌制而成，口感爽脆，味道酸甜适中，是很好的开胃菜。
description_en: Pickled Cucumber Strips is a simple and refreshing side dish made by marinating cucumber strips. It has a crisp texture and a moderately sweet and sour taste, making it an excellent appetizer.

name: 灰菜团子
description: 灰菜团子是一种以灰灰菜为主要原料的东北地区传统小吃，灰灰菜经过清洗、烫煮后切碎，与玉米面混合成团，再蒸熟即可食用。其口感软糯，味道清新。
description_en: Ashy Greens Dumplings is a traditional snack from Northeast China, made mainly from ashy greens. The greens are washed, boiled, and chopped before mixing with cornmeal to form dumplings. They are then steamed to achieve a soft and glutinous texture with a fresh and clean taste.

name: 笨鸡炖榛蘑
description: 笨鸡炖榛蘑是一道以土鸡肉和榛蘑为主要食材的传统菜肴。土鸡肉质鲜美，榛蘑味道独特，两者结合烹饪而成，汤汁浓郁，肉质鲜嫩，营养丰富。
description_en: Stewed Chicken with Hazel Fungus is a traditional dish made with free-range chicken and hazel mushrooms as the main ingredients. The chicken has a delicious texture, and the hazel mushrooms have a unique flavor. The combination of these two ingredients, stewed together, results in a rich and nutritious soup with tender meat.

name: 酱焖猪尾
description: 酱焖猪尾是一道以猪尾巴为主要食材的菜肴，通过酱料长时间的焖煮使得猪尾肉质酥软，味道浓郁，富含胶原蛋白。
description_en: Braised Pig Tail in Sauce is a dish primarily made with pig tails, cooked with sauce for a long time to make the meat tender and the taste rich and full of collagen.

name: 冷面
description: 冷面是一道以面条为主料，辅以各种蔬菜和肉类，用冷汤或冷汁调味而成的韩国传统面食。面条通常经过冷藏后食用，口感爽滑，汤汁清新，是夏日里的消暑佳品。
description_en: Cold Noodles are a traditional Korean noodle dish made with noodles as the main ingredient, supplemented by various vegetables and meats, seasoned with cold soup or cold sauce. The noodles are typically served chilled, offering a smooth texture and refreshing broth, making it a popular dish for cooling down in the summer.

name: 酸汤子
description: 酸汤子是一种东北地区传统的特色小吃，以玉米面和发酵米汤为原料，经过发酵后制成的酸味面条。它的口感略带酸味，质地柔韧，常配以蔬菜、肉末等配料，再淋上特制的酸辣汤汁，味道鲜明、层次丰富。
description_en: Sour Soup Rice Noodles is a traditional specialty from Northeast China, made from cornmeal and fermented rice soup. After fermentation, it has a slightly sour taste and a chewy texture, often served with vegetables and minced meat, topped with a specially made spicy and sour sauce, offering a distinct and rich flavor.

name: 熏肉大饼
description: 熏肉大饼是一种流行于中国北方的传统小吃，以熏肉和面饼为主要食材制作而成。熏肉肉质鲜嫩，面饼外酥内软，搭配食用风味独特。
description_en: Smoked Meat Pie is a popular traditional snack in northern China, made from smoked meat and pancake as the main ingredients. The smoked meat is tender, and the pancake is crispy outside and soft inside, offering a unique flavor when eaten together.

name: 杂拌汤
description: 杂拌汤是一道以各种蔬菜、肉类和豆腐等为主要食材制作而成的汤品。其特点是食材多样、营养丰富、口味鲜美。通常包含西红柿、土豆、胡萝卜等蔬菜，以及猪肉、鸡肉或海鲜等肉类，有时会加入豆腐增加口感。
description_en: Mixed Vegetable Soup is a type of soup made with a variety of vegetables, meat, and tofu. It is characterized by its rich ingredients, nutritious value, and delicious taste. Commonly includes tomatoes, potatoes, carrots, and other vegetables, as well as meat like pork, chicken or seafood, and sometimes tofu for added texture.

name: 茶汤
description: 茶汤是一种以茶叶冲泡而成的汤品，通常在餐后饮用，有助于消化。它可以简单，如清茶，也可以加入其他食材，如枸杞、红枣等，增加风味和营养价值。
description_en: Tea Soup is a type of soup made by brewing tea leaves, typically consumed after meals to aid digestion. It can be as simple as a clear tea or enriched with ingredients such as goji berries and red dates to enhance flavor and nutritional value.

name: 三鲜豆腐脑
name_en: Savory Tofu Pudding with Three Delicacies
description: 三鲜豆腐脑是一道以嫩豆腐为主料，辅以虾仁、海参和香菇等三鲜食材，制成的一道色泽鲜美，口感嫩滑的汤品。
description_en: Savory Tofu Pudding with Three Delicacies is a soup dish made with tender tofu as the main ingredient, complemented by shrimp, sea cucumber, and mushrooms, known for its fresh color and smooth texture.

name: 粘豆包
description: 粘豆包是一种传统的东北小吃，主要原料包括糯米粉和红豆馅，外皮软糯，内馅香甜，是春节期间的传统食品之一。
description_en: Glutinous Rice Bean Bun is a traditional snack from Northeast China, mainly made from glutinous rice flour and red bean filling, with a soft and sticky outer skin and a sweet filling, making it one of the traditional foods during the Spring Festival.

name: 猪肉酸菜馅包子
description: 猪肉酸菜馅包子是一道以猪肉和酸菜为主要馅料的传统中式点心，外皮松软，内馅鲜香，味道酸爽可口。
description_en: Pork and Sauerkraut Stuffed Buns are a traditional Chinese dim sum dish featuring pork and sauerkraut as the main fillings, with a soft exterior and a fresh, tangy filling that is very palatable.

name: 酸菜炒饼
description: 酸菜炒饼是一道以酸菜和烙饼为主要食材的中国北方传统菜肴。酸菜的酸爽与烙饼的香脆相结合，口感丰富，是一道开胃的家常菜。
description_en: Sour Cabbage Stir-Fried Pancake is a traditional Northern Chinese dish made with pickled cabbage and fried pancakes. The tangy flavor of the pickled cabbage pairs well with the crispy texture of the pancakes, offering a delightful and appetizing home-cooked meal.

name: 酱坛子菜
description: 酱坛子菜是一道以各种蔬菜为主料，用特制酱料腌制而成的传统小吃。它色泽鲜艳、口感爽脆，是开胃下饭的好搭档。常见的蔬菜有白菜、萝卜、黄瓜等，可以单独食用，也可以作为配菜增色添香。
description_en: Pickled Vegetables in Sauce is a traditional snack made by pickling various vegetables in a special sauce. It features a bright color and a crisp texture, making it a great companion for appetite and meals. Common vegetables used include cabbage, radish, and cucumber, which can be eaten alone or as a side dish to enhance the flavors of the main course.

name: 大头菜丝拌粉丝
description: 大头菜丝拌粉丝是一道简单快捷的凉拌菜，以大头菜（卷心菜）丝和粉丝为主要食材，辅以特制的调料，口感爽脆，是夏日消暑的理想选择。
description_en: Shredded cabbage with glass noodles is a quick and easy cold dish, featuring shredded cabbage and glass noodles as the main ingredients, complemented by special seasonings, with a crisp texture, making it the ideal choice for cooling down in the summer.

name: 杂粮煎饼
description: 杂粮煎饼是一种以杂粮面粉为主要原料，加入鸡蛋、葱花等辅料制成的煎饼。它口感香脆，营养丰富，是北方地区常见的早餐食品。
description_en: Multigrain Pancake is a type of pancake made from multigrain flour, mixed with eggs and green onions. It has a crispy texture and is rich in nutrition, making it a popular breakfast food in northern regions.

name: 铁锅炖鱼
description: 铁锅炖鱼是一道以新鲜鱼肉为主要食材的地道中式菜肴。它通常将鱼肉与多种调料一同放入铁锅中，用中小火慢炖至鱼肉熟透、汤汁浓郁。这道菜肉质鲜嫩，汤汁浓郁，非常适合搭配米饭食用。
description_en: Iron Pot Braised Fish is a traditional Chinese dish mainly made with fresh fish. It usually stews fish with a variety of seasonings in an iron pot over medium-low heat until the fish is cooked and the soup is rich. This dish has tender meat and rich soup, making it perfect for eating with rice.

name: 土豆泥拌酸菜
description: 土豆泥拌酸菜是一道以土豆和酸菜为主要食材的东北家常菜肴。土豆煮熟后压成泥，与酸菜和猪肉末一起炒制，味道鲜美，口感丰富。
description_en: Mashed Potatoes with Pickled Cabbage is a Northeastern Chinese home-style dish that combines mashed potatoes with pickled cabbage and minced pork. The dish is flavorful and has a rich texture.

name: 芸豆煎饼
description: 芸豆煎饼是一道以芸豆为主要原料，经过浸泡、磨制、调浆等工艺后，煎制而成的小吃。口感软嫩，豆香浓郁，是北方地区常见的传统小吃。
description_en: Fried Bean Pancake is a traditional snack mainly made from kidney beans. After soaking, grinding, and batter mixing, it is fried until soft and fragrant with a rich bean flavor, commonly found in northern areas.

name: 榛蘑炖白菜
description: 榛蘑炖白菜是一道以榛蘑和白菜为主要食材的东北传统菜肴。先将榛蘑泡发，白菜洗净切片，然后一同炖煮，加入调料，味道鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: A traditional Northeastern Chinese dish primarily made with hazel mushrooms and Chinese cabbage. The dish involves soaking the mushrooms, washing and slicing the cabbage, and stewing them together with seasonings for a flavorful and nutritious meal.

name: 酱渍雪里红
description: 酱渍雪里红是一道以雪里红（学名Brassica juncea，即叶用芥菜）为主料，加入酱油、糖、盐等调料腌制而成的冷盘小菜。它口感爽脆，味道咸鲜，带有独特的酱香，是下饭佐酒的理想选择。
description_en: Pickled Sheh Ping is a cold dish made from leaf mustard greens (Brassica juncea), marinated with soy sauce, sugar, salt, and other seasonings. It has a crisp texture and a savory flavor with a unique soy sauce aroma, making it an ideal accompaniment for rice and wine.

name: 大拉皮拌鸡丝
name_en: Cold Jelly Noodles with Shredded Chicken
description: 大拉皮拌鸡丝是一道东北美食，主要食材包括鸡胸肉和大拉皮。大拉皮是一种由红薯粉制成的透明宽粉条，口感滑爽，而鸡胸肉煮熟后撕成细丝，两者搭配，辅以葱、姜、蒜、辣椒等多种调味料，制成一道酸辣爽口的凉菜。
description_en: Cold Jelly Noodles with Shredded Chicken is a popular dish from Northeast China. The main ingredients include chicken breast and transparent wide noodles made from sweet potato starch, known as 'da la pi'. The dish is a refreshing cold dish, with chicken breast cooked and shredded into thin strips, and served with a variety of seasonings such as onion, ginger, garlic, and chili to create a tangy and spicy flavor.

name: 酱焖排骨
description: 酱焖排骨是一道经典的中华菜肴，选用新鲜猪肋排为主料，以酱油、料酒、糖等调料进行腌制后，再配以八角、桂皮等香料，通过慢火焖煮而成。这道菜色泽红亮，肉质酥烂入味，酱香浓郁，是下饭的好选择。
description_en: Braised Pork Ribs in Sauce is a classic Chinese dish made from fresh pork ribs marinated in soy sauce, cooking wine, sugar, and other seasonings, then slow-cooked with spices such as star anise and cinnamon. This dish has a bright red color, tender meat that is flavorful and rich in sauce, making it a great choice for serving with rice.

name: 酱烧木耳
description: 酱烧木耳是一道以木耳为主要食材，辅以酱油和其他调料烧制而成的素食菜肴。木耳经过泡发后，加入酱油、糖、料酒等调料烧制，味道鲜美，口感滑嫩，营养丰富。
description_en: Soy Sauce Braised Wood Ears is a vegetarian dish made primarily of wood ears, braised with soy sauce and other seasonings. After soaking, the wood ears are braised with soy sauce, sugar, and cooking wine, resulting in a delicious taste, smooth texture, and rich nutrition.

name: 大闸蟹
description: 大闸蟹是中国特有的淡水蟹类，以其肉质鲜美、膏黄肥美而闻名，尤以阳澄湖产的最为有名。食用时通常清蒸，以保留蟹肉的原汁原味，是秋季的时令美食。
description_en: The Chinese Mitten Crab is a unique freshwater crab species in China, known for its delicious meat and rich, fatty roe. Particularly famous are those from Yangcheng Lake. It is usually steamed to preserve the original flavor and is a seasonal delicacy in the fall.

name: 清蒸多宝鱼
description: 清蒸多宝鱼是一道粤菜，以新鲜的多宝鱼为主要食材，用清蒸的方式烹饪，保留了鱼的鲜美口感和营养成分。特点是肉质细嫩，味道鲜美。
description_en: Steamed Turbot is a Cantonese dish that uses fresh turbot as the main ingredient, cooked by steaming to preserve the fish's delicate texture and nutrients. It is characterized by its tender meat and delicious taste.

name: 红烧鲤鱼
description: 红烧鲤鱼是一道色香味俱佳的传统中式菜肴。这道菜以鲤鱼为主要食材，经过炸制金黄后再用酱油、糖等调料烧煮入味，肉质鲜嫩，味道鲜美。
description_en: Braised Carp in Brown Sauce is a traditional Chinese dish known for its vibrant colors and flavors. The carp is first fried until golden, then braised with soy sauce and sugar to absorb the flavors, resulting in tender meat and a delicious taste.

name: 油爆河虾
description: 油爆河虾是一道经典的沪菜，以新鲜河虾为主料，通过高温油炸的方式使虾壳爆裂，肉质鲜嫩。成菜色泽红亮，口感鲜美，外酥里嫩，是下饭下酒的佳肴。
description_en: Deep-Fried River Shrimp is a classic Shanghai dish made from fresh river shrimps. The high-temperature frying makes the shrimp shells burst, while the meat remains tender and juicy. The dish is characterized by its bright red color and delicious taste, with a crispy exterior and tender interior, making it an excellent accompaniment to rice or alcohol.

name: 清蒸大黄鱼
description: 清蒸大黄鱼是一道以大黄鱼为主要食材，通过清蒸的方式烹饪而成的海鲜菜肴。它保留了鱼的原汁原味，肉质细嫩，口感鲜美。
description_en: Steamed Yellow Croaker is a seafood dish that uses Yellow Croaker as the main ingredient, cooked by steaming to preserve the fish's original flavor and tender texture, resulting in a delicious taste.

name: 酱爆扇贝
description: 酱爆扇贝是一道以扇贝为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，通过快速翻炒的方式使扇贝快速成熟，同时保持肉质的鲜嫩多汁，搭配特制的酱料，风味独特，口感丰富。
description_en: Sautéed Scallops with Sauce is a seafood dish primarily made with scallops. The scallops are quickly stir-fried to retain their tender and juicy texture, complemented by a special sauce, resulting in a unique flavor and rich taste.

name: 葱姜花蟹
name_en: Flower Crab with Ginger and Scallion
description: 葱姜花蟹是一道以花蟹为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，通过葱姜的搭配来突出蟹肉的鲜美和口感。蟹肉含有丰富的蛋白质，葱姜则具有去腥增香的作用。
description_en: Flower Crab with Ginger and Scallion is a seafood dish featuring flower crab as the main ingredient, enhanced by the pairing of ginger and scallion to highlight the delicacy and texture of the crab meat. Crab meat is rich in protein, while ginger and scallion serve to remove the fishy taste and add a pleasant aroma.

name: 豉汁青口贝
name_en: Steamed Mussels with Black Bean Sauce
description: 豉汁青口贝是一道以青口贝为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。青口贝肉质鲜美，富含蛋白质和微量元素，搭配豆豉和特制的豉汁调料，风味独特，肉质细嫩，营养丰富。
description_en: Steamed Mussels with Black Bean Sauce is a seafood dish featuring mussels as the main ingredient. Mussels have a delicious texture and are rich in protein and trace elements. Combined with fermented black beans and special sauce, the dish offers a unique flavor, tender texture, and nutritious value.

name: 麻辣小龙虾
description: 麻辣小龙虾是一道以小龙虾为主要食材的川菜，通过将小龙虾与辣椒、花椒等调味料一同烹饪，使其味道麻辣鲜香。
description_en: Spicy Crayfish is a Sichuan dish primarily made with crayfish, cooked with chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns to achieve a spicy and aromatic flavor.

name: 清蒸对虾
description: 清蒸对虾是一道以对虾为主料，辅以葱姜等调料，通过清蒸的方式烹饪而成的海鲜菜肴。其特点是肉质鲜嫩，味道鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Steamed Prawn is a seafood dish made of prawns with the addition of green onions, ginger, and other seasonings, cooked through steaming. It is known for its tender texture, delicious flavor, and rich nutritional value.

name: 黄豆炖鲫鱼
description: 黄豆炖鲫鱼是一道以鲫鱼和黄豆为主要食材的家常菜。将黄豆提前泡发，鲫鱼处理干净后，用油煎至两面金黄，再加入泡发好的黄豆及调料，没过食材的水，文火慢炖至汤汁浓郁，鱼肉鲜嫩，豆香浓郁。
description_en: Braised Crucian Carp with Soybeans is a traditional home-cooked dish that uses crucian carp and soybeans as the main ingredients. After soaking the soybeans, the cleaned crucian carp is pan-fried until golden on both sides, then the soaked soybeans and seasonings are added along with water to cover the ingredients, and simmered over low heat until the sauce is rich and thick. The result is tender fish and aromatic beans.

name: 糖醋鲤鱼
description: 糖醋鲤鱼是一道山东省的传统名菜，以黄河鲤鱼为主要食材，经过油炸后外皮酥脆，再淋上特制的糖醋汁，色泽金黄，酸甜适中，口感外酥里嫩，是宴席上的常见佳肴。
description_en: Sweet and Sour Carp is a traditional dish from Shandong Province, featuring the Yellow River carp as the main ingredient. The carp is deep-fried until the skin is crispy, then coated with a special sweet and sour sauce. It has a golden color, balanced sweet and sour taste, and a crispy skin with tender flesh, making it a popular dish at banquets.

name: 咸鱼茄子煲
description: 咸鱼茄子煲是一道色香味俱全的传统粤菜，以咸鱼和茄子为主要食材，通过砂锅煲制的方式烹饪。咸鱼的咸鲜味与茄子的软糯口感相结合，味道鲜美，是一道下饭的好菜。
description_en: Salted Fish and Eggplant Casserole is a traditional Cantonese dish characterized by its rich color, aroma, and taste. It is primarily made with salted fish and eggplant, cooked in a casserole pot. The dish combines the savory and salty flavor of the salted fish with the soft and glutinous texture of the eggplant, creating a delicious meal that goes well with rice.

name: 姜葱虾蟹煲
name_en: Ginger and Scallion Crab and Shrimp Pot
description: 姜葱虾蟹煲是一道以鲜活的海虾和螃蟹为主料，搭配姜葱等调料烹制而成的海鲜菜。这道菜以海鲜的鲜美和姜葱的香气为特色，味道浓郁，口感鲜美。
description_en: Ginger and Scallion Crab and Shrimp Pot is a seafood dish featuring fresh shrimp and crab as the main ingredients, cooked with ginger and scallions among other seasonings. This dish is characterized by the delicacy of the seafood and the aroma of ginger and scallions, with a rich flavor and a delicious taste.

name: 沙姜濑尿虾
description: 沙姜濑尿虾是一道以沙姜和濑尿虾为主要食材的特色海鲜菜肴，沙姜的独特香味与海鲜的鲜美完美融合，口感鲜香，肉质紧实，是一道色香味俱佳的海鲜佳肴。
description_en: Sand Ginger Shrimp is a unique seafood dish featuring the main ingredients of sand ginger and peeling shrimp, where the distinctive aroma of sand ginger perfectly blends with the freshness of the seafood, offering a fragrant and firm texture, making it a visually and tastefully appealing seafood delicacy.

name: 辣炒花蛤
description: 辣炒花蛤是一道以花蛤为主要食材的海鲜菜品，辅以辣椒、大葱、大蒜等调料，通过快速翻炒烹饪而成，口味鲜辣，肉质细嫩，适合喜欢辣味的食客。
description_en: Spicy Stir-Fried Clams is a seafood dish that uses clams as the main ingredient, complemented by chili peppers, green onions, garlic, and other seasonings. It is quickly stir-fried to create a dish with a fresh and spicy flavor, tender texture, and is well-suited for people who enjoy spicy flavors.

name: 皮蛋鳕鱼羹
name_en: Century Egg and Cod Fish Porridge
description: 皮蛋鳕鱼羹是一道以鳕鱼、皮蛋为主要食材的羹类菜肴，口味独特，营养丰富。鳕鱼肉质鲜嫩，皮蛋带有特殊的香味，两者结合，口感丰富，是一道非常受欢迎的海鲜羹。
description_en: Century Egg and Cod Fish Porridge is a porridge dish primarily made from cod and century egg, with a unique taste and rich nutrition. The cod fish has tender meat, and the century egg has a special aroma. The combination of the two creates a rich taste and texture, making it a popular seafood porridge.

name: 清汤鱼丸
description: 清汤鱼丸是一道以鱼肉为主要原料制作的汤品，鱼丸滑嫩，汤汁鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Fish Ball Soup is a soup dish primarily made from fish meat. The fish balls are tender and the soup is delicious, rich in nutrients.

name: 油淋鱿鱼
description: 油淋鱿鱼是一道海鲜菜肴，以鱿鱼为主料，经过油炸后淋上香辣的辣椒油，口感外酥里嫩，香辣可口。
description_en: Deep-Fried Squid with Chili Oil is a seafood dish featuring squid as the main ingredient. After being deep-fried, it is drizzled with spicy chili oil, resulting in a crispy exterior and tender interior, with a delicious spicy flavor.

name: 干煸鱿鱼须
description: 干煸鱿鱼须是一道以鱿鱼须为主要食材的海鲜菜品。主要通过干煸的方式烹饪，使鱿鱼须外焦里嫩，口感香脆。
description_en: Stir-fried Dried Squid is a seafood dish featuring squid tentacles as the main ingredient. It is cooked by dry-frying, resulting in a crispy and tender texture.

name: 葱油海参
name_en: Braised Sea Cucumber with Scallion Oil
description: 葱油海参是一道以海参为主料，辅以葱油和调味料制成的海鲜菜肴。其特点是海参软糯，葱香浓郁，营养丰富。
description_en: Braised Sea Cucumber with Scallion Oil is a seafood dish that uses sea cucumber as the main ingredient, enriched with scallion oil and seasonings. It is characterized by its tender sea cucumber and rich scallion fragrance, as well as its nutritional value.

name: 蚝油鲜鲍片
description: 蚝油鲜鲍片是一道以新鲜鲍鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。通过将鲍鱼切成薄片，搭配蚝油、酱油和葱花等调料进行烹饪，使得鲍鱼片味道鲜美，口感爽滑，是一道色香味俱佳的高档粤菜。
description_en: Oyster Sauce Fresh Abalone Slices is a seafood dish that primarily uses fresh abalone as its main ingredient. By slicing the abalone into thin pieces and cooking it with oyster sauce, soy sauce, and scallions, the dish achieves a delightful taste and a smooth texture, making it a visually and tastefully appealing high-end Cantonese dish.

name: 香煎鳕鱼块
description: 香煎鳕鱼块是一道以鳕鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。鳕鱼肉质细嫩，富含蛋白质和微量元素。此菜通过香煎的方式，使鳕鱼块外焦里嫩，口感鲜美，是餐桌上的一道健康美食。
description_en: Pan-Fried Cod Steaks is a seafood dish that uses cod as the main ingredient. Cod has a delicate texture and is rich in protein and trace elements. By pan-frying, the cod steaks achieve a crispy exterior and tender interior, offering a delicious taste and making it a healthy choice for the dining table.

name: 蒜蓉粉丝蒸扇贝
name_en: Steamed Scallops with Garlic and Vermicelli
description: 蒜蓉粉丝蒸扇贝是一道经典的海鲜菜肴。将新鲜的扇贝搭配粉丝和大量的蒜末进行蒸制，蒜香浓郁，口感鲜美。
description_en: Steamed Scallops with Garlic and Vermicelli is a classic seafood dish. Fresh scallops are paired with vermicelli and a generous amount of minced garlic for steaming, resulting in a dish that is rich in garlic flavor and wonderfully delicious.

name: 糖醋虾球
description: 糖醋虾球是一道以虾为主要食材的海鲜料理。这道菜通过将虾球裹粉后油炸至外酥里嫩，再配以酸甜的糖醋汁，口味酸甜适中，色香味俱佳，是一道广受欢迎的家常菜肴。
description_en: Sweet and Sour Shrimp Balls is a seafood dish that primarily uses shrimp as its main ingredient. The shrimp balls are coated in flour and then deep-fried until they are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, followed by a sweet and sour sauce. This dish has a balanced taste and is well-loved for its color, aroma, and taste, making it a popular home-cooked dish.

name: 香辣八爪鱼
description: 香辣八爪鱼是一道以八爪鱼为主料，辅以辣椒、花椒等调料制成的海鲜菜肴。八爪鱼经过焯水、腌制后，与辣椒等调料一同炒制，使八爪鱼肉质鲜嫩，香辣味浓。
description_en: Spicy Octopus is a seafood dish made with octopus as the main ingredient, complemented by chili peppers and Sichuan peppercorns. After blanching and marinating, the octopus is stir-fried with the seasonings, resulting in tender texture and a rich spicy flavor.

name: 葱烧海参花
description: 葱烧海参花是一道以海参和大葱为主料的海鲜菜肴。将海参花泡发后与葱段一起炖煮，加入高汤、料酒、生抽等调料，煮至海参花软糯入味，葱段香气四溢。成菜色泽红亮，葱香浓郁，海参花口感滑嫩，营养丰富。
description_en: Braised Sea Cucumber with Scallions is a seafood dish mainly made of sea cucumber and green onions. After soaking the sea cucumber, braise it with green onion sections in a pot along with high stock, cooking wine, soy sauce, and other seasonings until the sea cucumber becomes tender and flavorful. The dish has a bright red color, full of rich onion aroma, and the sea cucumber has a smooth texture with rich nutritional value.

name: 干烧对虾
description: 干烧对虾是一道以对虾为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，特点是虾肉鲜美，味道浓郁，色泽红亮。烹饪过程中，对虾经过油煎至外壳酥脆，然后加入调料和辣椒，通过干烧的方式使虾肉入味，最后撒上葱花增香。
description_en: Dry-fried Prawns is a seafood dish with prawns as the main ingredient. It is characterized by its fresh prawn meat, rich flavor, and bright red color. In the cooking process, the prawns are fried until the shell is crispy, then seasoned with spices and chili, and cooked by dry frying to infuse the prawn meat with flavor, finally sprinkled with scallions to enhance the aroma.

name: 姜葱炒花甲
name_en: Stir-fried Clams with Ginger and Scallion
description: 姜葱炒花甲是一道以花甲（蛤蜊）为主要食材，辅以姜葱等调料的海鲜类小炒菜。其特点是肉质鲜嫩，味道鲜美，姜葱的香味能去除海鲜的腥味，是一道受欢迎的家常菜。
description_en: Stir-fried Clams with Ginger and Scallion is a seafood dish primarily made with clams and flavored with ginger and scallions. It is characterized by its tender meat and delicious taste. The aroma of ginger and scallions helps to remove the fishy taste of seafood, making it a popular home-cooked meal.

name: 辣子墨鱼仔
description: 辣子墨鱼仔是一道以墨鱼仔为主食材的海鲜菜肴，特点是麻辣鲜香，色泽红亮，口感鲜嫩，适合喜欢辣味的食客。
description_en: Spicy Squidlets is a seafood dish that features squidlets as the main ingredient, characterized by its spicy and fragrant flavor, bright red color, and tender texture, making it a favorite among those who enjoy spicy flavors.

name: 豆鼓蒸鲈鱼片
name_en: Steamed Grouper Slices with Fermented Black Beans
description: 豆鼓蒸鲈鱼片是一道以新鲜鲈鱼片为主料，辅以豆豉、姜丝、葱花等调料通过蒸煮方式烹饪而成的海鲜菜肴。这道菜品肉质细嫩、味道鲜美、豆豉香味浓郁。
description_en: Steamed grouper slices with fermented black beans is a seafood dish made from fresh grouper slices, complemented with fermented black beans, shredded ginger, chives and other seasonings, cooked through steaming. The dish features tender meat, delicious flavor, and rich aroma of fermented black beans.

name: 泡椒田螺
description: 泡椒田螺是一道以田螺为主要食材的川菜，通过将田螺与泡椒、姜蒜等调料一同烹饪，使其具有独特的酸辣味。
description_en: Pickled Peppers with Snails is a Sichuan dish that uses snails as the main ingredient, cooked with pickled chili peppers, ginger, and garlic to give it a unique sour and spicy flavor.

name: 鲜虾滑蛋
description: 鲜虾滑蛋是一道以鲜虾和鸡蛋为主要食材的家常菜。这道菜通过将鲜虾与鸡蛋混合后快速炒制，保留了虾的鲜美和蛋的滑嫩，口感丰富，色泽诱人。
description_en: Shrimp and Soft Egg is a home-style dish made primarily from fresh shrimp and eggs. The dish is prepared by quickly stir-frying the shrimp with eggs, preserving the shrimp's freshness and the egg's tenderness, resulting in a rich texture and an appealing color.

name: 黄鱼豆腐汤
description: 黄鱼豆腐汤是一道以黄鱼和豆腐为主要食材的汤品。黄鱼肉质细嫩，豆腐软滑，搭配在一起炖煮，汤汁鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Yellow Croaker and Tofu Soup is a soup dish primarily made with yellow croaker and tofu. The yellow croaker has delicate flesh, and tofu is soft and smooth. Together, they are stewed to create a delicious and nutritious broth.

name: 糟溜鱼片
description: 糟溜鱼片是一道以新鲜鱼片为主要食材的汉族传统名菜。这道菜的特点是利用酒糟的香气入味，通过炒制的方式使鱼片吸收糟香，口感鲜嫩，糟香浓郁。
description_en: Fish Fillets in Wine Sauce is a traditional Chinese dish using fresh fish fillets as the main ingredient. The dish is characterized by the aroma of fermented rice wine, which is absorbed by the fish fillets through stir-frying, resulting in a tender texture and a rich, fragrant flavor.

name: 葱姜白蟹煲
name_en: Ginger and Scallion White Crab Casserole
description: 葱姜白蟹煲是一道以新鲜白蟹为主料，搭配葱、姜等调料烹饪而成的海鲜美食。这道菜突出了白蟹的鲜美，同时葱姜去腥提鲜，肉质鲜嫩，味道醇厚。
description_en: Ginger and Scallion White Crab Casserole is a seafood delicacy made with fresh white crab as the main ingredient, paired with green onions and ginger for seasoning. This dish highlights the freshness of the white crab while using the green onions and ginger to remove any fishy odors and enhance the flavor. The crab meat is tender and the taste is rich and mellow.

name: 姜葱炒青蟹
name_en: Stir-Fried Green Crab with Ginger and Scallions
description: 姜葱炒青蟹是一道以鲜活青蟹为主要食材的海鲜菜式，辅以姜、葱等调味料炒制而成。这道菜色泽金黄，蟹肉鲜嫩，葱姜的香味浓郁，口感层次丰富，是一道色香味俱佳的经典海鲜菜肴。
description_en: Stir-Fried Green Crab with Ginger and Scallions is a seafood dish primarily made with live green crabs and seasoned with ginger, scallions, and other condiments. The dish has a golden yellow color, with tender crab meat and a rich aroma of ginger and scallions, offering a delightful combination of flavors and textures.

name: 红烧海鳗
description: 红烧海鳗是一道以海鳗鱼为主要食材的经典海鲜菜肴。海鳗经过红烧烹饪方式，肉质鲜嫩，味道鲜美，汤汁浓郁，是海边地区非常受欢迎的一道菜。
description_en: Braised Sea Eel is a classic seafood dish that uses sea eel as the main ingredient. The eel, cooked with a braising method, is tender and delicious, with a rich sauce, making it a popular dish in coastal areas.

name: 清蒸桂花鱼
description: 清蒸桂花鱼是一道以桂花鱼为主料，辅以葱丝、姜丝等配料，以清蒸方式烹饪而成的中式菜肴。鱼肉细嫩，口感鲜美，营养丰富，具有高蛋白、低脂肪的特点。
description_en: Steamed Mandarin Fish is a Chinese dish made with mandarin fish as the main ingredient, supplemented with green onion and ginger as ingredients. It is cooked by steaming. The fish meat is tender and delicious, rich in nutrients, and characterized by high protein and low fat.

name: 剁椒蒸武昌鱼
name_en: Steamed Wuchang Fish with Chopped Chili
description: 剁椒蒸武昌鱼是一道以武昌鱼为主料，辅以剁椒、姜、葱等调料，通过蒸制而成的湖北特色菜肴。其特点是肉质鲜嫩，辣中带鲜，风味独特。
description_en: Steamed Wuchang Fish with Chopped Chili is a traditional Hubei dish made from Wuchang fish and seasoned with chopped chili, ginger, and scallions, cooked by steaming. It features tender fish meat with a spicy and fresh flavor, making it a unique culinary delight.

name: 黄瓜拌海蜇
description: 黄瓜拌海蜇是一道清爽的凉菜，主要由新鲜的黄瓜和海蜇丝组成。黄瓜的清脆口感与海蜇的爽滑相得益彰，通常配以特制的酱汁，如蒜末、香醋等，使口感更加鲜美。
description_en: Cucumber and Jellyfish Salad is a refreshing cold dish, primarily composed of fresh cucumber and jellyfish shreds. The crisp texture of cucumber complements the slippery jellyfish, usually dressed with a special sauce, such as minced garlic and aromatic vinegar, enhancing the flavor.

name: 酱爆鱿鱼卷
description: 酱爆鱿鱼卷是一道以鱿鱼为主要食材，辅以多种调料制成的海鲜菜肴。鱿鱼经过改刀成卷状，快速翻炒，加入特制的酱料，使得鱿鱼肉质鲜嫩，口感微辣，酱香浓郁。
description_en: Sauteed Squid Rolls in Sauce is a seafood dish primarily made with squid as the main ingredient, complemented by various seasonings. The squid is cut into rolls, quickly stir-fried, and then mixed with a special sauce, resulting in tender squid meat with a slightly spicy taste and rich sauce aroma.

name: 黄泥螺炖蛋
description: 黄泥螺炖蛋是一道以黄泥螺和鸡蛋为主要食材的传统菜肴，通过将鸡蛋与泥螺结合，在蒸制过程中，泥螺的鲜美与鸡蛋的滑嫩完美融合，形成独特的海鲜风味。
description_en: Baked Clams with Egg is a traditional dish featuring yellow clams and eggs as the main ingredients. By combining the clams and eggs, the dish creates a unique seafood flavor through the steaming process, where the delicacy of the clams perfectly blends with the smoothness of the eggs.

name: 姜葱炒河虾
name_en: Stir-fried River Shrimp with Ginger and Scallions
description: 姜葱炒河虾是一道以河虾为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，通过姜葱的香辣与河虾的鲜美相结合，炒制而成，口感鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Stir-fried River Shrimp with Ginger and Scallions is a seafood dish primarily made with river shrimp, combining the spiciness of ginger and scallions with the delicacy of the shrimp, stir-fried to perfection, resulting in a delicious and nutritious meal.

name: 干煸海虾皮
description: 干煸海虾皮是一道以海虾皮为主料，通常佐以蒜泥、辣椒等调料，通过干煸的烹饪方式制作而成，口感酥脆，香辣可口。
description_en: Stir-fried Dried Shrimp Skin is a dish made with dried shrimp skin as the main ingredient, usually seasoned with minced garlic and chili peppers, cooked by the stir-frying method until crispy. It has a crispy texture and spicy flavor.

name: 三鲜鱼肚羹
description: 三鲜鱼肚羹是一道广东及香港地区的经典汤品，以鱼肚、鸡肉、香菇和虾仁等为主要原料，通过炖煮的方式制作而成。这道菜色泽金黄，口感鲜美，营养丰富，尤其适合在秋冬季节食用，具有很好的滋补效果。
description_en: Three Delicacies Fish Maw Soup is a classic soup dish from Guangdong and Hong Kong, mainly made with fish maw, chicken, mushrooms, and shrimp. It is cooked by simmering to achieve a golden color and a delicious taste, rich in nutrients, making it an excellent choice for autumn and winter consumption and a great tonic.

name: 咸鱼蒸肉饼
description: 咸鱼蒸肉饼是一道以猪肉为主要食材，搭配咸鱼干蒸制而成的传统粤菜。这道菜通过将腌制的咸鱼与猪肉混合，再进行蒸制，使肉饼吸收咸鱼的咸香，猪肉的鲜嫩与咸鱼的浓郁风味相互交融，是一道下饭的好菜。
description_en: Salted Fish Steamed Meat Patty is a traditional Cantonese dish made with pork and dried salted fish. The pork is mixed with the salted fish, then steamed to allow the meat to absorb the saltiness of the fish. The tenderness of the pork and the rich flavor of the fish create a harmonious blend, making it a great dish to accompany rice.

name: 香辣皮皮虾
description: 香辣皮皮虾是一道以新鲜皮皮虾为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，通过炒制的方式烹饪而成。其特点是肉质鲜美，香辣可口，深受食客喜爱。
description_en: Spicy and Fragrant Crab is a seafood dish primarily made with fresh crabs, cooked by stir-frying. It is characterized by its delicate meat texture and spicy flavor, which is highly appreciated by diners.

name: 蒜蓉炒花蛤
description: 蒜蓉炒花蛤是一道以新鲜花蛤和大量蒜蓉为主料的海鲜类菜肴。其特点是花蛤肉质鲜嫩，蒜香浓郁。烹饪过程中，花蛤与蒜蓉、辣椒等调料快速翻炒，使花蛤充分吸收蒜香和辣味。
description_en: Stir-Fried Clams with Garlic is a seafood dish featuring fresh clams and a generous amount of minced garlic. The dish is characterized by the tender texture of the clams and the rich aroma of garlic. During cooking, clams are quickly stir-fried with garlic, chili, and other seasonings, allowing the clams to fully absorb the garlic flavor and spiciness.

name: 豉椒炒青口
name_en: Stir-Fried Mussel with Black Bean and Chili
description: 豉椒炒青口是一道以青口（一种贝类海鲜）为主要食材的菜肴，以豆豉和辣椒为主要调料，通过炒制的方式烹饪而成，味道鲜美，带有豆豉的咸香和辣椒的微辣。
description_en: Stir-Fried Mussel with Black Bean and Chili is a dish featuring mussels as the main ingredient, seasoned primarily with fermented black beans and chili peppers. Prepared by stir-frying, it offers a delicious taste with a savory flavor from the black beans and a slight spiciness from the chili peppers.

name: 海参炖鸡汁
name_en: Sea Cucumber Stewed in Chicken Broth
description: 海参炖鸡汁是一道以海参和鸡肉为主要食材的传统滋补名菜。选用优质海参，搭配新鲜鸡肉，经过长时间炖煮，使海参吸收鸡肉的鲜美，同时鸡肉也融入海参的海洋风味，汤汁浓郁，营养丰富，具有很高的食疗价值。
description_en: Sea Cucumber Stewed in Chicken Broth is a traditional nourishing dish made with high-quality sea cucumber and fresh chicken. The sea cucumber absorbs the delicious flavor of the chicken, while the chicken merges with the marine aroma of the sea cucumber after a long stewing process. The soup is rich and nutritious, and it is known for its high therapeutic value.

name: XO酱爆鲜贝
description: XO酱爆鲜贝是一道以新鲜扇贝为主要食材的经典粤菜。这道菜的特点是使用特制的XO酱，这种酱料由火腿、干贝、虾米等海味制成，味道鲜美，香气浓郁。鲜贝经过快速翻炒后，肉质鲜嫩，搭配XO酱恰到好处的香辣，让人回味无穷。
description_en: XO Sauce Stir-fried Scallops is a classic Cantonese dish featuring fresh scallops as the main ingredient. Characterized by the use of special XO sauce, which is made from ham, dried scallops, shrimp, and other seafood flavors, it boasts a rich aroma and exquisite taste. The scallops are quickly stir-fried to retain their tender texture, perfectly complemented by the mild spiciness of the XO sauce, leaving a lingering impression on the palate.

name: 辣炒墨鱼丝
description: 辣炒墨鱼丝是一道以墨鱼为主料，辅以辣椒、大葱等调料制成的海鲜菜肴。它色泽鲜艳，口感劲道，辣味十足，是开胃下饭的佳肴。
description_en: Spicy Stir-Fried Squid is a seafood dish made with squid as the main ingredient, complemented by chili peppers, green onions, and other seasonings. It has a vibrant color, chewy texture, and a strong spicy flavor, making it an appetizing and digestible dish.

name: 糖醋带鱼
description: 糖醋带鱼是一道以带鱼为主料，辅以糖醋汁烹制而成的菜肴。这道菜色泽红亮，酸甜可口，肉质鲜嫩，是许多家庭喜爱的家常菜。
description_en: Sweet and Sour Hairtail Fish is a dish made with hairtail fish as the main ingredient, cooked with a sweet and sour sauce. The dish has a bright red color, a sweet and sour taste, tender texture, and is a favorite home-cooked dish for many families.

name: 红烧鳜鱼
description: 红烧鳜鱼是一道以鳜鱼为主要食材的传统名菜，色泽红亮，味道鲜美，肉质细嫩。烹饪过程中，将鳜鱼炸至外皮酥脆，然后加入酱油、料酒、糖等调料进行红烧，配以葱、姜、蒜等香料，使其味道浓郁，风味独特。
description_en: Braised Mandarin Fish is a traditional famous dish with mandarin fish as the main ingredient, featuring a bright red color and a delicious taste with tender and delicate meat. In the cooking process, the mandarin fish is fried until the skin is crispy, and then braised with soy sauce, cooking wine, sugar, and other seasonings, complemented by onions, ginger, garlic, and other spices, making the flavor rich and unique.

name: 清蒸多春鱼
description: 清蒸多春鱼是一道以多春鱼为主料，通过清蒸的方式烹饪而成的海鲜菜肴。它保留了鱼的鲜美和原汁原味，肉质细嫩，带有独特的香气。
description_en: Steamed Lumpfish is a seafood dish made from lumpfish, cooked by steaming to preserve the fish's fresh flavor and original taste. The texture is tender, with a distinctive aroma.

name: 豉汁蒸青蟹
name_en: Steamed Green Crab with Black Bean Sauce
description: 豉汁蒸青蟹是一道以新鲜青蟹为主料，搭配豉汁等调料蒸制而成的菜肴。其肉质鲜美，味道醇厚，豉香浓郁，是典型的海鲜类菜品。
description_en: Steamed Green Crab with Black Bean Sauce is a dish made from fresh green crab, seasoned with black bean sauce and steamed until cooked. It is known for its succulent meat and rich, savory flavor with a strong aroma of fermented black beans, making it a quintessential seafood dish.

name: 清汤鱼肠
description: 清汤鱼肠是一道以鱼肠为主要食材制作的汤品。鱼肠经过清洗后切段，搭配清汤烹饪，可以加入一些蔬菜如豆芽、金针菇等增加口感和营养。
description_en: Fish Intestine Soup is a soup dish primarily made from fish intestines. After cleaning, the fish intestines are cut into segments and cooked with a clear soup, sometimes accompanied by vegetables such as bean sprouts and enoki mushrooms for added texture and nutrition.

name: 羊肚菌炖鲍鱼
description: 羊肚菌炖鲍鱼是一道以羊肚菌和鲍鱼为主要食材的滋补汤品。羊肚菌味道鲜美，鲍鱼肉质细嫩，营养丰富，两者搭配炖煮，汤色清澈，味道醇厚。
description_en: Morel Braised Abalone is a nourishing soup dish featuring morels and abalones as the main ingredients. The combination of the delicious flavor of morels and the tender texture of abalones results in a clear soup with a rich taste.

name: 芥末章鱼须
description: 芥末章鱼须是一道常见的日式海鲜小吃，选用新鲜的章鱼须，搭配特制的芥末酱汁，口感爽脆，芥末的辛辣刺激与章鱼的鲜美完美融合，是开胃的佳品。
description_en: Spicy Octopus Tentacles is a popular Japanese seafood snack made with fresh octopus tentacles and a special spicy mustard sauce. The dish features a crisp texture and a perfect blend of the pungent taste of mustard with the freshness of octopus, making it an excellent appetizer.

name: 咸蛋黄焗虾
description: 咸蛋黄焗虾是一道以新鲜虾为主要食材，配以咸蛋黄和其他调料烹饪而成的海鲜菜式。它的口感鲜美，味道浓郁，虾肉的鲜嫩与咸蛋黄的咸香完美融合，是一道色香味俱全的佳肴。
description_en: Salted Egg Yolk Baked Shrimp is a seafood dish made from fresh shrimp and salted egg yolk, seasoned and baked. This dish is known for its delicious taste and rich flavor, where the tender shrimp meat combines perfectly with the savory salted egg yolk, resulting in a visually appealing and flavorful dish.

name: 葱姜炒梭子蟹
name_en: Stir-Fried Swimming Crab with Ginger and Scallion
description: 葱姜炒梭子蟹是一道以梭子蟹为主要食材，辅以葱和姜等调料进行炒制的海鲜类菜肴。其特点是肉质鲜美，葱姜香味浓郁，营养丰富。
description_en: A seafood dish featuring swimming crab stir-fried with ginger and scallion, known for its tender meat and rich aroma of ginger and scallion. It is rich in nutrition.

name: 椒盐小白虾
description: 椒盐小白虾是一道以小白虾为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。通常将小白虾洗净后沥干水分，用椒盐等调料腌制，随后进行油炸至外皮酥脆。这道菜外酥内嫩，椒盐的香辣味与虾肉的鲜美完美融合，是下酒的好菜。
description_en: Spicy Salt Baby Shrimp is a seafood dish mainly made with baby shrimp. The shrimp are cleaned, drained, marinated with spicy salt and other seasonings, and then deep-fried until crispy. This dish has a crispy exterior and tender interior, with the spicy flavor of the salt perfectly blending with the freshness of the shrimp, making it a great accompaniment to alcohol.

name: 豆豉炒花甲
name_en: Sautéed Clams with Fermented Soybean Paste
description: 豆豉炒花甲是一道以花甲为主要食材，辅以豆豉、蒜泥、辣椒等调料，通过炒制而成的海鲜菜肴。其特点是口味咸鲜微辣，花甲肉质鲜嫩。
description_en: Sautéed Clams with Fermented Soybean Paste is a seafood dish that uses clams as the main ingredient, complemented by fermented soybean paste, minced garlic, chili peppers, and other seasonings. It is made by stir-frying, resulting in a dish that is salty, slightly spicy, and features tender clam meat.

name: 荆芥拌虾皮
description: 荆芥拌虾皮是一道以荆芥和虾皮为主要食材的凉菜，鲜嫩的荆芥叶搭配上富含钙质的虾皮，口感爽脆，营养丰富。这道菜简单易做，适合作为开胃前菜。
description_en: Jing Jie mixed with shrimp skin is a cold dish mainly made of perilla and shrimp skin. Tender perilla leaves are paired with calcium-rich shrimp skin, resulting in a crisp and nutritious texture. This dish is simple to make and suitable as an appetizer.

name: 香煎马哈鱼片
description: 香煎马哈鱼片是一道以马哈鱼为主要食材的烹饪菜肴，通过简单的煎制过程，使鱼肉外焦里嫩，香气四溢。这道菜色泽金黄，口感鲜美，是海鲜爱好者的佳选。
description_en: Pan-Fried Salmon Fillets is a culinary dish primarily made with salmon, cooked through a simple pan-frying process to achieve a crispy exterior and tender interior. This dish is golden in color and has a delicious taste, making it a favorite choice for seafood enthusiasts.

name: 小米辣蒸鲈鱼片
description: 小米辣蒸鲈鱼片是一道以鲈鱼和小米辣为主要食材的蒸菜。鲈鱼切片后，混合小米辣、姜片和蒸鱼豉油等调料，放入蒸锅蒸至鱼肉熟透，这道菜肉质鲜嫩，辣味适中，色香味俱全。
description_en: Steamed Perch Slices with Chili is a steamed dish primarily made with perch and chili peppers. Sliced perch is mixed with chili peppers, ginger, and soy sauce for steaming. The dish has tender fish meat with a moderate spiciness, presenting an appealing combination of taste, aroma, and appearance.

name: 酱烤秋刀鱼
description: 酱烤秋刀鱼是一道以秋刀鱼为主料，搭配特制酱料烤制而成的海鲜美食。秋刀鱼肉质鲜嫩，经过烤制后外皮香脆，内肉多汁，搭配的酱料增加了风味，使得整体口感层次丰富，是烧烤和日式料理中常见的一道菜。
description_en: Grilled Mackerel with Sauce is a seafood dish made from mackerel that is grilled with a special sauce. The mackerel has a tender texture, and after grilling, the skin is crispy while the inside remains juicy. The sauce adds extra flavor, creating a rich taste experience. It is a common dish in barbecue and Japanese cuisine.

name: 五香熏鱼
description: 五香熏鱼是一道以鱼类为主要食材的中式菜肴。这道菜通过腌制鱼肉，加入五香粉等多种香料后进行熏制，使其具有独特的烟熏香味和丰富的五香味道。
description_en: Spiced Smoked Fish is a traditional Chinese dish that features fish as the main ingredient. The dish is marinated with a variety of spices including five-spice powder and then smoked, giving it a distinctive smoky aroma and a rich, flavorful taste.

name: 芥末银鱼
description: 芥末银鱼是一道以银鱼为主要食材，搭配芥末和其他调料制成的开胃小吃。银鱼口感细腻，芥末的辛辣与银鱼的鲜美相结合，是一道独特的风味小吃。
description_en: Mustard Silver Fish is a snack dish made with silver fish as the main ingredient, complemented by mustard and other seasonings. The texture of silver fish is delicate, and the pungency of mustard combines with the freshness of silver fish to create a unique snack.

name: 葱油虾球
description: 葱油虾球是一道以新鲜虾仁为主料，辅以葱油、姜丝、料酒等调料烹饪而成的海鲜菜肴。虾仁经过处理后，与葱油等调料一同烹制，使得虾球鲜嫩多汁，葱香四溢，口感丰富。
description_en: Scallop balls with scallion oil is a seafood dish primarily made with fresh scallops, complemented by scallion oil, shredded ginger, and cooking wine as seasonings. The scallops are processed and cooked with scallion oil and other seasonings, resulting in a tender and juicy texture with a rich flavor of scallions.

name: 红焖海螺
description: 红焖海螺是一道经典的海鲜菜肴，选用新鲜的海螺肉为主料，搭配葱、姜、蒜等调料，用慢火焖煮至熟，肉质鲜嫩，汁香味浓。
description_en: Braised Whelk is a classic seafood dish made with fresh whelk meat as the main ingredient, complemented by scallions, ginger, garlic, and other condiments. It is cooked slowly until tender, resulting in a dish with tender and flavorful meat.

name: 椒麻皮皮虾
name_en: Spicy and Numbing Peel and Peel Shrimp
description: 椒麻皮皮虾是一道以皮皮虾为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，特点是色泽红亮，肉质鲜嫩，带有麻辣和花椒的香气，口感层次丰富。
description_en: Spicy and Numbing Peel and Peel Shrimp is a seafood dish mainly made of peel and peel shrimp. It is characterized by its bright red color, tender meat, and the aroma of spicy and Sichuan pepper, with a rich taste.

name: 尖椒炒河蟹
description: 尖椒炒河蟹是一道色香味俱全的传统汉族名菜，主要食材为河蟹和尖椒。河蟹肉质鲜美，尖椒的香辣味渗透其中，味道鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: A traditional Chinese dish that combines the tender and flavorful river crab with the spicy kick of chili peppers, creating a dish that is both visually appealing and packed with taste and nutrition.

name: 糖醋大虾
description: 糖醋大虾是一道典型的中式菜肴，以新鲜的大虾为主料，通过裹粉炸制后浇上酸甜口味的糖醋汁制作而成。这道菜色泽红亮，口感外酥里嫩，酸甜适中，是一道深受大众喜爱的海鲜菜肴。
description_en: Sweet and Sour Prawns is a classic Chinese dish made from fresh prawns coated in batter and deep-fried until crispy, then covered in a sweet and sour sauce. The dish has a bright red color, with a crispy exterior and tender interior, and is well-balanced in terms of sweetness and sourness, making it a popular seafood dish.

name: 紫苏炒蛏子
description: 紫苏炒蛏子是一道以新鲜蛏子和紫苏叶为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。蛏子肉质鲜嫩，紫苏叶带有特殊的香气，两者搭配炒制，味道鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Fried Razor Clams with Perilla is a seafood dish made with fresh razor clams and perilla leaves as the main ingredients. The clams have a tender texture, and the perilla leaves have a distinctive aroma, making this dish delicious and nutritious.

name: 鱼香墨鱼花
description: 鱼香墨鱼花是一道以墨鱼为主要食材，采用鱼香口味烹饪方法制作而成的川菜。这道菜色泽红亮，味道鲜美，酸、甜、辣、咸四种味道相互交融，口感丰富，是一道色香味俱佳的传统川菜。
description_en: Fish-Flavored Cuttlefish Blossom is a traditional Sichuan dish primarily made with cuttlefish, prepared with a fish-flavored sauce. The dish is known for its bright red color, delicious taste, and a harmonious blend of sour, sweet, spicy, and savory flavors, offering a rich and delightful culinary experience.

name: 辣炒蟹钳
description: 辣炒蟹钳是一道以蟹钳为主料，辅以辣椒、葱、姜等调料，通过翻炒烹饪而成的海鲜菜。这道菜以其鲜辣的口感和蟹钳的鲜美肉质而受到食客的喜爱。
description_en: Spicy Fried Crab Claws is a seafood dish featuring crab claws as the main ingredient, complemented by chili peppers, onions, ginger, and other seasonings, cooked by stir-frying. This dish is loved by diners for its fresh and spicy taste, as well as the tender and delicious flesh of the crab claws.

name: 黄辣丁鱼火锅
description: 黄辣丁鱼火锅是一道以黄辣丁鱼为主要食材的火锅菜品，汤底香辣，鱼肉鲜嫩，含有丰富的蛋白质和微量元素。
description_en: Spicy Yellow Catfish Hotpot is a hotpot dish that uses yellow catfish as the main ingredient. The soup base is spicy and the fish meat is tender, rich in protein and trace elements.

name: 小米辣蒸青斑鱼
description: 小米辣蒸青斑鱼是一道以青斑鱼为主料，小米辣为辅料的蒸制海鲜菜肴。青斑鱼肉细嫩鲜美，加入小米辣后口感香辣，是一道色香味俱佳的佳肴。
description_en: Steamed Coral Trout with Chili is a seafood dish mainly made of Coral Trout and Chili. The tender and delicious flesh of Coral Trout is enhanced by the spicy taste of chili, making it a visually appealing and flavorful dish.

name: 蚝汁白贝
description: 蚝汁白贝是一道以白贝（扇贝）为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。将新鲜的白贝洗净后，配以蚝汁、葱花、蒜等调味料，通过蒸煮的方式烹饪而成，使白贝吸收蚝汁的鲜美，口感鲜嫩多汁。
description_en: Oyster Sauce Scallops is a seafood dish primarily made with scallops. Fresh scallops are cleaned and cooked with oyster sauce, green onions, garlic, and other seasonings through steaming, allowing the scallops to absorb the delicious flavor of the oyster sauce, resulting in a tender and juicy texture.

name: 姜葱煎虾饼
name_en: Ginger and Scallion Fried Shrimp Cake
description: 姜葱煎虾饼是一道以鲜虾、姜、葱为主要原料的海鲜菜肴，通过煎制的方式烹制而成。虾肉鲜美，姜葱的香味与虾的甜味完美结合，外皮微酥，内里鲜嫩多汁，是家庭和餐厅中常见的美味佳肴。
description_en: Ginger and Scallion Fried Shrimp Cake is a seafood dish primarily made with fresh shrimp, ginger, and scallions. It is cooked by frying, resulting in a delicious combination of the sweetness of shrimp and the aroma of ginger and scallions. The exterior is slightly crispy while the interior remains tender and juicy, making it a popular choice in both homes and restaurants.

name: 香煎带子
description: 香煎带子是一道以新鲜带子为主要食材的海鲜料理，通常选用大颗带子，通过轻微的煎烤来锁住其鲜味和汁液，通常搭配蒜蓉、香草等香料增加风味。
description_en: Pan-Fried Scallops is a seafood dish featuring fresh scallops as the main ingredient, typically large scallops are lightly pan-fried to lock in their freshness and juices, often accompanied by garlic, herbs, and other spices to enhance the flavor.

name: 沙拉海月水母
description: 沙拉海月水母是一道以海月水母为主料的海鲜凉菜。这道菜通过将海月水母与各种蔬菜、水果混合，配合特制沙拉酱，制作而成。它不仅口感爽脆、风味独特，而且营养价值高，富含丰富的蛋白质和矿物质。
description_en: Sea Moon Jellyfish Salad is a seafood dish primarily made from sea moon jellyfish, mixed with various vegetables and fruits, and served with a special dressing. It is known for its crunchy texture, unique taste, and high nutritional value, rich in protein and minerals.

name: 扣三丝
description: 扣三丝是一道经典的上海菜，主要由鸡肉丝、火腿丝和笋丝组成。这道菜的制作工艺精细，需要将食材切成细丝，再通过蒸煮的方式使原料的味道相互融合，口感细腻，味道鲜美。
description_en: Braised Three Shreds is a classic Shanghai dish, primarily made up of shredded chicken, ham, and bamboo shoots. This dish requires meticulous craftsmanship, with ingredients finely sliced into thin shreds and then braised to allow the flavors to meld together, resulting in a delicate texture and a savory taste.

name: 三套鸭
description: 三套鸭是一道江苏扬州的传统名菜，以整鸭去骨后，依次套入鸽、鹌鹑制成，外形完整，肉质鲜嫩，汤汁浓郁，风味独特。
description_en: A traditional dish from Yangzhou, Jiangsu, the Three-Duck Delicacy involves deboning an entire duck and sequentially stuffing it with pigeon and quail, creating a unique dish with a complete shape and tender meat. The soup is rich and the flavor is distinctive.

name: 蟹粉狮子头
description: 蟹粉狮子头是一道江苏扬州的传统名菜，以五花肉为主料，加入蟹肉、蟹黄等制成的蟹粉，经过精心烹制，肉质鲜嫩，汤汁浓郁，蟹味十足，是扬州早茶中不可或缺的一道美味。
description_en: Crab Powder Lion's Head is a traditional dish from Yangzhou, Jiangsu, made from pork with the addition of crab meat and roe to create a crab powder. It is carefully cooked to achieve a tender texture and rich broth, fully infused with the flavor of crab, making it an indispensable delicacy in Yangzhou's morning tea.

name: 豆鼓蒸黄鱼片
name_en: Steamed Yellow Croaker with Fermented Black Beans
description: 豆鼓蒸黄鱼片是一道以黄鱼为主料，辅以豆鼓等调料蒸制而成的海鲜菜肴。其特点是鱼肉鲜嫩，豆鼓香浓，味道鲜美。
description_en: Steamed Yellow Croaker with Fermented Black Beans is a seafood dish primarily made with yellow croaker and seasoned with fermented black beans. It is characterized by its tender fish and rich fermented bean fragrance, offering a delicious flavor.

name: 辣汤虾滑
description: 辣汤虾滑是一道以鲜虾为主要食材，配合辣椒等调料制成的汤品。虾肉经过特殊处理，口感滑嫩，汤味鲜辣适口，是喜欢辣味的食客的佳肴。
description_en: Spicy Shrimp Soup is a delicacy primarily made with fresh shrimp and seasoned with chili peppers. The shrimp meat is specially processed to be tender and slippery, and the soup has a fresh and spicy flavor, making it a favorite among those who enjoy spicy food.

name: 剁椒蒸多宝鱼
description: 剁椒蒸多宝鱼是一道以多宝鱼为主料，辅以剁椒等调料制作而成的湘菜。这道菜色泽红亮，味道鲜美，辣中带鲜，蒸制的方式使鱼肉更加细嫩。
description_en: Steamed Turbot with Chopped Chili is a Hunan dish made with turbot and seasoned with chopped chili. The dish has a bright red color, a delicious taste, a spicy and fresh flavor, and the steaming method makes the fish more tender.

name: 芥末虾仁拌木耳
description: 芥末虾仁拌木耳是一道清爽的凉拌菜。主要原料为虾仁和泡发好的木耳，以芥末为主要调料，再配以酱油、醋等调味品，使得这道菜口感鲜辣，带有芥末的呛香，是一道开胃的前菜。
description_en: Mustard Shrimp with Black Fungus is a refreshing cold dish. The main ingredients are shrimp and rehydrated black fungus, seasoned primarily with mustard, accompanied by soy sauce, vinegar, and other condiments to achieve a fresh and spicy taste with the pungent aroma of mustard, making it an appetizing appetizer.

name: 黄瓜拌海肠
description: 黄瓜拌海肠是一道清爽口味的凉菜，主料包括新鲜的黄瓜和海肠，通常会配以醋、蒜泥、酱油等调料拌匀，口感爽脆、鲜香，是夏日里非常受欢迎的一道开胃菜。
description_en: Cucumber and Sea Cucumber Salad is a refreshing cold dish that combines fresh cucumber with sea cucumber. It is typically seasoned with vinegar, minced garlic, and soy sauce to create a crisp and savory flavor, making it a popular appetizer especially in the summer.

name: 牛蒡虾汤
description: 牛蒡虾汤是一道以牛蒡和虾为主要食材的汤品。牛蒡具有清热解毒、利尿消肿的功效，搭配富含蛋白质的虾，营养丰富，口味鲜美。
description_en: Burdock and Shrimp Soup is a soup dish made primarily from burdock and shrimp. Burdock has the effects of clearing heat and detoxifying, promoting diuresis and reducing swelling, while shrimp is rich in protein. This soup is nutritious and tastes delicious.

name: 白灼花螺
description: 白灼花螺是一道以花螺为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。它通过将新鲜的花螺清洗后放入沸水中快速煮熟，保持其原汁原味，最后配以简单的调味料，如酱油、葱、姜等，以突出花螺的鲜美。
description_en: Boiled Flower Whelk is a seafood dish that uses flower whelk as the main ingredient. It is quickly cooked in boiling water to maintain its original flavor and then served with simple seasonings such as soy sauce, green onions, and ginger to highlight the delicacy of the flower whelk.

name: 葱油海蜇头
description: 葱油海蜇头是一道以海蜇头为主料，配以小葱、蒜末等辅料制成的凉菜。海蜇头经过清水浸泡去除咸味和杂质，随后切片，与葱油、蒜末、香菜等调料拌匀，口感爽脆，风味独特。
description_en: Scallion Oil Jellyfish Head is a cold dish made from jellyfish heads with the addition of scallions, garlic, and other accessories. After soaking jellyfish heads in water to remove saltiness and impurities, they are sliced and mixed with scallion oil, minced garlic, cilantro, and other seasonings, resulting in a refreshing and unique taste.

name: 姜汁扇贝肉
description: 姜汁扇贝肉是一道以新鲜扇贝肉为主料，配以姜丝、蒜末等调料烹制而成的海鲜菜。其特点是肉质鲜嫩，姜香浓郁，味道鲜美。
description_en: Ginger Scallop Meat is a seafood dish made with fresh scallop meat as the main ingredient, cooked with ginger shreds, garlic and other seasonings. It features tender meat with a rich ginger fragrance and a delicious taste.

name: 鱼肚烧海参
name_en: Braised Sea Cucumber with Fish Maw
description: 鱼肚烧海参是一道以海参与鱼肚为主要食材的高档菜肴，通过烧制的方式烹饪而成。海参与鱼肚均为富含胶原蛋白的海产品，具有很高的营养价值。这道菜色泽红亮，口感滑嫩，味道鲜美，是宴席上的常见佳肴。
description_en: Braised Sea Cucumber with Fish Maw is a high-end dish that uses sea cucumber and fish maw as the main ingredients, cooked by braising. Both sea cucumber and fish maw are marine products rich in collagen and have high nutritional value. This dish has a bright red color, a smooth and tender texture, and a delicious taste, making it a common delicacy at banquets.

name: 干锅海龙虾
description: 干锅海龙虾是一道以鲜活海龙虾为主料，辅以各种调料和配菜制成的麻辣口味的海鲜菜肴。其特点是龙虾肉质鲜嫩，香辣可口，是海鲜爱好者和辣味爱好者的佳肴。
description_en: Dry Pot Sea Lobster is a spicy seafood dish made with fresh sea lobster as the main ingredient, complemented by various seasonings and side dishes. It is characterized by the tender texture of the lobster meat and a savory spiciness, making it a delightful choice for seafood and spicy food enthusiasts.

name: 麻辣小海螺
description: 麻辣小海螺是一道以小海螺为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，特点是鲜辣味浓，肉质鲜嫩，是四川和重庆地区非常受欢迎的一道菜。
description_en: Spicy Sea Snails is a seafood dish mainly made with small sea snails, characterized by a strong and spicy flavor with tender and juicy texture, and is a popular dish in Sichuan and Chongqing areas.

name: 白灼基围虾
description: 白灼基围虾是一道以新鲜活虾为主料的海鲜菜品，通过简单的白水煮制来保留虾肉的鲜美和口感，通常会配以简单的蘸料食用。
description_en: Boiled Shrimp is a seafood dish that primarily uses fresh live shrimp. It is boiled simply in water to preserve the freshness and texture of the shrimp meat, often served with a simple dipping sauce.

name: 麻辣基围虾
description: 麻辣基围虾是一道以基围虾和麻辣调料为主要食材的川菜，口感麻辣鲜香，肉质爽滑，色泽红亮，是一道非常受欢迎的海鲜菜肴。
description_en: Spicy Crawfish is a Sichuan dish made with crawfish and spicy seasonings, featuring a numbing and spicy flavor with tender and smooth texture, and a bright red color. It is a very popular seafood dish.

name: 干烧黄鱼段
description: 干烧黄鱼段是一道以黄鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜品，通过干烧的烹饪手法，使鱼肉外焦里嫩，口味独特，具有浓郁的酱香味。
description_en: Dry-fried Yellow Croaker is a seafood dish featuring yellow croaker as the main ingredient. It is cooked dry until the fish is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a distinctive taste and rich sauce flavor.

name: 粉丝蒸大虾
description: 粉丝蒸大虾是一道以新鲜大虾和粉丝为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。粉丝提前用水泡软，大虾去壳去肠，用蒜末、姜末、生抽、料酒等调料腌制入味，然后将粉丝铺底，大虾放在粉丝之上，撒上葱花、辣椒圈等，最后浇上热油，蒸制而成。这道菜色香味俱全，粉丝吸收了虾的鲜味和调料的香气，口感鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Steamed Shrimp with Vermicelli is a seafood dish mainly made with fresh shrimp and vermicelli. Vermicelli is soaked in water beforehand, shrimp are peeled and gutted, and marinated with minced garlic, ginger, light soy sauce, cooking wine and other seasonings to enhance the flavor. Then vermicelli is laid at the bottom, topped with shrimp, sprinkled with scallions and chili rings, and finally drizzled with hot oil before being steamed. This dish is full of color, aroma and taste, with vermicelli absorbing the freshness of the shrimp and the aroma of the seasonings, making it a delicious and nutritious meal.

name: 柠檬红茶
description: 柠檬红茶是一种结合了红茶和柠檬的饮品，红茶的醇厚口感与柠檬的清新酸甜相得益彰，是夏日消暑的理想选择。
description_en: Lemon Black Tea is a refreshing beverage that combines the rich taste of black tea with the bright, tangy flavor of lemon. It is an ideal choice for cooling down on hot summer days.

name: 茉莉花茶
description: 茉莉花茶是一种以茶叶和茉莉花为原料，经过多次窨制而成的花茶。茶叶吸收了茉莉花的香气，茶汤呈现出淡雅的花香和清新的口感，是一种非常受欢迎的饮品。
description_en: Jasmine Tea is a type of scented tea made from tea leaves and jasmine flowers through multiple scenting processes. The tea absorbs the aroma of jasmine flowers, offering a subtle floral scent and a fresh taste, making it a popular beverage.

name: 菊花茶
description: 菊花茶是一种以菊花为主要成分的茶饮，菊花具有清热解毒、明目的功效。菊花茶色泽金黄，味道清香，可以单独饮用，也可以与其他茶叶如绿茶、乌龙茶等搭配饮用。
description_en: Chrysanthemum tea is a type of tea made primarily from chrysanthemum flowers, known for their properties of clearing heat and detoxifying, as well as for their beneficial effects on eyesight. With a golden hue and a fragrant aroma, chrysanthemum tea can be consumed on its own or blended with other types of tea such as green tea or oolong tea.

name: 碧螺春
description: 碧螺春是一种中国传统绿茶，产自江苏省太湖的洞庭山。其茶叶呈卷曲状，形似螺，色泽翠绿，嫩芽繁多，香气清雅，味道鲜爽。碧螺春茶汤色泽碧绿清澈，口感甘醇，具有独特的香气和回甘。
description_en: Biluochun is a traditional Chinese green tea originating from Dongting Mountain in Taihu Lake, Jiangsu Province. The tea leaves are curled, resembling a spiral, with a green color and abundant tender buds. It has a fresh and elegant aroma and a sweet, refreshing taste. The tea soup is green and clear, with a mellow mouthfeel and a unique fragrance and aftertaste.

name: 铁观音
description: 铁观音是中国福建省安溪县的特产，属于乌龙茶类。它以独特的香气和滋味而闻名，具有绿叶红镶边的外形。泡制后的铁观音汤色金黄明亮，香气浓郁持久，滋味醇厚甘鲜，回甘生津。
description_en: Tie Guan Yin is a specialty from Anxi County in Fujian Province, China, and belongs to the category of oolong tea. It is known for its unique aroma and taste, with a green leaf edge. After brewing, Tie Guan Yin has a golden and bright soup color, rich and long-lasting aroma, and thick and sweet taste, with a sweet aftertaste.

name: 大红袍
description: 大红袍是福建省武夷山特产的乌龙茶，以其独特的香气和味道而闻名。这种茶叶外形条索紧结，色泽绿褐鲜润，冲泡后汤色橙黄明亮，滋味醇厚甘鲜，香气馥郁而持久。
description_en: Da Hong Pao, originating from Wuyi Mountain in Fujian province, is a specialty oolong tea known for its distinctive aroma and flavor. The tea leaves are tightly rolled with a green-brown, vibrant color. When brewed, the tea soup has an orange-yellow clarity, a rich and sweet taste, and a lasting, rich fragrance.

name: 普洱茶
description: 普洱茶是一种产自中国云南省的发酵茶，有着独特的陈香和醇厚的口感。它既可以生饮也可以熟饮，具有降脂减肥、助消化等健康益处。
description_en: Pu'er Tea, a fermented tea originating from Yunnan Province, China, is known for its distinctive aged aroma and rich, mellow taste. It can be enjoyed both raw and ripe, and is known for its health benefits such as reducing body fat, aiding digestion, and other wellness perks.

name: 竹叶青茶
description: 竹叶青茶是一种以绿茶为基底，配以竹叶香气的茶饮。它色泽翠绿，口感清新，具有独特的竹叶清香，常被视作一种养生茶饮。
description_en: Bamboo Leaf Green Tea is a type of tea based on green tea, flavored with the aroma of bamboo leaves. It is characterized by its green color and fresh taste, with a unique fragrance of bamboo leaves, often considered a healthful beverage.

name: 信阳毛尖
description: 信阳毛尖是中国河南省信阳市出产的一种绿茶，以其嫩芽尖部的细毛和独特的香气而闻名。毛尖茶色绿汤清，具有清高持久的香气和醇厚爽口的口感。
description_en: Xinyang Maojian is a green tea produced in Xinyang City, Henan Province, China, known for its tender buds with fine hairs and distinctive aroma. The tea has a green color and clear soup, with a high and lasting fragrance, and a mellow and refreshing taste.

name: 黄山毛峰
description: 黄山毛峰是中国十大名茶之一，产于安徽省黄山市的绿茶。其外形细嫩卷曲，白毫显露，色泽翠绿，香气清高持久，滋味鲜爽回甘，汤色清澈明亮，叶底嫩绿匀亮。黄山毛峰不仅口感上乘，还具有清热解毒、提神醒脑等功效。
description_en: Huangshan Maofeng is one of the top ten famous teas in China, a green tea produced in Huangshan City, Anhui Province. It has a delicate, curled shape with visible white down, green color, a fresh and lasting aroma, a fresh and sweet aftertaste, a clear and bright tea liquid, and a tender and bright tea base. Huangshan Maofeng not only tastes superior but also has effects such as clearing heat and detoxifying, and refreshing and invigorating the brain.

name: 六安瓜片
description: 六安瓜片是中国传统小吃之一，源自安徽六安市。以西瓜子为原料，经炒制或烘制而成，具有独特的香气和味道。
description_en: Lu'an Melon Seeds is a traditional Chinese snack originated from Lu'an city, Anhui province. Made from watermelon seeds through roasting or baking, it has a unique aroma and flavor.

name: 凤凰单枞茶
description: 凤凰单枞茶是中国广东潮州产的乌龙茶中的一个品种。它以其独特的香气和味道而闻名，香气高锐持久，汤色金黄明亮，滋味鲜爽，回甘悠长。
description_en: Phoenix Single Bush Tea is a variety of oolong tea produced in Chaozhou, Guangdong, China. It is known for its unique aroma and flavor, with a sharp and lasting fragrance, golden and bright soup color, fresh and refreshing taste, and a long-lasting aftertaste.

name: 太平猴魁
description: 太平猴魁是一种产自中国安徽省黄山市黄山区的绿茶，以其扁平挺直的茶叶形状和独特的香气而著名。这种茶叶通常在春季采摘，经过精心的手工制作，保留了茶叶的天然风味和营养价值。
description_en: Taiping Houkui is a green tea from Huangshan City in Anhui Province, known for its flat and straight leaf shape and distinctive aroma. This tea is usually picked in spring and crafted by hand to retain its natural flavor and nutritional value.

name: 安吉白茶
description: 安吉白茶是一种产自中国浙江省安吉县的绿茶，以其独特的白化变异茶树品种制作而成，茶叶色泽翠绿，汤色清澈明亮，香气清新，滋味鲜爽。
description_en: Anji White Tea is a type of green tea produced in Anji County, Zhejiang Province, China. It is made from a unique albino tea plant variety. The tea leaves are green and the soup is clear and bright, with a fresh aroma and a fresh taste.

name: 白毫银针
description: 白毫银针是一种中国福建省产的白茶，因其外形似针，全身白毫而得名。其色泽银白，香气清新，滋味鲜爽，是最高品质的白茶之一。
description_en: White Peony Silver Needle is a type of white tea produced in Fujian Province of China, named for its needle-like shape and white down. It features a silvery white color, fresh aroma, and a refreshing taste, making it one of the highest quality white teas.

name: 白牡丹茶
description: 白牡丹茶是一种白茶，主要以福建省的福鼎大白茶、政和大白茶等茶树品种的一芽一二叶为原料制成。其外形芽叶连枝，呈自然的灰绿色，色泽银白，形似牡丹花初放，因而得名。冲泡后汤色清澈明亮，香气清新，滋味鲜爽甘甜，具有很高的观赏价值和品饮价值。
description_en: White Peony is a type of white tea, mainly made from the buds and one or two leaves of tea varieties such as Fuding Da Bai and Zhenghe Da Bai in Fujian Province. Its appearance is a natural grey-green with a silvery hue, resembling the initial bloom of a peony flower, hence the name. When brewed, the tea has a clear and bright infusion, a fresh aroma, a sweet and refreshing taste, and is highly appreciated for both its aesthetic and taste value.

name: 正山小种
description: 正山小种是一种传统的中国红茶，产自福建省武夷山区，以其独特的烟熏香味而闻名。这种茶叶经过特殊的烟熏工艺处理，具有浓郁的松烟香和甘甜的回甘。
description_en: Lapsang Souchong is a traditional Chinese black tea produced in the Wuyi Mountain area of Fujian Province, known for its unique smoky aroma. The tea leaves are processed with a special smoking technique, resulting in a rich piney aroma and sweet aftertaste.

name: 祁门红茶
description: 祁门红茶是一种著名的中国红茶，产自安徽祁门县。其色泽乌润，汤色红艳，香气芬芳持久，滋味醇厚。
description_en: Keemun Black Tea is a famous Chinese black tea originating from Qimen County, Anhui. It has a dark and moist appearance, a bright red color in the tea liquor, a long-lasting fragrant aroma, and a rich and mellow taste.

name: 滇红茶
description: 滇红茶，又称云南红茶，是中国云南省的传统名茶。它以其独特的香气和味道而闻名，色泽红亮，叶质柔软，口感醇厚，汤色红艳透明，具有很好的回甘。
description_en: Dian Hong Tea, also known as Yunnan Black Tea, is a traditional famous tea from Yunnan Province, China. It is renowned for its unique aroma and flavor, bright red color, soft leaves, rich taste, and transparent red soup, with a good aftertaste.

name: 台湾高山乌龙
description: 台湾高山乌龙茶是一种产自台湾高山地区的半发酵茶，以其独特的香气和回甘而闻名。茶叶采摘于海拨1000米以上的高山，经过精细的工艺制作而成。
description_en: Taiwan High Mountain Oolong is a semi-fermented tea originating from the high mountain areas of Taiwan, renowned for its unique aroma and aftertaste. The tea leaves are picked from mountains above 1000 meters in altitude and are processed with a meticulous craft.

name: 东方美人茶
description: 东方美人茶是一种台湾特产的乌龙茶，以其独特的果香和蜜香著称。它的外观卷曲成球状，色泽呈现红褐，茶汤颜色金黄明亮，带有轻微的甘甜和花香。
description_en: Dongfang Meiren Tea, also known as Oriental Beauty Tea, is a special oolong tea from Taiwan, famous for its unique fruit and honey fragrances. It has a curled ball shape with a reddish-brown color and a golden, bright tea soup, with a slight sweetness and floral aroma.

name: 冻顶乌龙茶
description: 冻顶乌龙茶是台湾高山茶的代表之一，产于台湾南投县鹿谷乡的冻顶山。这种茶叶外形卷曲，色泽墨绿，香气清雅，汤色金黄，滋味甘醇，具有独特的高山冷香。
description_en: Dong Ding Oolong Tea is one of the representative high mountain teas from Taiwan, originating from Dong Ding Mountain in Lugu Township, Nantou County, Taiwan. This tea has a curled shape, dark green color, elegant aroma, golden liquor, and a sweet taste, possessing a unique high mountain cold fragrance.

name: 文山包种茶
description: 文山包种茶是一种台湾传统茶，产自台湾台北县文山区的茶区，属于轻发酵的茶树品种。茶汤色金黄明亮，口感清香甘甜，具有独特的果香味，如同水果般清甜。
description_en: Wenshan Baozhong Tea is a traditional tea from Taiwan, originating from the tea-growing region of Wenshan District in Taipei County. It is a lightly fermented tea variety. The tea soup is golden and bright, with a fresh and sweet taste, and has a unique fruity fragrance, as sweet as fruit.

name: 单枞蜜兰香
description: 单枞蜜兰香是一种以凤凰单枞茶为基底的茶饮，以其独特的蜜兰香气而闻名。这种茶通常在广东潮州地区制作，具有回甘持久和滋味醇厚的特点。
description_en: Dan Cong Mi Lan Xiang is a type of tea drink based on Fenghuang Dan Cong tea, famous for its unique honey orchid aroma. Typically made in the Chaoshan region of Guangdong, it is characterized by its long-lasting sweetness and rich flavor.

name: 福鼎白茶
description: 福鼎白茶，产自中国福建省福鼎市，是中国白茶的代表之一。它以嫩芽或嫩叶为原料，经过自然萎凋和干燥工艺精制而成。福鼎白茶汤色清澈，香气清新，滋味鲜爽，具有独特的保健功效和收藏价值。
description_en: Fuding Baihao White Tea is a representative of Chinese white tea, produced in Fuding City, Fujian Province, China. Made from tender buds or leaves, it is meticulously crafted through natural withering and drying processes. The tea has a clear liquor, a fresh aroma, and a refreshing taste, known for its unique health benefits and collectible value.

name: 挂壁柑普
description: 挂壁柑普是一种独特的普洱茶饮品，将普洱茶与晒干的柑皮结合，共同发酵，形成独特的风味和香气。饮用时，柑皮与茶汤融为一体，既有普洱茶的醇厚，又带有柑橘的清新。
description_en: Wall Hanging Citrus Pu-erh is a unique Pu-erh tea drink that combines dried citrus peel with Pu-erh tea, fermented together to create a unique flavor and aroma. When consumed, the citrus peel blends with the tea broth, offering the richness of Pu-erh tea along with the freshness of citrus.

name: 老白茶
description: 老白茶，产于中国福建省，是一种经过特殊工艺制作，自然发酵的茶叶。它有着独特的香气，口感醇厚，滋味甘甜，具有很高的收藏价值。老白茶随着存放时间的增加，其药用价值和口感均会有所提升，具有一定的保健功效。
description_en: Aged White Tea originates from Fujian Province of China and is a special type of tea that undergoes natural fermentation. It has a unique aroma and a rich, sweet flavor, which enhances over time, making it highly valuable for collection. The medicinal value and taste of aged white tea improve with age, offering various health benefits.

name: 信阳红
description: 信阳红是一种以信阳毛尖茶为基底，加入红枣、枸杞等养生食材，再以红糖调味后，用沸水冲泡而成的特色茶饮。此茶汤色红亮、甘甜醇厚，具有很好的养生保健效果。
description_en: Xinyang Hong is a special tea drink made from Xinyang Maojian tea as the base, added with health-boosting ingredients such as red dates and goji berries, then seasoned with brown sugar and brewed with boiling water. The tea has a bright red color and a sweet, mellow taste, and is known for its health benefits.

name: 布朗山普洱
description: 布朗山普洱茶是一种产自中国云南省布朗山地区的特色茶叶，属于普洱茶的一种。其特点是色泽褐红，香气独特，滋味醇厚，回甘持久，具有很好的陈化潜力。
description_en: Bolang Mountain Pu'er Tea is a special type of tea produced in the Bolang Mountain area of Yunnan Province, China, and is a type of Pu'er tea. It is characterized by its reddish-brown color, unique aroma, rich taste, and lasting sweetness, and has great potential for aging.

name: 云南滇绿
description: 云南滇绿，又名宝洪茶，是一种采摘于云南宝洪山的绿茶。滇绿以其独特的香气和回甘而著名，色泽翠绿，汤色清澈明亮，口感鲜爽，带有淡淡的花香。
description_en: Yunnan Dian Green, also known as Baohong tea, is a green tea harvested from Baohong Mountain in Yunnan. Renowned for its unique aroma and sweet aftertaste, it features a vibrant green color and clear, bright infusion with a fresh and floral flavor.

name: 乌梅汤
description: 乌梅汤是一种传统的饮品，以乌梅为主要原料，通常搭配冰糖、甘草和山楂等材料煮制而成。它味道酸甜适中，具有生津止渴、增进食欲的功效。
description_en: Plum Soup is a traditional drink primarily made with plums, often cooked with rock sugar, licorice, and hawthorn among other ingredients. It has a sweet and sour taste and is known for its thirst-quenching and appetite-enhancing properties.

name: 山楂水
description: 山楂水是由山楂制成的一种传统饮品，酸甜可口，具有消食化积的功效。
description_en: Hawthorn Water is a traditional drink made from hawthorn, which is sour and sweet, and has the effect of promoting digestion.

name: 金银花茶
description: 金银花茶是一种以金银花为主要原料的茶饮，具有清热解毒、凉血散瘀的功效。金银花性寒，适合夏季饮用，有助于消暑解渴。
description_en: Honeysuckle Flower Tea is a tea beverage primarily made from honeysuckle flowers, known for its heat-clearing and detoxifying properties, as well as its ability to cool blood and disperse blood stasis. Honeysuckle is cold in nature, making it suitable for consumption in summer to relieve heat and quench thirst.

name: 洛神花茶
description: 洛神花茶是一种以洛神花为主要原料的饮品，色泽鲜艳，口感酸甜，具有清热解毒、美容养颜的功效。
description_en: Hibiscus Tea is a beverage mainly made from hibiscus flowers, with a bright color and a sweet and sour taste. It is known for its health benefits such as detoxifying and beautifying the skin.

name: 玫瑰花茶
description: 玫瑰花茶是一种以干燥的玫瑰花蕾泡制的茶饮，具有独特的香气和淡淡的甜味，常被认为具有美容养颜和舒缓情绪的作用。
description_en: Rose Flower Tea is a type of tea made by steeping dried rose petals, which has a distinctive fragrance and a slight sweetness. It is often associated with beautifying the skin and soothing emotions.

name: 桂花茶
description: 桂花茶是一种以桂花和茶叶为主要原料制作的茶饮。它通常带有桂花的淡雅香气和茶叶的清新口感，风味独特，适宜四季饮用。
description_en: Osmanthus Tea is a beverage made primarily from dried osmanthus flowers and tea leaves. It is known for its subtle fragrance of osmanthus and the fresh taste of tea, offering a unique and refreshing flavor, suitable for consumption all year round.

name: 槐花茶
description: 槐花茶是一种以槐花为主要原料制作的饮品，具有清肝明目、清热解毒的功效。
description_en: Locust Blossom Tea is a refreshing drink made primarily from locust blossoms, known for its benefits in clearing the liver and eyesight as well as detoxifying the body.

name: 玉兰花茶
description: 玉兰花茶是一道具有清热去火功效的饮品。选用新鲜的玉兰花瓣，经过晾晒和干燥处理后，可以泡茶饮用。它带有独特的花香和轻微的甜味，颜色金黄透亮。
description_en: Magnolia Flower Tea is a refreshing beverage with heat-clearing properties. Made from fresh magnolia petals that are sun-dried and processed, it can be brewed to make a tea. The tea has a unique floral aroma and a slight sweetness, with a golden, translucent appearance.

name: 蒲公英茶
description: 蒲公英茶是一种以蒲公英为原料制成的饮品，具有清热解毒、利尿消肿的功效。蒲公英茶色泽金黄，口感清新，带有淡淡的苦味和草本香气。
description_en: Dandelion tea is a beverage made from dandelions, known for its detoxifying and diuretic properties. It has a golden color, a fresh taste, and a slight bitterness with a herbal aroma.

name: 紫苏茶
description: 紫苏茶是一种传统的药草茶，以紫苏叶为主要原料，泡制而成。紫苏叶具有独特的香气和味道，具有解表散寒、清热解毒的功效。
description_en: Perilla Tea is a traditional herbal tea made primarily from perilla leaves, which are known for their unique aroma and flavor. It is known for its effects of relieving exterior syndromes and clearing heat and toxins.

name: 苦荞茶
description: 苦荞茶是一种以苦荞麦为原料制成的茶饮。它具有独特的营养价值和健康益处，经常饮用可以降低血脂、降血糖和抗氧化。
description_en: Bitter buckwheat tea is a type of tea made from buckwheat. It is known for its unique nutritional value and health benefits, often consumed to reduce blood lipids, lower blood sugar, and provide antioxidant effects.

name: 黄菊花露
description: 黄菊花露是一种以菊花花瓣为主要成分的传统饮品，具有清热解毒的功效。
description_en: Chrysanthemum Dew is a traditional beverage made primarily from chrysanthemum petals, known for its heat-clearing and detoxifying properties.

name: 冰糖菊花饮
description: 冰糖菊花饮是一道以菊花和冰糖为主要原料的饮品。菊花具有清热解毒的功效，与冰糖搭配可以中和菊花的苦味，使得饮品甜润爽口。
description_en: Rock Candy Chrysanthemum Drink is a beverage made primarily from chrysanthemum flowers and rock sugar. Chrysanthemum flowers are known for their heat-clearing and detoxifying properties, and when paired with rock sugar, it balances the bitter taste of the flowers, resulting in a sweet and refreshing drink.

name: 槐米茶
description: 槐米茶是一种以槐树的花蕾或花朵干燥后制成的传统茶饮。它不仅具有清热解毒的功效，还能够帮助降低血压。槐米茶味道清新，带有淡淡的花香。
description_en: Locust Flower Tea is a traditional beverage made from dried buds or flowers of the locust tree. It is known for its detoxifying and blood pressure-lowering properties. The tea has a refreshing taste with a hint of floral aroma.

name: 柚子茶
description: 柚子茶是一种以柚子果皮和果肉为主要成分的饮品，它结合了柚子的清新香气和茶的甘醇口感。通常搭配蜂蜜或糖增加甜味，有时还会加入一些柠檬来增加风味。
description_en: Pomelo Tea is a beverage made primarily from the rind and fruit of pomelo, combined with the sweet aroma of pomelo and the mellow taste of tea. It is often sweetened with honey or sugar, and sometimes lemon is added for extra flavor.

name: 罗汉果茶
description: 罗汉果茶是一种以罗汉果为主要原料的饮品，具有清热解毒、润肺止咳的功效。罗汉果经过烘焙、切片、干燥处理后，可以直接泡水饮用，味道甘甜，适合热饮或冷饮。
description_en: Siraitia Grosvenorii tea is a beverage primarily made from Siraitia grosvenorii fruit, known for its detoxifying and cough-relieving properties. After being baked, sliced, and dried, the fruit can be directly soaked in water for hot or cold drinking, offering a sweet taste.

name: 桔红茶
description: 桔红茶是一种将红茶与新鲜桔皮或桔皮干混合制成的茶饮。它结合了红茶的醇厚口感和桔皮的清新香气，风味独特。
description_en: Tangerine black tea is a tea drink made by mixing black tea with fresh tangerine peel or dried tangerine peel. It combines the rich taste of black tea with the fresh aroma of tangerine peel, offering a unique flavor.

name: 桑葚汁
description: 桑葚汁是一种以桑葚为主要原料制成的饮品，具有酸甜可口的口感，富含多种维生素和矿物质，是一种健康的饮品选择。
description_en: Mulberry Juice is a beverage made primarily from mulberries, known for its sweet and sour taste, rich in vitamins and minerals, and a healthy beverage option.

name: 甘蔗汁
description: 甘蔗汁是一种以新鲜甘蔗为原料制成的饮品。它具有甘甜的自然味道，同时含有丰富的维生素和矿物质，是一种非常健康的天然饮品。
description_en: Sugarcane juice is a beverage made from fresh sugarcane. It has a naturally sweet taste and is rich in vitamins and minerals, making it a very healthy natural drink.

name: 荷叶茶
description: 荷叶茶是一种传统的植物茶，主要原料为荷叶。它有清热解暑、健脾利湿的功效。荷叶茶通常通过晒干荷叶后，泡水饮用。
description_en: Lotus Leaf Tea is a traditional herbal tea made primarily from lotus leaves. It is known for its heat-clearing, summer-relieving, and spleen-strengthening effects. The tea is typically prepared by infusing dried lotus leaves in hot water.

name: 莲子心茶
description: 莲子心茶是一道以莲子心为主要原料的茶饮，具有清心去火的功效，适合在炎热的夏季饮用，能够带来身心的平和与清凉。
description_en: Lotus Seed Heart Tea is a beverage primarily made from the heart of the lotus seed, known for its cooling and calming effects. It is an ideal drink for hot summer days, providing a sense of peace and refreshment.

name: 百合花茶
description: 百合花茶是一种以百合花为主要原料的花茶，具有清心安神的功效。
description_en: Lily Flower Tea is a type of flower tea made from lily flowers, known for its calming and soothing effects.

name: 金盏花茶
description: 金盏花茶是一种以金盏花瓣为主料的饮品，具有消炎、利尿的功效，色泽金黄，口感清新。
description_en: Calendula Tea is a beverage made from calendula petals, known for its anti-inflammatory and diuretic effects, with a golden color and a fresh taste.

name: 橘皮陈皮茶
name_en: Tangerine Peel and Dried Orange Peel Tea
description: 橘皮陈皮茶是一种传统的中国茶饮，以新鲜的橘皮和晒干的陈皮为主要原料。橘皮能润肺止咳，陈皮则可健脾和胃。
description_en: Tangerine Peel and Dried Orange Peel Tea is a traditional Chinese herbal tea made from fresh tangerine peel and dried orange peel as the main ingredients. Tangerine peel is known for moistening the lungs and relieving cough, while dried orange peel helps to strengthen the spleen and stomach.

name: 陈皮普洱
description: 陈皮普洱是一种结合了陈皮的清新果香和普洱茶的醇厚茶香的特色饮品。陈皮普洱的制作方式是将晒干的陈皮与普洱茶叶一同泡制，既能提神醒脑，又具有消脂减肥的功效。
description_en: A special beverage that combines the fresh citrus aroma of dried tangerine peel with the rich and mellow flavor of Pu'er tea. Made by infusing dried tangerine peel with Pu'er tea leaves, it is known for its invigorating effects and potential to aid in losing weight.

name: 枸杞茶
description: 枸杞茶是一种以枸杞为主要材料的传统饮品。枸杞具有滋补肝肾、益精明目的功效，常被用于泡茶或煲汤。
description_en: Goji Berry Tea is a traditional beverage primarily made from goji berries, known for their nourishing effects on the liver and kidneys, as well as their benefits for eyesight. They are often used for tea or soup.

name: 枸杞菊花茶
description: 枸杞菊花茶是一种传统的中式草本茶饮，以枸杞子和菊花为主要原料。枸杞子含有丰富的胡萝卜素和多种维生素，而菊花则具有清热降火的功效，两者合泡，不仅能滋补肝肾、明目提神，还有助于缓解眼睛疲劳。
description_en: Goji Berry and Chrysanthemum Tea is a traditional Chinese herbal beverage made primarily from goji berries and chrysanthemum flowers. Goji berries are rich in carotenoids and various vitamins, while chrysanthemum flowers are known for their heat-clearing properties. Together, they nourish the liver and kidneys, improve vision, and help relieve eye fatigue.

name: 玫瑰枸杞茶
description: 玫瑰枸杞茶是一种以玫瑰花和枸杞为主要食材的花草茶，常被用来美容养颜和滋补养生。玫瑰花带有天然的香气，能够舒缓神经，而枸杞子含有丰富的抗氧化成分，对眼睛和肝脏有保健作用。
