description: 翡翠豆腐是一道以豆腐为主料的清淡菜肴，其特点是色泽翠绿、口感嫩滑。该菜通常会使用菠菜或其它绿色蔬菜汁来增添豆腐的色泽，使其呈现出翡翠般的绿色，同时增加菜肴的营养价值。
description_en: Emerald tofu is a light dish primarily made from tofu, known for its emerald green color and tender texture. The dish often incorporates the juice of spinach or other green vegetables to enhance the tofu's color and nutritional value, giving it an appearance reminiscent of jade.

name: 炸鱼薯条
description: 炸鱼薯条是一道经典的英国菜，通常由裹粉炸制的鱼肉和炸薯条搭配而成，外酥里嫩，是英国的国民小吃。
description_en: Fish and Chips is a classic British dish, typically consisting of battered fish and chips. The fish is crispy and tender, making it a national snack in the UK.

name: 石锅拌饭
description: 石锅拌饭是一种韩国传统菜肴，将蒸好的米饭连同各种蔬菜、肉类和调料一起放入加热的石锅中，上桌时石锅内的食物还在滋滋作响，伴随着热气腾腾的视觉和听觉效果。食用前将所有调料和食材搅拌均匀，使每一口拌饭都充满丰富的味道。
description_en: Stone Pot Bibimbap is a traditional Korean dish where steamed rice along with various vegetables, meats, and seasonings are placed into a heated stone pot, sizzling upon serving with a visual and auditory effect of steaming hot food. All ingredients and seasonings are mixed well before consuming, ensuring each spoonful of the stir-fried rice is rich in flavors.

name: 香辣鸡翅
description: 香辣鸡翅是一道以鸡翅为主料，辅以辣椒、花椒等香辣调料烹饪而成的菜肴。它的口感鲜嫩多汁，香辣入味，是深受人们喜爱的家常小吃。
description_en: Spicy chicken wings are a dish made from chicken wings, seasoned with chili and Sichuan peppercorns to create a spicy flavor. The dish is tender and juicy with a spicy kick, making it a popular home-style snack.

name: 双层芝士堡
description: 双层芝士堡是一种典型的西式快餐，主要由两片面包裹着的肉饼，中间夹着融化的芝士、生菜、番茄等配料制作而成。它以丰富的口感和便利性受到许多人的喜爱。
description_en: A Double Cheese Burger is a classic Western fast food item, primarily consisting of a meat patty sandwiched between two buns with melted cheese, lettuce, tomato, and other fillings in between. It is loved by many for its rich flavor and convenience.

name: 田园蔬菜堡
description: 田园蔬菜堡是一道以新鲜蔬菜为主要食材的素食菜肴，通常包括胡萝卜、豌豆、玉米等多种蔬菜，混合面粉或土豆泥制成饼状，然后煎烤至外皮金黄酥脆。
description_en: The Garden Vegetable Patty is a vegetarian dish primarily made from fresh vegetables such as carrots, peas, and corn, mixed with flour or mashed potatoes to form a patty shape, then pan-fried until the exterior is golden and crispy.

name: 培根蛋堡
description: 培根蛋堡是一种西式快餐，以汉堡面包夹着煎制的培根和鸡蛋，搭配生菜、番茄和酱料，口感丰富，营养均衡。
description_en: Bacon and Egg Burger is a Western-style fast food, featuring a hamburger bun filled with pan-fried bacon and eggs, along with lettuce, tomatoes, and sauce, offering a rich taste and balanced nutrition.

name: 美式芝士热狗
description: 美式芝士热狗是一道简单的小吃，将热狗肠包裹在面皮中，涂上黄油后撒上芝士碎，然后在烤箱或烤架上烤制而成。成品外皮香脆，内里芝士融化，口感丰富，深受年轻人喜爱。
description_en: American Cheese-Stuffed Hotdog is a simple snack where hotdog is wrapped in a dough, coated with butter and sprinkled with cheese. It is then baked in an oven or on a grill. The finished product has a crispy crust and melted cheese inside, offering a rich texture that is popular among young people.

name: 墨西哥鸡肉卷
description: 墨西哥鸡肉卷是一道融合了墨西哥风味的快餐食品，通常由面粉或玉米饼皮包裹着烤制或煎炒的鸡肉、蔬菜和调料。
description_en: A fast food dish that combines Mexican flavors, typically wrapped in flour or corn tortillas with grilled or stir-fried chicken, vegetables and seasonings.

name: 生菜鸡肉沙拉
description: 生菜鸡肉沙拉是一道以生菜和熟鸡肉为主要食材的西式凉菜。将洗净的生菜撕成适当大小，与撕成丝的熟鸡肉混合，可以加入其他蔬菜如西红柿、黄瓜等，倒入调好的沙拉酱拌匀即可。这道菜口感清新，富含蛋白质和膳食纤维，是健康饮食的好选择。
description_en: Lettuce Chicken Salad is a Western-style cold dish with lettuce and cooked chicken as the main ingredients. Tear the washed lettuce into suitable sizes and mix it with shredded cooked chicken. You can also add other vegetables such as tomatoes, cucumbers, etc., and mix it well with the prepared salad dressing. This dish has a fresh taste, is rich in protein and dietary fiber, and is a good choice for a healthy diet.

name: 凯撒沙拉卷
description: 凯撒沙拉卷是一道以生菜、面包丁、凯撒酱和乳酪为主要食材的创意菜。将沙拉包裹在面饼中，既方便食用又增加了食物的层次感。
description_en: Caesar Salad Roll is an innovative dish made with lettuce, croutons, Caesar dressing, and cheese. The salad is wrapped in a crepe, which makes it easy to eat and adds a layer of texture to the food.

name: 薯条奶酪锅
description: 薯条奶酪锅是一道以薯条和奶酪为主要食材的美式快餐风味小吃。这道菜将炸至金黄酥脆的薯条与融化的奶酪混合在一起，口感外脆内软，香气扑鼻。通常还会搭配各种酱料，如番茄酱、辣椒酱等，增加风味。
description_en: Cheese Fries Pot is a snack dish that features fries and melted cheese. Crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, it is a popular fast-food option in American cuisine. Often served with various sauces such as ketchup and chili, it adds a burst of flavor to the mix.

name: 肉酱意面
description: 肉酱意面是一道经典的意大利面食，以长条形的意面搭配由猪肉或牛肉末、番茄酱、胡萝卜、洋葱、芹菜、大蒜等食材制成的肉酱。这道菜色泽鲜艳，味道浓郁，是许多西餐厅中非常受欢迎的主食之一。
description_en: Spaghetti Bolognese is a classic Italian pasta dish made with long spaghetti noodles served with a hearty meat sauce, which is traditionally made from minced pork or beef, tomato sauce, carrots, onions, celery, garlic and other ingredients. This dish has a vibrant color and a rich flavor, making it a popular staple in many Western restaurants.

name: 碳烤猪排堡
description: 碳烤猪排堡是一种将猪排骨经过碳烤后夹入汉堡中的美食。外层的面包通常伴有生菜、番茄、洋葱等蔬菜和特制的酱料，搭配烤得香脆的猪排，是一道颇具风味的快餐。
description_en: Grilled Pork Rib Burger is a meal where grilled pork ribs are placed inside a burger bun. The bun is typically accompanied by vegetables such as lettuce, tomatoes, onions, and special sauces, paired with the crispy grilled pork rib, making it a flavorful fast-food dish.

name: 日式炸猪排
description: 日式炸猪排是一道源自日本的菜肴，通常选用猪里脊肉，经过腌制、裹粉、油炸而成，外层金黄酥脆，内里肉质鲜嫩多汁。
description_en: Japanese Tonkatsu is a dish originating from Japan, typically made with pork loin that is marinated, breaded, and deep-fried, resulting in a golden and crispy exterior with tender and juicy meat inside.

name: 咖喱鸡块饭
description: 咖喱鸡块饭是一道以鸡肉为主料，辅以咖喱粉等调料烹制而成的菜肴，通常搭配米饭食用，味道浓郁，口感香辣。
description_en: Curry Chicken Rice is a dish made with chicken as the main ingredient, cooked with curry powder and other seasonings, usually served with rice, with a rich flavor and spicy taste.

name: 炸洋葱圈
description: 炸洋葱圈是一道采用洋葱为主要食材，通过裹粉油炸制成的小吃，外酥里嫩，色泽金黄，口感香脆，是许多西餐厅和快餐店常见的配菜或小食。
description_en: Fried Onion Rings is a snack made primarily from onions, coated and deep-fried until crispy and golden brown, with a tender texture inside. It is common in many Western restaurants and fast-food outlets as a side dish or appetizer.

name: 香辣鸡米花
description: 香辣鸡米花是一道以鸡肉为主料，通过切丁、腌制、裹粉后炸制而成的小吃。鸡肉外酥里嫩，香辣可口，是很多人喜爱的快餐食品。
description_en: Spicy Chicken Popcorn is a snack dish made from diced chicken that is marinated and coated in flour before being deep-fried until crispy. It is tender inside and spicy, making it a popular fast food choice.

name: 烤牛肉三明治
description: 烤牛肉三明治是一款以烤牛肉为特色，夹在面包中的西式快餐。牛肉经过腌制和烤制，肉质鲜嫩多汁，搭配生菜、番茄等蔬菜，再淋上适量的酱料，口感层次丰富，营养均衡。
description_en: Grilled Beef Sandwich is a western-style fast food that features grilled beef, sandwiched between slices of bread. The beef is marinated and grilled to be tender and juicy. Accompanied by lettuce, tomatoes, and other vegetables, it is topped with a suitable amount of sauce, making it rich in flavor and balanced in nutrition.

name: 芝士培根薯条
description: 芝士培根薯条是一道流行的西式快餐小吃，主要原料为薯条、芝士和培根。薯条经过油炸至金黄酥脆，撒上咸香的培根碎，最后淋上浓郁的芝士酱，口味丰富，层次分明。
description_en: Cheesy Bacon Fries is a popular Western fast-food snack, with ingredients including fries, cheese, and bacon. The fries are deep-fried until golden and crispy, sprinkled with salty bacon bits, and finally drizzled with rich cheese sauce, offering a rich and layered taste.

name: 咖喱猪排饭
description: 咖喱猪排饭是一道结合了日式炸猪排和咖喱的美味料理。外皮金黄酥脆的猪排搭配浓郁香辣的咖喱汁，营养丰富，味道鲜美，是一道非常受欢迎的亚洲美食。
description_en: Curry Pork Cutlet Rice is a delicious dish combining Japanese-style fried pork cutlet with curry sauce. The golden and crispy pork cutlet is served with rich and spicy curry, making it a popular Asian cuisine rich in nutrients and flavors.

name: 香草鸡肉卷饼
description: 香草鸡肉卷饼是一道以鸡肉和香草为主要食材的卷饼，通常搭配辣椒酱、酸奶油和新鲜蔬菜，口感丰富，适合作为前菜或小吃享用。
description_en: Herb Chicken Quesadilla is a type of quesadilla made with chicken and various herbs, typically served with salsa, sour cream, and fresh vegetables. It offers a rich and flavorful combination, making it a suitable dish for appetizers or snacks.

name: 香煎鳕鱼堡
description: 香煎鳕鱼堡是一道以鳕鱼为主要食材的西式海鲜料理。选用新鲜鳕鱼片，用盐、胡椒、香草等调料腌制后，裹上面包糠小火慢煎至两面金黄酥脆，搭配生菜、番茄等蔬菜夹入汉堡面包中，再淋上沙拉酱或千岛酱，口感鲜美、营养丰富。
description_en: Pan-Fried Cod Burger is a Western seafood dish made with cod as the main ingredient. Fresh cod fillets are marinated with salt, pepper, and herbs, then coated with breadcrumbs and pan-fried over low heat until golden and crispy on both sides. Served in a burger bun with lettuce, tomatoes, and other vegetables, topped with mayonnaise or thousand island dressing, it is delicious, nutritious, and full of flavor.

name: 油炸虾仁筒
description: 油炸虾仁筒是一道以虾仁为主要食材的海鲜美食。这道菜色泽金黄，外皮酥脆，内里虾仁鲜嫩多汁，口感层次分明。通常搭配蘸酱食用，增添风味。
description_en: Deep-Fried Shrimp Rolls is a seafood delicacy that mainly uses shrimp as the ingredient. This dish has a golden color, with a crispy outer layer and tender, juicy shrimp inside, offering a distinct texture. It is commonly served with dipping sauce to enhance its flavor.

name: 辣鸡肉香肠卷
description: 辣鸡肉香肠卷是一道将鸡肉与辣椒等香料混合后，裹入酥皮中烤制而成的小吃。外皮酥脆，内馅香辣多汁，深受辣味爱好者的喜爱。
description_en: Spicy Chicken Sausage Rolls are a snack made by mixing chicken with chili and other spices, then wrapping it in puff pastry and baking until crispy. The outer layer is crunchy, and the filling is spicy and juicy, favored by those who love spicy flavors.

name: 扒鸡胸三明治
description: 扒鸡胸三明治是一道以鸡胸肉为主要食材制作的三明治。通常将鸡胸肉用香料腌制后扒烤至熟透，夹在切片面包之间，搭配生菜、番茄、黄瓜等蔬菜，有时还会加入一些酱料，如美乃滋或烧烤酱，以增加风味。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Breast Sandwich is a sandwich primarily made with chicken breast as the main ingredient. The chicken breast is usually marinated with spices and grilled until cooked through, then placed between slices of bread with vegetables such as lettuce, tomato, and cucumber, sometimes accompanied by sauces like mayonnaise or barbecue sauce to enhance the flavor.

name: 金枪鱼三明治
description: 金枪鱼三明治是一种以金枪鱼为主料的西式快餐，通常将金枪鱼与蛋黄酱混合后涂抹在切片面包上，辅以生菜、番茄等蔬菜，有时还会加入煎蛋或奶酪增加风味。
description_en: A tuna sandwich is a type of Western fast food that uses tuna as the main ingredient, usually mixed with mayonnaise and spread on sliced bread, accompanied by vegetables like lettuce and tomatoes, and sometimes enhanced with fried eggs or cheese for added flavor.

name: 韩式部队锅
description: 韩式部队锅是一道源自韩国的火锅类美食，以多种食材混合炖煮而成，通常包括火腿、香肠、泡面、豆腐、蔬菜等，加入特制的辣酱和泡菜，味道浓郁、辣中带甜，是韩国非常受欢迎的一道菜。
description_en: Korean Army Stew is a hot pot dish originating from South Korea, cooked with a variety of ingredients such as ham, sausage, instant noodles, tofu, and vegetables. It is seasoned with a special chili sauce and kimchi, offering a rich, spicy, and slightly sweet flavor, making it a very popular dish in Korea.

name: 鳗鱼饭
description: 鳗鱼饭是一道以鳗鱼为主要食材的日式料理，将鳗鱼烤制后盖在米饭上，搭配特制的酱汁，风味独特。
description_en: Eel Rice is a Japanese dish that consists of grilled eel served over rice, accompanied by a special sauce, characterized by its unique flavor.

name: 香酥鸡腿饭
description: 香酥鸡腿饭是一道以鸡腿肉为主食材，经过腌制、裹粉和油炸后与米饭搭配的快餐料理。鸡腿外皮金黄酥脆，内部肉质鲜嫩多汁，搭配特制酱料和蔬菜，味道鲜美，营养丰富。
description_en: Crispy Fried Chicken Leg Rice is a fast-food dish that uses chicken legs as the main ingredient. The chicken legs are marinated, coated with flour, and then deep-fried. It is paired with rice and served with specially made sauces and vegetables, offering a crispy skin and tender meat, making it a delicious and nutritious meal.

name: 芝士烤马铃薯
description: 芝士烤马铃薯是一道以马铃薯为主要食材的西式风味小吃，通过将马铃薯切开后撒上芝士和其他调料，放入烤箱烤制而成。
description_en: Baked Potato with Cheese is a Western-style snack mainly made of potatoes. Potatoes are cut open, sprinkled with cheese and other seasonings, and then baked in the oven.

name: 香辣鸡肉卷
description: 香辣鸡肉卷是一道色香味俱全的小吃，以鸡肉为主要食材，辅以香辣调味料，通过卷制和炸制的方法制作而成。外皮金黄酥脆，内里鸡肉鲜嫩多汁，香辣味十足，是一道受欢迎的下酒菜和小吃。
description_en: Spicy Chicken Rolls is a snack with color, aroma, and taste. The main ingredient is chicken, complemented by spicy seasonings. It is made by rolling and frying. The outer skin is golden and crispy, and the chicken inside is tender and juicy, with a strong spicy flavor, making it a popular dish to accompany drinks and snacks.

name: 照烧鸡腿
description: 照烧鸡腿是一道日式风味的菜肴，以鸡腿肉为主材，辅以照烧酱精心烹饪而成。其特点是色泽红亮，肉质鲜嫩多汁，味道甜中带咸，风味独特。
description_en: Teriyaki Chicken Leg is a Japanese-style dish mainly made with chicken legs and seasoned with teriyaki sauce. It is known for its bright red color, tender and juicy meat, and a unique flavor that is sweet and salty.

name: 美式炸鸡桶
description: 美式炸鸡桶是一种源自美国的经典快餐，将整只鸡切块后油炸至外皮金黄酥脆，内肉鲜嫩多汁。通常搭配各种酱料食用，如番茄酱、辣椒酱等。
description_en: The American Fried Chicken Bucket is a classic American fast food dish, where whole chicken is cut into pieces and fried until the outer skin is golden and crispy, and the inner meat is tender and juicy. It is usually served with various sauces, such as tomato sauce and hot sauce.

name: 珍珠饭团
description: 珍珠饭团是一道以米饭为主要食材制作而成的传统小吃。米饭在制作过程中加入少量的糯米，使其具有粘性和弹性，然后将其搓成小圆球状，形似珍珠，因此得名。珍珠饭团可以根据个人口味添加各种馅料，如豆沙、肉松或者蔬菜等，食用时也可以蘸取酱油、辣酱等调味品。
description_en: Pearl Rice Balls is a traditional snack primarily made with rice. A small portion of glutinous rice is added during the cooking process to give it a sticky and elastic texture. The rice is then formed into small round balls resembling pearls, hence the name. Various fillings such as red bean paste, meat floss, or vegetables can be added according to personal taste, and they can be enjoyed with dipping sauces like soy sauce or chili sauce.

name: 啤酒炸鸡套餐
description: 啤酒炸鸡套餐是一种结合了香脆炸鸡和冰爽啤酒的快餐美食。炸鸡外皮金黄酥脆，肉质鲜嫩多汁，搭配啤酒的清爽口感，是朋友聚会或休闲时光的理想选择。
description_en: The Beer and Fried Chicken Combo combines crispy fried chicken with a refreshing taste and the coolness of beer. The golden and crispy skin of the chicken, with tender and juicy meat, pairs perfectly with the refreshing taste of beer, making it an ideal choice for social gatherings or leisure time.

name: 番茄牛肉堡
description: 番茄牛肉堡是一款经典的西式快餐，由新鲜番茄片、煎制到恰到好处的牛肉饼和新鲜蔬菜组成，夹在两片面包之间。牛肉饼肉质鲜嫩多汁，番茄增添酸甜口感，是一道营养均衡且快速便捷的餐点。
description_en: A classic Western fast-food dish, the Tomato Beef Burger consists of fresh tomato slices, a perfectly grilled beef patty, and fresh vegetables, all sandwiched between two slices of bread. The beef patty is tender and juicy, while the tomatoes add a tangy sweetness, making it a nutritionally balanced and quick meal option.

name: 蜂蜜芥末鸡柳
description: 蜂蜜芥末鸡柳是一道结合了蜂蜜的甜和芥末的辛辣的鸡肉料理，外层裹粉炸至金黄酥脆，内里鸡肉多汁，是一道受欢迎的小吃或主菜。
description_en: Honey Mustard Chicken Strips is a popular dish that combines the sweetness of honey with the spiciness of mustard. The chicken is coated in a crispy batter and fried until golden, resulting in a juicy and flavorful main dish or appetizer.

name: 黑椒牛肉卷饼
description: 黑椒牛肉卷饼是一道以牛肉为主料，辅以黑椒调味的风味小吃。牛肉切片后经过腌制，加入黑椒等调料，再用面皮包裹成卷，煎至金黄酥脆，口感外酥内嫩，带有浓郁的黑椒香气。
description_en: Black Pepper Beef Rolls, a savory snack, uses beef as the main ingredient and is seasoned with black pepper. The beef is sliced, marinated with black pepper and other spices, then wrapped in dough and pan-fried until golden and crispy. It features a crispy exterior with tender beef inside, exuding a rich aroma of black pepper.

name: 香烤鸡中翅
description: 香烤鸡中翅是一道以鸡中翅为主料，通过腌制和烘烤制作而成的美味佳肴。它外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩，带有独特的香气，是老少皆宜的佳肴。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Wings is a delicious dish made from chicken wings, which are marinated and then grilled. It has a crispy skin and tender meat with a unique aroma, making it a popular dish for all ages.

name: 墨西哥披萨
description: 墨西哥披萨是一种将墨西哥风味与意式披萨相结合的美食。通常在披萨饼底上撒上墨西哥风味的香料，加上肉末、豆子、洋葱、辣椒等配料，再淋上酸奶油和鳄梨酱，具有浓厚的墨西哥风情。
description_en: Mexican Pizza is a fusion of Italian pizza with Mexican flavors. It typically involves a pizza crust topped with Mexican spices, meat, beans, onions, and chili peppers, then drizzled with sour cream and guacamole, embodying a rich Mexican style.

name: 手抓饼
description: 手抓饼是一种流行于中国西北地区的传统小吃，其特点是饼皮薄而多层，口感酥脆，通常搭配各种肉类和蔬菜一起食用。手抓饼的制作过程包括将面团揉制、拉伸和煎烤，直至外皮金黄酥脆。
description_en: Hand-Pulled Pancake is a traditional snack popular in Northwest China, known for its thin and layered crispy texture. Typically served with various meats and vegetables, the pancake is made by kneading, stretching, and pan-frying the dough until it turns golden brown and crispy.

name: 芝士烤玉米
description: 芝士烤玉米是一道将新鲜玉米棒涂上奶酪后进行烤制的美食。其特点是外皮微焦，内部玉米粒香甜多汁，奶酪的浓郁与玉米的清甜相互融合，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Corn with Cheese is a dish made by spreading cheese on fresh corn cobs and grilling them. It features a slightly charred exterior with sweet and juicy corn kernels on the inside, combining the rich taste of cheese with the sweetness of the corn for a unique flavor.

name: 鸡肉卷
description: 鸡肉卷是一道以鸡肉为主要食材的创意菜式，通常将鸡肉片成薄片，包裹蔬菜或其他食材，再进行烹饪。外皮香脆，内馅鲜嫩多汁，口感丰富。
description_en: Chicken Rolls is a creative dish that mainly uses chicken as the ingredient. Typically, chicken is sliced thin and wrapped around other ingredients such as vegetables, then cooked. The exterior is crispy while the filling is juicy and tender, offering a rich texture.

name: 辣味鸡腿堡
description: 辣味鸡腿堡是一道以鸡腿肉为主要食材，搭配辣椒等调料制成的汉堡。鸡腿肉被煎至外焦里嫩，辣椒和香料的加入使得整个汉堡呈现出麻辣鲜香的口感，适合喜欢辣味的人士享用。
description_en: Spicy Chicken Burger is a dish made with chicken legs as the main ingredient, combined with chili and other spices to create a burger. The chicken legs are fried until they are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with the addition of chili and spices giving the entire burger a spicy and aromatic taste, suitable for those who enjoy spicy flavors.

name: 扭扭薯条
description: 扭扭薯条是一种流行于快餐文化中的小吃，以其独特的扭曲形状而得名。这种薯条通常由土豆制成，经过油炸至金黄酥脆，外皮略带焦香，内部保持一定的软糯口感。扭扭薯条因其形状容易沾附酱料，而成为许多食客的最爱。
description_en: Twisty Fries are a popular snack in fast-food culture, known for their distinctive twisted shape. These fries are typically made from potatoes, deep-fried until golden and crispy, with a slightly charred exterior and a soft, moist interior. Twisty Fries are a favorite among many diners because their shape easily catches sauces.

name: 薯角
description: 薯角是一种将马铃薯切成角状后，通过油炸或烘烤的方式烹饪而成的小吃。外皮酥脆，内里软糯，常搭配各种调味料食用。
description_en: Potato Wedges are a snack made by cutting potatoes into wedge shapes and then frying or baking them. They have a crispy exterior and a soft interior, often served with various seasonings.

name: 脆皮甜甜圈
description: 脆皮甜甜圈是一种经典的油炸小吃，以其酥脆的外皮和软软的内里而闻名。通常表面撒有糖粉，也可以根据个人口味添加巧克力酱或其他果酱。
description_en: Crispy Donuts is a classic fried snack known for its crunchy exterior and soft interior. Typically dusted with powdered sugar, it can also be dressed with chocolate sauce or other jams according to personal preference.

name: 炸薯饼
description: 炸薯饼是一道以土豆为主要食材，经过洗净、煮熟、捣泥、调味后，拍成饼状再油炸至金黄酥脆的传统小吃。外皮酥脆，内里软糯，色泽金黄诱人，常作为小吃或配菜食用。
description_en: Fried Potato Cakes are a traditional snack made from potatoes. After washing, boiling, mashing, and seasoning, the potatoes are patted into cake shapes and then deep-fried until golden and crispy. The outer crust is crispy while the inside is soft and glutinous, with an appealing golden color, often served as a snack or side dish.

name: BBQ烤肉披萨
description: BBQ烤肉披萨是一种将烧烤风味与披萨相结合的创意美食。它通常以小麦粉制作的披萨底为基础，上面铺满BBQ烤肉、洋葱丝、辣椒和奶酪等配料，再经过烘烤制成。
description_en: BBQ Grilled Meat Pizza is a creative cuisine that combines the flavors of barbecue with pizza. It is typically made with a wheat flour pizza base, topped with BBQ grilled meat, onion shreds, chili peppers, and cheese, then baked to perfection.

name: 虾仁辣酱
description: 虾仁辣酱是一道以新鲜虾仁为主料，辅以辣椒等调料制成，口感鲜辣滑嫩。
description_en: Shrimp with Spicy Sauce is a dish made with fresh shrimp as the main ingredient, enhanced with chili and other seasonings, offering a delicious combination of spicy and tender flavors.

name: 芝士牛肉
description: 芝士牛肉是一道以牛肉和芝士为主要食材的菜肴。牛肉切成薄片或块状，与融化的芝士混合，通常搭配面包、米饭或土豆食用，口感丰富，味道浓郁。
description_en: Cheese Beef is a dish that primarily consists of beef and cheese. The beef is cut into thin slices or chunks and mixed with melted cheese, often served with bread, rice, or potatoes, offering a rich texture and a flavorful taste.

name: 韩式五花肉
description: 韩式五花肉是一道以五花肉为主料的韩国传统菜肴，通常搭配韩国泡菜、生菜叶、辣椒酱等食用。五花肉经过腌制，使得肉质更加入味，口感嫩滑。
description_en: Korean Pork Belly is a traditional Korean dish featuring the main ingredient of pork belly. It is often served with Korean kimchi, lettuce leaves, and chili sauce. The pork belly is marinated to enhance its flavor, resulting in a tender and smooth texture.

name: 培根烤薯泥
description: 培根烤薯泥是一道将马铃薯泥与培根结合的西式小吃。首先将马铃薯蒸熟，压成泥状，然后拌入黄油、奶油等调料，铺上煎香的培根片，撒上芝士后再进行烤制，使其表面金黄并带有培根的香味。
description_en: Bacon Roasted Mashed Potatoes is a Western-style snack that combines mashed potatoes with bacon. First, the potatoes are steamed and mashed, then mixed with butter and cream to season. After that, fried bacon slices are laid on top, and the dish is sprinkled with cheese before being baked until golden brown and fragrant with the aroma of bacon.

name: 烤鸡柳沙拉
description: 这道菜由烤鸡柳搭配新鲜蔬菜组成，佐以特制沙拉酱，是一道健康且美味的轻食料理。
description_en: This dish consists of grilled chicken strips paired with fresh vegetables and dressed with a special salad dressing, making it a healthy and delicious light meal.

name: 脆皮鸡排卷
description: 脆皮鸡排卷是一道以鸡肉为主要食材的小吃，外层裹上面包糠炸至金黄酥脆，内里鸡肉鲜嫩多汁，搭配特制酱料食用，口感丰富，风味独特。
description_en: Crispy Chicken Roll is a snack dish mainly made of chicken. The outer layer is coated with breadcrumbs and fried until golden and crispy. The chicken inside is tender and juicy, and it is served with a special sauce. The taste is rich and unique.

name: 墨西哥牛肉卷
description: 墨西哥牛肉卷是一道以牛肉为主要食材的墨西哥风味菜肴。通常将牛肉切成薄片，加入辣椒、香料等调料腌制，然后用面饼包裹起来，最后烤制或煎制至牛肉熟透。成菜外皮酥脆，内馅鲜嫩多汁，口感层次丰富。
description_en: Mexican Beef Rolls is a Mexican-style dish mainly made with beef. Beef is usually sliced, marinated with chili and spices, wrapped with a pancake, and then baked or fried until the beef is cooked. The dish has a crispy skin and juicy filling, with a rich taste.

name: 辣炒年糕
description: 辣炒年糕是一道以年糕为主要食材的辣味菜肴。年糕需先切成条状，与辣椒、葱、姜等调料一同在锅中快速翻炒，直至年糕熟透且入味。
description_en: Spicy Stir-Fried Rice Cake is a spicy dish mainly made of rice cake. The rice cake is cut into strips and quickly stir-fried in a pan with chili peppers, green onions, ginger, and other seasonings until the rice cake is cooked and flavorful.

name: 洋葱圈
description: 洋葱圈是一道以洋葱为主要原料，通过切片、裹粉、油炸而成的小吃。外层金黄酥脆，内里洋葱细腻多汁，常作为餐前小吃或配菜。
description_en: Onion Rings are a dish made from onions, sliced, coated in batter, and then deep-fried. The exterior is golden and crispy, while the onion inside is tender and juicy. They are often served as appetizers or side dishes.

name: 黑胡椒牛柳
description: 黑胡椒牛柳是一道以牛肉为主要食材，辅以黑胡椒等调料制作的菜肴。鲜嫩的牛柳与黑椒的辛辣味完美融合，口感丰富，是一道广受欢迎的经典西餐。
description_en: Black Pepper Beef Fillet is a classic Western dish made from beef fillet with black pepper and other seasonings. The tender beef fillet combines perfectly with the spicy flavor of black pepper, offering a rich taste.

name: 香煎肥牛卷
description: 香煎肥牛卷是一道以优质的牛肉片为主材，配以各种蔬菜和调味料，通过快速煎制的方式烹饪而成的美味佳肴。牛肉的鲜嫩多汁与蔬菜的清脆口感相结合，外层的焦香与内里的多汁形成鲜明对比，是一道色香味俱佳的下饭好菜。
description_en: Pan-Fried Beef Rolls is a delicious dish made with high-quality beef slices, combined with various vegetables and seasonings, and cooked quickly by frying. The tender and juicy beef, along with the crispness of the vegetables, creates a delightful contrast between the slightly charred exterior and the juicy interior, making it a flavorful and satisfying dish.

name: 什锦海鲜饭
description: 什锦海鲜饭是一道以海鲜为主要食材搭配米饭烹饪而成的美食。通常包括虾、蟹肉、带子、鱿鱼等多种海味，与米饭混合烹饪，口感丰富，鲜香四溢。
description_en: Mixed Seafood Rice is a delicious dish made with a variety of seafood, including shrimp, crab meat, scallops, and squid, cooked with rice. It offers a rich taste and is full of the fresh aroma of the sea.

name: 炸蟹棒
description: 炸蟹棒是一道以蟹肉棒为主料的海鲜小吃，外皮金黄酥脆，内里肉质鲜美，常配以沙拉酱或番茄酱食用。
description_en: Fried Crab Sticks is a seafood snack mainly made of crab sticks, with golden and crispy skin and tender meat inside, often served with salad dressing or tomato sauce.

name: 奶酪鸡块
description: 奶酪鸡块是一道以鸡肉为主要食材，辅以奶酪和各种调料制作而成的小吃。鸡肉经过腌制后裹上奶酪，炸至金黄酥脆，外层奶酪浓郁，内里鸡肉鲜嫩多汁，口感丰富，深受食客喜爱。
description_en: Cheesy Chicken Nuggets is a snack dish made from chicken as the main ingredient, complemented by cheese and various seasonings. The chicken is marinated and then coated with cheese, deep-fried until golden and crispy. The outer layer is rich in cheese, while the inner part of the chicken is juicy and tender. It has a rich taste and is loved by diners.

name: 韩式炸鸡块
description: 韩式炸鸡块是一种流行于韩国的炸物小吃，以其独特的甜辣酱料和香脆口感著称。鸡肉裹上特制的面糊后进行油炸，外皮金黄酥脆，内里鸡肉鲜嫩多汁。
description_en: Korean Fried Chicken is a popular Korean snack known for its unique sweet and spicy sauce as well as its crispy texture. Chicken is coated in a special batter and then fried until the exterior is golden and crispy while the interior remains tender and juicy.

name: 土豆泥
description: 土豆泥是一种将土豆煮熟或蒸熟后压成泥状的简单食品，常作为配菜或小吃，口感细腻，营养丰富。
description_en: Mashed potatoes is a simple dish made by boiling or steaming potatoes until they are soft, then mashing them to create a smooth, nutrient-rich side dish or snack.

name: 果酱薄饼
description: 果酱薄饼是一种以面粉、鸡蛋、牛奶等为基础材料，加入果酱作为夹心的甜品。这种薄饼外皮金黄酥脆，内馅甜香软糯，常作为早餐或下午茶食用。
description_en: Jam Pancakes are a dessert made of flour, eggs, milk, and other basic ingredients with jam as the filling. These pancakes have a golden crispy exterior and a sweet and soft filling, often served as breakfast or afternoon tea.

name: 咖喱虾仁
description: 咖喱虾仁是一道以虾仁为主要食材，搭配咖喱粉等调料制作而成的特色菜肴。其色泽金黄，口感鲜美，咖喱的香辣与虾仁的鲜嫩相得益彰，是一道色香味俱佳的佳肴。
description_en: Curry Shrimp is a signature dish made with shrimp as the main ingredient, complemented by curry powder and other seasonings. It is characterized by its golden color and rich taste, where the spiciness of the curry perfectly matches the tenderness of the shrimp, making it a visually and flavorful delight.

name: 香酥猪排饭
description: 香酥猪排饭是一道经典的中华料理，以炸至金黄酥脆的猪排搭配米饭而成，外皮酥脆、内里肉质鲜嫩，是许多人喜爱的快餐选择。
description_en: Crispy Pork Chop Rice is a classic Chinese dish made by pairing deep-fried, golden, and crispy pork chops with rice. The outer skin is crisp, and the meat inside is tender, making it a popular fast-food choice for many people.

name: 香葱饼
description: 香葱饼是一道以面粉和香葱为主要原料的小吃，外皮金黄酥脆，内馅香葱味浓郁，常作为早餐或茶点食用。
description_en: Scallion Pancake is a traditional snack made from flour and scallions, featuring a golden crispy crust and a rich, savory filling. It is commonly enjoyed as a breakfast or tea-time snack.

name: 鸡丝凉面
description: 鸡丝凉面是一道以面条、鸡胸肉为主材料的传统川菜。将煮熟的面条过冷水后，加入撕成细丝的熟鸡胸肉，再配以黄瓜丝、蒜末、辣椒油、酱油等调料拌匀，口感爽滑，味道酸辣，适合夏季食用。
description_en: Chicken Shreds Cold Noodles is a traditional Sichuan dish made with noodles and chicken breast as the main ingredients. The boiled noodles are chilled in cold water, then mixed with shredded cooked chicken breast, along with cucumber shreds, minced garlic, chili oil, soy sauce, and other seasonings. It has a refreshing, smooth texture and a tangy, spicy flavor, making it ideal for summer consumption.

name: 甜辣炸鸡堡
name_en: Sweet and Spicy Fried Chicken Burger
description: 甜辣炸鸡堡是一款将炸鸡块与汉堡结合的美食，鸡肉外酥里嫩，搭配甜辣酱，风味独特。
description_en: A unique fusion of fried chicken and burgers, with crispy exterior and tender interior, paired with a sweet and spicy sauce.

name: 泡菜石锅
description: 泡菜石锅是一道以泡菜为主料的韩国传统美食，通常还会加入豆腐、猪肉片等配料，用石锅焖煮，使泡菜的酸辣味渗透到其他食材中。这道菜的味道酸辣开胃，色泽鲜艳，是韩国料理中非常受欢迎的一道菜。
description_en: Kimchi Stone Pot is a traditional Korean dish mainly made of kimchi, often accompanied by tofu and pork slices. It is stewed in a stone pot, allowing the sour and spicy taste of kimchi to permeate other ingredients. This dish is sour and spicy, appetizing, with bright colors, and is a very popular dish in Korean cuisine.

name: 五香粉
description: 五香粉是一种由五种不同香料研磨而成的调味品，通常包括八角、桂皮、丁香、小茴香和花椒。它常用于增加食物的香气和味道，适用于各种肉类和素菜的调味。
description_en: Five-Spice Powder is a spice mixture made from five different spices, typically including star anise, cinnamon, cloves, fennel seeds, and Sichuan peppercorns. It is commonly used to enhance the aroma and flavor of food, suitable for seasoning various meats and vegetarian dishes.

name: 牙签肉
description: 牙签肉是一道以肉类为主料，用牙签穿起的小串烧，通常在肉块上涂抹特制的调料后进行烤制或油炸，味道香辣可口，是一道流行的小吃。
description_en: Toothpick meat is a popular snack where meat is marinated with special seasonings and then skewered on toothpicks, either grilled or deep-fried, resulting in a spicy and delicious treat.

name: 手撕鸡
description: 手撕鸡是一道以鸡肉为主要食材的凉拌菜，特点是肉质鲜嫩，口感爽滑，通常搭配特制的酱汁和调料，口味可以是麻辣、香辣或清淡，是一道受欢迎的下酒菜。
description_en: Shredded Chicken is a popular cold dish made primarily with chicken. It is characterized by its tender and smooth texture, often served with a special sauce and seasoning. The dish can be flavored with spicy, hot, or light tastes, making it a favored accompaniment for alcoholic beverages.

name: 什锦沙拉杯
description: 什锦沙拉杯是一道色彩缤纷、营养丰富的前菜。它通常由多种蔬菜、水果和蛋白质食材混合而成，如生菜、番茄、黄瓜、煮鸡蛋、鸡胸肉或豆腐等，以满足不同的口味和营养需求。沙拉酱可以根据个人口味选择，常见的有千岛酱、油醋汁或酸奶酱。
description_en: Mixed Salad Cup is a vibrant and nutritious appetizer made from a variety of vegetables, fruits, and protein ingredients such as lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, boiled eggs, chicken breast, or tofu, catering to different tastes and nutritional needs. The dressing can be chosen based on personal preference, with common options including Thousand Island dressing, vinaigrette, or yogurt dressing.

name: 韩式泡菜
description: 韩式泡菜是一种源自韩国的传统发酵食品，以其独特的酸辣味著称。主要原料包括白菜、萝卜以及各种辣椒、大蒜和姜等调料。泡菜经过发酵后，味道鲜美，营养丰富，常作为餐前小吃或配菜食用。
description_en: Korean Kimchi is a traditional fermented food from South Korea, known for its unique sour and spicy flavor. The main ingredients include cabbage, radish, along with various seasonings such as chili, garlic, and ginger. After fermentation, the Kimchi has a delicious taste and rich nutrition, often served as an appetizer or side dish.

name: 奥尔良烤鸡
description: 奥尔良烤鸡是一道以整只鸡为主料，加入奥尔良烤鸡腌料进行腌制，再经过烤制烹饪而成的美味肉类菜肴。它色泽金黄、肉质鲜嫩多汁，深受食客喜爱。
description_en: Orleans Roast Chicken is a delicious poultry dish made from a whole chicken marinated with special Orleans seasoning and then roasted. It's known for its golden color and juicy, tender meat, favored by many diners.

name: 鸡肉意面
description: 鸡肉意面是一道将煮熟的意大利面条与炒制的鸡肉混合，通常加入奶油或番茄酱制成的主菜。
description_en: Chicken Pasta is a main dish that combines cooked Italian noodles with stir-fried chicken, often in a cream or tomato sauce.

name: 蒜香薯条
description: 蒜香薯条是一道简单的小吃，将薯条油炸至金黄酥脆后，撒上炒香的蒜末和适量的盐，使其具有浓郁的蒜香和咸香味道。
description_en: Garlic Flavored French Fries is a simple snack where the fries are deep-fried until golden and crispy, then sprinkled with sautéed minced garlic and a pinch of salt, giving it a rich garlic aroma and savory flavor.

name: 鸡米花
description: 鸡米花是一种以鸡肉为主料的小吃，通常将鸡肉切成小块，裹上面包屑后油炸至金黄酥脆，外酥里嫩，是许多人喜爱的下酒菜和零食。
description_en: Chicken Popcorn is a popular snack made from chicken, usually cut into small pieces, coated with breadcrumbs, and then deep-fried until golden and crispy. It is a favorite dish for many people to accompany drinks and as a snack.

name: 韩式年糕鸡排
description: 韩式年糕鸡排是一道融合了韩国风味和炸鸡排的经典小吃。主要食材包括鸡肉排和年糕，通常用甜辣酱调味，外酥里嫩，口感丰富。
description_en: Korean-style Rice Cake Chicken Cutlet is a classic snack that combines Korean flavors with fried chicken cutlets. Main ingredients include chicken cutlets and rice cakes, usually seasoned with sweet chili sauce, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside with a rich taste.

name: 番茄肉酱焗饭
name_en: Tomato and Meat Sauce Baked Rice
description: 番茄肉酱焗饭是一道以番茄、肉酱和米饭为主要食材的焗饭，通过将番茄肉酱与米饭混合后放入烤箱烘烤至表面金黄，口感丰富，酸甜适中。
description_en: Tomato meat sauce baked rice is a baked rice dish mainly made of tomatoes, meat sauce, and rice. It is characterized by a rich taste and a sweet and sour flavor, achieved by mixing tomato meat sauce with rice and then baking it in the oven until the surface is golden.

name: 酸辣牛肉粉
description: 酸辣牛肉粉是一道以牛肉和米粉为主要食材的菜肴。牛肉经过腌制后，与酸豆角、辣椒等调料一同烹饪，最终与烫好的米粉混合，口味酸辣鲜香，令人食欲大增。
description_en: Hot and Sour Beef Noodles is a dish that features beef and rice noodles as the main ingredients. The beef is marinated and then cooked with sour beans and chili peppers among other seasonings, and finally mixed with the boiled rice noodles. The taste is characterized by a spicy and sour flavor, which greatly stimulates the appetite.

name: 香烤薯片塔
description: 香烤薯片塔是一道以马铃薯为主要食材的创意小吃，通过将切片的马铃薯经过调味后烤制成酥脆的薯片，再层层叠加成塔状，外观独特，口感香脆，是一道适合聚会分享的小吃。
description_en: Aromatic Roasted Potato Chip Tower is a creative snack mainly made of potatoes. The thinly sliced potatoes are seasoned and roasted into crispy chips, then layered into a tower shape. It has a unique appearance and a crispy texture, making it a suitable snack to share at gatherings.

name: 明太鱼
description: 明太鱼是一种以明太鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，通常采用烤制或炖煮的方式烹饪。明太鱼肉质鲜美，富含蛋白质和不饱和脂肪酸，是非常受欢迎的海鲜之一。
description_en: Ming Tai Fish is a seafood dish that primarily features Ming Tai fish. It is commonly prepared by grilling or stewing, and is known for its delicious and tender flesh, rich in protein and healthy unsaturated fatty acids, making it a popular choice among seafood lovers.

name: 鳕鱼柳
description: 鳕鱼柳是一道以鳕鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。将鳕鱼去骨去皮后切成柳状，用盐、胡椒粉等简单调味后，煎至两面金黄即可。口感鲜嫩，营养丰富。
description_en: Cod Fillet is a seafood dish mainly made of cod. After deboning and skinning the cod, it is cut into fillets, seasoned with salt, pepper and other simple seasonings, then pan-fried until golden on both sides. The taste is tender and rich in nutrition.

name: 香草鸡肉棒
description: 香草鸡肉棒是一道以鸡肉为主要食材的创意菜，将腌制过的鸡肉和各种香草混合后串在竹签上烤制而成，外皮酥脆，内里多汁，香草的独特香气与鸡肉的鲜美完美融合，是一道色香味俱佳的佳肴。
description_en: Herb Chicken Skewers is a creative dish primarily made with chicken. The chicken is marinated with a variety of herbs and then grilled on bamboo skewers. It offers a crispy exterior and juicy interior, with the unique aroma of herbs perfectly blended with the delicacy of chicken, making it a dish that's visually appealing and delicious.

name: 黑椒牛肉堡
description: 黑椒牛肉堡是一款融合了西式快餐文化和中式烹饪技法的美食。它通常由烘烤得恰到好处的面包、鲜嫩多汁的牛肉饼、以及香辣的黑椒酱组成。牛肉饼通常经过精心调味，带有浓郁的黑椒香气，搭配新鲜生菜、番茄和洋葱，既美味又健康。
description_en: Black Pepper Beef Burger is a culinary fusion of Western fast-food culture and Chinese cooking techniques. It typically consists of a well-baked bun, a juicy beef patty, and spicy black pepper sauce. The beef patty is usually seasoned with a rich black pepper aroma, complemented by fresh lettuce, tomatoes, and onions, making it both delicious and healthy.

name: 青酱意面卷饼
description: 青酱意面卷饼是一道结合了意大利面的创意卷饼，通常使用意大利青酱（Pesto）调味的经典意面，卷入饼皮中，形成一道独特的小吃。青酱主要由罗勒、松子、蒜末、橄榄油和帕尔马奶酪制成，香味浓郁。
description_en: Pasta Pesto Wrap is a creative fusion of Italian pasta and a wrap, typically using traditional Italian pesto sauce to season the pasta, which is then rolled into a wrap. The pesto is primarily made from basil, pine nuts, garlic, olive oil, and Parmesan cheese, giving it a rich aroma.

name: 烤鸡翅
description: 烤鸡翅是一道以鸡翅为主料，通过腌制和烤制的烹饪方式制作而成，肉质鲜嫩，口感香酥，是常见的烧烤类小吃。
description_en: Grilled chicken wings are a popular barbecue snack made from chicken wings that are marinated and grilled. They are tender and have a crispy texture.

name: 火腿三明治
description: 火腿三明治是一道简单快捷的西式快餐，主要由两片面包夹着火腿片、生菜、番茄等配料制作而成。
description_en: Ham Sandwich is a simple and quick Western fast food, mainly made by sandwiching ham slices, lettuce, tomatoes, and other ingredients between two slices of bread.

name: 金枪鱼寿司
description: 金枪鱼寿司是一道以新鲜的金枪鱼肉为主要食材，搭配醋饭和海苔，通过捏制或卷制的方式制作的日本传统料理。金枪鱼的肉质紧实，口感滑嫩，搭配醋饭的酸甜味，使得整个寿司既有海鲜的鲜美，又有米饭的香醇。
description_en: Tuna Sushi is a traditional Japanese dish made with fresh tuna fish, vinegared rice, and nori. It is made by shaping or rolling the rice with tuna and other ingredients. The dense and slippery texture of the tuna, combined with the sour sweetness of the vinegared rice, gives the sushi a refreshing taste of the sea and the rich flavor of the rice.

name: 咖喱牛肉
description: 咖喱牛肉是一道以牛肉为主要食材的菜肴，通常搭配咖喱酱料烹饪而成，口感浓郁，带有独特的香气和辛辣味。
description_en: Curry Beef is a dish that primarily uses beef as the main ingredient, usually cooked with curry sauce, which has a rich taste with a unique aroma and spiciness.

name: 鳗鱼烧
description: 鳗鱼烧是一种以鳗鱼为主要食材的日式料理。鳗鱼经过腌制后，烤制至外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩多汁，常搭配特制的鳗鱼酱汁一起食用。
description_en: Eel Grill is a Japanese dish primarily made with eel. After marinating, the eel is grilled until the skin is crispy and the meat is tender and juicy, often served with a special eel sauce.

name: 鸡蛋汉堡
description: 鸡蛋汉堡是一种以鸡蛋为主要原料，加入面粉、调味料等混合后煎制的小吃。它外酥里嫩，口感丰富，是早餐或快餐的常见选择。
description_en: Egg Burger is a snack made primarily of eggs, mixed with flour and seasonings, then pan-fried. It is crispy on the outside and tender inside, making it a popular choice for breakfast or fast food.

name: 香辣鸡皮
description: 香辣鸡皮是一道以鸡皮为主要食材的小吃，通过炸制或烤制后，加入辣椒、花椒等调料进行炒制，使其外皮酥脆，内里香辣可口。
description_en: Spicy Chicken Skin is a snack dish mainly made of chicken skin, which is fried or grilled and then stir-fried with chili and Sichuan pepper, resulting in a crispy skin and a spicy flavor inside.

name: 意式千层
description: 意式千层是一种源自意大利的经典面食。它由多层宽面条、肉酱、白酱、奶酪层层叠加而成，经过烘烤至奶酪融化、表面金黄，口感丰富，味道浓郁。
description_en: Italian Lasagna is a classic pasta dish originating from Italy. It consists of layers of wide noodles, meat sauce, béchamel sauce, and cheese, baked until the cheese is melted and the top is golden brown, offering a rich texture and a strong flavor.

name: 番茄沙司
description: 番茄沙司是一种以番茄为主要原料，经过炒制、调味等工艺制成的调味品。它色泽鲜红，味道酸甜适中，常用于烹饪各种菜肴，如意大利面、披萨等。
description_en: Tomato sauce is a condiment made primarily from tomatoes, which undergoes processes such as frying and seasoning. It has a bright red color and a sweet and sour taste, making it a common ingredient in various dishes like pasta and pizza.

name: 孜然羊肉
description: 孜然羊肉是一道以羊肉为主要食材的中华传统菜肴，通常选用羊腿部肉，切成薄片或块状，用孜然、辣椒粉等调料腌制后进行炒制。此菜肴色泽金黄，肉质鲜嫩，口味香辣，是新疆维吾尔族的传统美食之一，也是许多地区流行的街头小吃。
description_en: Cumin Lamb is a traditional Chinese dish that primarily uses lamb as the main ingredient. The lamb, usually from the leg, is cut into thin slices or chunks, marinated with spices such as cumin and chili powder, and then stir-fried. This dish has a golden color, tender meat, and a spicy flavor. It is a traditional food of the Uyghur people in Xinjiang and a popular street snack in many regions.

name: 骨肉相连
description: 骨肉相连是一道以猪肉、排骨为主料的特色菜肴，通过将肉与排骨相连的方式烹饪而成，肉质鲜嫩，骨香浓郁。
description_en: Bones Connected with Meat is a specialty dish made from pork and pork ribs, cooked by connecting meat with bones, resulting in tender meat and rich bone fragrance.

name: 牛肉串
description: 牛肉串是一种将腌制过的牛肉切成小块，串在竹签或铁签上，然后经过炭火烤制的菜肴。它肉质鲜嫩，味道浓郁，是很多人喜爱的烤肉类小吃。
description_en: Beef skewers are made by cutting marinated beef into small pieces, threading them onto bamboo or metal skewers, and then grilling them over charcoal. These skewers are tender, flavorful, and a popular barbecue snack for many people.

name: 秘制烤鸡翅
description: 秘制烤鸡翅是一道以鸡翅为主料，通过腌制和烤制相结合的烹饪方式制作而成的美食。其色泽金黄，外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩多汁，味道浓郁，带有独特的香辣味。
description_en: Secret Recipe Grilled Chicken Wings is a dish mainly made of chicken wings, prepared by marinating and grilling. It has a golden color, crispy skin, juicy meat, rich flavor, and a unique spicy taste.

name: 烤鸡心
description: 烤鸡心是一道以鸡心为主料的烧烤菜式，通常经过腌制后用火烤制，口感鲜香、肉质细嫩。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Hearts is a barbecue dish made from chicken hearts, usually marinated before being grilled to achieve a fragrant and tender texture.

name: 烤鸡胗
description: 烤鸡胗是一道以鸡胗为主料的烧烤类小吃，口感香脆，味道鲜美，是下酒的好菜。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Gizzard is a barbecue snack dish mainly made of chicken gizzards, featuring a crispy texture and a delicious taste, making it a great dish to accompany alcohol.

name: 烤翅尖
description: 烤翅尖是一道以鸡翅尖为主料的小吃，通过烹饪使鸡翅尖外皮焦脆，内里肉质鲜嫩，常伴有香辣味。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Wings Tips is a snack dish mainly made from chicken wing tips. The cooking process results in crispy skin and tender meat, often seasoned with a spicy flavor.

name: 烤五花肉
description: 烤五花肉是一道以五花肉为主要食材，经过腌制、烤制等步骤制作而成的菜肴。五花肉肥而不腻，烤制后外表金黄，香气四溢，搭配特制的酱料食用，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Pork Belly is a dish made from pork belly that has been marinated and grilled. It is known for its fatty yet tender texture and golden color. Served with special sauces, this dish offers a distinctive flavor.

name: 烤牛板筋
description: 烤牛板筋是一道以牛板筋为主要食材的烧烤类菜肴。它经过特殊的腌制方法，再通过炭火烤至外焦里嫩，口感弹牙且富有嚼劲，是很多人喜爱的下酒菜或休闲小吃。
description_en: Grilled Beef Tendon is a barbecue dish made primarily with beef tendons. It is specially marinated and then grilled over charcoal until it is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, offering a chewy and elastic texture, making it a popular dish for drinking or as a leisure snack.

name: 香辣烤排骨
description: 香辣烤排骨是一道以排骨为主要食材，辅以香辣调料制作的美味佳肴。这道菜色泽红亮，口感鲜嫩多汁，香辣味十足，是很多人喜爱的下酒菜。
description_en: Spicy Roasted Ribs is a delicious dish made with pork ribs as the main ingredient, complemented by spicy seasonings. This dish features a bright red color, tender and juicy texture, and a full-bodied spicy flavor, making it a popular dish for enjoying with drinks.

name: 蒜香烤猪蹄
description: 蒜香烤猪蹄是一道以猪蹄为主要食材的菜肴，通过烤制的方式烹饪而成，蒜香浓郁，肉质鲜嫩，口感Q弹，是很多人喜爱的下酒菜。
description_en: Garlic Roasted Pig's Feet is a dish mainly made of pig's feet, cooked by roasting. It has a rich garlic flavor, tender and chewy texture, and is a popular dish for drinking.

name: 烤五花肉
description: 烤五花肉是一道常见的烤肉类菜肴，选用肥瘦相间的五花肉作为原料，通过腌制和烤制的方式使其外皮酥脆，内部多汁，风味独特，是许多烤肉爱好者的必点美食之一。
description_en: Grilled pork belly is a popular grilled meat dish made with pork belly that is well-marbled with fat and lean meat. The dish is seasoned and grilled to achieve a crispy exterior while retaining juicy insides, offering a distinctive flavor that is a favorite among many barbecue enthusiasts.

name: 香辣烤羊排
description: 香辣烤羊排是一道以羊肉为主要食材的烤制菜肴，通常选用羊排作为主料，辅以辣椒、孜然等香料进行腌制后烤制。其特点是外焦里嫩，肉质鲜美，香辣可口。
description_en: Spicy Roasted Lamb Chops is a grilled dish mainly made of lamb. Typically, lamb chops are marinated with spices like chili and cumin before being roasted. It is characterized by its crispy exterior and tender interior, with a spicy and delicious flavor.

name: 烤羊腿
description: 烤羊腿是一道以羊腿为主料，加入各种香料和调味料，经过腌制和慢火烤制而成的菜肴。外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩多汁，是冬季温暖身体的美味佳肴。
description_en: Roasted Lamb Leg is a dish made from lamb legs marinated with various spices and condiments, then slowly roasted to perfection. It's characterized by crispy skin and tender, juicy meat, making it a delicious and warming dish for the winter season.

name: 黑椒烤牛排
description: 黑椒烤牛排是一道以牛肉为主要食材，辅以黑椒、蒜等调料，经过腌制和烤制而成的西餐或中西合璧的主食。牛肉富含蛋白质和多种氨基酸，搭配黑椒的独特香味，使这道菜滋味浓郁，肉质鲜嫩多汁。
description_en: Grilled Steak with Black Pepper is a dish primarily made with beef as the main ingredient, seasoned with black pepper, garlic, and other condiments, marinated and then grilled to perfection. It is a fusion of Western and Chinese cuisine and a staple food. Beef is rich in protein and essential amino acids, which, when paired with the distinctive aroma of black pepper, results in a rich flavor and juicy, tender meat.

name: 烤羊蝎子
description: 烤羊蝎子是一道以羊蝎子（羊脊骨）为主要食材的烧烤类菜肴，肉质鲜嫩，口感丰富，带有独特的羊肉香味。
description_en: Grilled Lamb Spine is a barbecue dish mainly made from lamb spine, known for its tender meat and rich flavor, featuring the unique aroma of mutton.

name: 烤三文鱼
description: 烤三文鱼是一道以三文鱼为主要食材，通过烤制的方式烹饪而成的海鲜菜肴。这道菜通常色彩鲜艳，鱼肉鲜嫩多汁，搭配柠檬或香草等调料，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Salmon is a seafood dish primarily made with salmon, cooked by grilling. This dish is often vibrant in color and tender in texture, paired with lemon or herbs for a unique flavor.

name: 烤秋刀鱼
description: 烤秋刀鱼是一道以秋刀鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜品，将秋刀鱼去内脏后，用特制酱料腌制，再放在烤架上烤至两面金黄，外皮微焦，内肉鲜嫩多汁，带有独特的香气。
description_en: Grilled sardines is a seafood dish that uses sardines as the main ingredient. After cleaning the sardines, they are marinated with special sauces and then grilled on a grill until golden brown on both sides, with slightly crispy skin and tender, juicy flesh, full of unique aroma.

name: 烤鳗鱼
description: 烤鳗鱼是一道美味的海鲜料理，通常选用海鳗为主料，经过腌制后放在炭火上烤制，味道鲜美，肉质细嫩。
description_en: Grilled Eel is a delicious seafood dish, usually made with sea eel as the main ingredient. It is marinated and then grilled over charcoal, resulting in a tasty, tender meat texture.

name: 烤黄鱼
description: 烤黄鱼是一道以黄鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜肴，通过烤制的方法烹饪而成，肉质鲜嫩，外皮焦香，常配以各种调料提升风味。
description_en: Grilled Yellow Croaker is a seafood dish primarily made with yellow croaker. It is cooked by grilling which results in tender flesh and a slightly charred skin, often enhanced with various seasonings.

name: 烤虾串
description: 烤虾串是一道将新鲜大虾穿成串后，经过腌制再烤制而成的海鲜类小吃。通常搭配特制的酱料食用，口感鲜美，肉质紧实，是颇受欢迎的烧烤类食品之一。
description_en: Grilled Shrimp Skewers is a seafood snack made by threading fresh shrimp onto skewers, marinating, and then grilling. It is usually served with a special sauce, offering a delicious taste and firm texture, making it a popular choice among barbecue lovers.

name: 烤鱿鱼须
description: 烤鱿鱼须是一种以鱿鱼须为主料的海鲜烧烤菜品，通常搭配特制的烧烤酱料一起食用，口感鲜美，肉质有弹性。
description_en: Grilled Squid Tentacles is a seafood dish mainly made of squid tentacles, typically served with special barbecue sauce. It has a delicious taste and a chewy texture.

name: 烤扇贝
description: 烤扇贝是一道海鲜烧烤菜品，主要原料是新鲜扇贝，经过精心腌制后，在炭火上烤制而成。扇贝肉质鲜美，口感细腻，搭配蒜蓉等调料，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Scallops is a seafood barbecue dish, primarily made from fresh scallops that are meticulously marinated and grilled over charcoal. The scallops are tender and have a delicate texture, enhanced with flavors like garlic, creating a distinctive taste.

name: 烤生蚝
description: 烤生蚝是一道将新鲜生蚝经过高温烧烤而成的海鲜类美食，通常搭配蒜末、辣椒等调料，味道鲜美，肉质嫩滑。
description_en: Grilled oysters are a seafood dish made by grilling fresh oysters at high temperatures, usually seasoned with minced garlic and chili, offering a delicious taste and tender texture.

name: 烤皮皮虾
description: 烤皮皮虾是一道以皮皮虾为主料的海鲜烧烤菜肴。通过高温烧烤的方式，使皮皮虾外壳酥脆，肉质紧实，搭配上特制的调料，味道鲜美。
description_en: Grilled Mantis Shrimp is a seafood dish that uses mantis shrimp as the main ingredient. By grilling at high temperatures, the shrimp's shell becomes crispy, and the meat is firm. It is paired with special seasonings to create a delicious taste.

name: 烤海螺
description: 烤海螺是一道以新鲜海螺为主料，通过炭火烤制的方式烹饪而成的海鲜菜肴。其肉质鲜美，口感细腻，带有炭火的烟熏香气。通常搭配特制酱料食用，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Conch is a seafood dish made primarily from fresh conch meat, cooked by grilling over charcoal. The texture is tender and the flavor is exquisite, with a smoky aroma from the grill. It is often served with a special sauce for a distinct taste.

name: 孜然
description: 孜然是一种常用的调味品，以其独特的香气和微辣味道而闻名。它在中国西北地区的烹饪中尤为常见，常用于烧烤和炖菜中以提升食物的风味。
description_en: Cumin is a popular spice known for its distinctive aroma and slightly spicy taste. It is especially common in the cuisine of northwest China, where it is used in barbecue and stews to enhance the flavor of dishes.

name: 烤竹节虾
description: 烤竹节虾是一道以竹节虾为主料的海鲜菜肴，通过高温烤制的方式烹饪而成，保留了虾肉的鲜美和营养，外皮酥脆，内里肉质细腻，口感丰富。
description_en: Grilled Bamboo Prawn is a seafood dish made from bamboo shrimp, cooked by high-temperature grilling to preserve the freshness and nutrition of the shrimp meat, with a crispy exterior and tender, delicate texture inside, offering a rich taste.

name: 烤小黄鱼
description: 烤小黄鱼是一道以小黄鱼为主料的海鲜菜肴，通过炭火或烤箱高温烤制，外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩，常配以柠檬汁增加风味。
description_en: Grilled Small Yellow Croaker is a seafood dish made with small yellow croaker as the main ingredient. It is grilled over charcoal or in an oven at high temperatures to achieve a crispy skin and tender meat, often served with lemon juice for added flavor.

name: 烤鲳鱼
description: 烤鲳鱼是一道以鲳鱼为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。鲳鱼经过腌制后，放在烤架上烤制，外皮酥脆，鱼肉鲜嫩多汁，是烧烤或家宴上的常见美食。
description_en: Grilled Pomfret is a seafood dish primarily made with pomfret. After marinating, the pomfret is grilled on a rack, resulting in a crispy skin and tender, juicy flesh, making it a common delicacy at barbecues or family gatherings.

name: 烤花甲
description: 烤花甲是一道以新鲜花甲为主要食材，通过烧烤的方式烹饪而成的海鲜类菜品。其特点是肉质鲜美，口感鲜嫩多汁，烧烤过程中加入的香料使得花甲的味道更加丰富，是一道非常受欢迎的海鲜小吃。
description_en: Grilled Scallops is a seafood dish that uses fresh scallops as the main ingredient. It is prepared by grilling, which gives the scallops a tender texture and a succulent flavor. The spices added during the grilling process enhance the taste, making it a popular seafood snack.

name: 烤海鲜
description: 烤海鲜是一道以各类海鲜为主要食材，通过烤制方式烹饪而成的美食。常见的海鲜包括虾、鱼、贝类等，经过腌制后，置于炭火上烤制，外焦里嫩，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Seafood is a delicacy made primarily from various types of seafood, cooked using the grilling method. Common seafoods include shrimp, fish, shellfish, etc. After being marinated, they are grilled over charcoal fire, resulting in a dish with a crispy exterior and tender interior, offering a unique flavor.

name: 烤韭菜
description: 烤韭菜是一道以韭菜为主要食材的素食烧烤类小吃。它通过将新鲜韭菜洗净后撒上调料，放在烤架上烤制而成，具有独特的香味和口感。
description_en: Grilled Chinese Chives is a vegetarian grilled snack mainly made with Chinese chives. After washing the fresh chives, season them and grill them on a barbecue rack to achieve a unique aroma and texture.

name: 烤金针菇
description: 烤金针菇是一道以金针菇为主料，通过烤制烹饪方式制作而成的小吃类菜肴。金针菇在烤制过程中会吸收调料的香味，口感嫩滑，味道鲜美。
description_en: Grilled Enoki Mushrooms is a snack dish made from the main ingredient enoki mushrooms, which are grilled to achieve a tender and flavorful texture, enhanced by the aromatic seasoning.

name: 烤香菇
description: 烤香菇是一道以新鲜香菇为主料，经过腌制后烤制而成的素食菜肴，口感鲜美，香气浓郁，营养丰富。
description_en: Grilled Shiitake Mushrooms is a vegetarian dish made from fresh shiitake mushrooms, marinated and then grilled to perfection, offering a rich taste and aroma.

name: 烤茄子
description: 烤茄子是一道以茄子为主要食材的家常菜，通过烧烤的方式使茄子肉质软糯，搭配特制的调料，味道鲜美，深受食客喜爱。
description_en: Grilled eggplant is a home-cooked dish that uses eggplant as the main ingredient. The eggplant is grilled to achieve a soft texture and is seasoned with special condiments, resulting in a delicious taste that is favored by diners.

name: 烤土豆片
description: 烤土豆片是一道简单的家常菜，由土豆切片后烤制而成，口感香脆，是很不错的小吃选择。
description_en: Grilled Potato Slices is a simple home-cooked dish made from sliced potatoes, grilled to a crispy texture, making it a great choice for a snack.

name: 烤玉米
description: 烤玉米是将新鲜的玉米棒经过炭火或者烤箱烤制，使其带有独特的烟熏香味。烤制过程中，玉米粒会变得更加香甜，外皮焦脆，内里软糯，通常还会撒上一些调味料，如盐、辣椒粉或者香草等，增加风味。
description_en: Grilled corn is a dish in which fresh corn cobs are grilled over charcoal or in an oven, giving them a unique smoky flavor. The corn kernels become sweeter and the exterior becomes slightly crispy while the inside remains soft and chewy. Seasonings such as salt, chili powder, or herbs can be sprinkled on top to enhance the taste.

name: 烤山药片
description: 烤山药片是一道以山药为主要食材，通过烘烤方式制作的小吃。山药切片后，撒上适量的盐和香料，放入烤箱中烤制至外脆内软，香味四溢。
description_en: Roasted Yam Slices is a snack dish primarily made with yam, seasoned with salt and spices, and baked until crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, releasing a fragrant aroma.

name: 烤地瓜
description: 烤地瓜是一道以地瓜为主料的简单小吃，通过慢火烘烤至软熟，外皮微焦，内里香甜绵软，是街头常见的一种受欢迎小吃。
description_en: Roasted Sweet Potato is a simple snack made from sweet potatoes, slow-roasted until tender with a slightly charred skin and sweet, soft interior, commonly found as a popular street snack.

name: 烤甜椒
description: 烤甜椒是一道简单的素食菜，将甜椒剖开后放在烤箱或炭火上烤制，直至外皮焦黑，内里软化，食用时去皮去籽，可搭配橄榄油、盐和胡椒等简单调料。
description_en: Grilled Bell Peppers is a simple vegetarian dish where bell peppers are halved and roasted on an oven or charcoal until the skin is charred and the flesh is softened. They are served after removing the skin and seeds, often seasoned with simple condiments such as olive oil, salt, and pepper.

name: 烤青椒
description: 烤青椒是一道简单的家常菜，将新鲜的青椒洗净后直接放在炭火上烤，烤至外皮变黑，内部变软，然后撕去外皮，搭配蘸料食用。
description_en: Grilled Green Peppers is a simple home-cooked dish, where fresh green peppers are washed and grilled directly over charcoal until the skin turns black and the inside becomes tender. The skin is then removed, and the peppers are served with dipping sauces.

name: 烤蒜蓉茄子
description: 烤蒜蓉茄子是一道以茄子为主要食材，通过烧烤的方式，加入大量蒜蓉进行烹饪的菜肴。茄子经过烤制后，软糯入味，蒜蓉的香味充分渗透其中，使得整道菜肴香气扑鼻，口感丰富。
description_en: Grilled eggplant with garlic is a dish primarily made of eggplant, grilled with a generous amount of minced garlic. After grilling, the eggplant becomes tender and flavorful, with the aroma of garlic penetrating through, making the dish fragrant and rich in taste.

name: 烤莲藕片
description: 烤莲藕片是一道以莲藕为主要食材的素食菜肴，通过切片后进行烤制，保留了莲藕的清脆口感，同时带有独特的香气。
description_en: Grilled Lotus Root Slices is a vegetarian dish that uses lotus root as the main ingredient. The slices are grilled to maintain the crisp texture of the lotus root while imparting a unique aroma.

name: 烤培根卷金针菇
description: 烤培根卷金针菇是一道将金针菇用培根卷起来后烤制而成的菜品，金针菇的清脆与培根的香脆口感相结合，适合作为小吃或前菜。
description_en: Bacon-Wrapped Enoki Mushrooms is a dish where enoki mushrooms are wrapped in bacon and then grilled. The dish combines the crisp texture of enoki with the savory crunch of bacon, making it suitable for appetizers or snacks.

name: 烤鸡蛋
description: 烤鸡蛋是一种将鸡蛋以烘烤方式烹饪而成的小吃，通常搭配各种食材如蔬菜、肉类或奶酪一起烤制，口感丰富，营养丰富。
description_en: Baked Eggs is a snack dish that involves baking eggs with various ingredients such as vegetables, meats, or cheese, offering a rich and nutritious taste.

name: 烤鹌鹑蛋
description: 烤鹌鹑蛋是一道简单的小吃，通常将鹌鹑蛋煮熟后剥壳，再通过烧烤或者烤箱加热至外皮微焦，食用时经常撒上椒盐等调料，口感香脆，味道鲜美。
description_en: Roasted Quail Eggs is a simple snack dish where quail eggs are boiled, peeled, and then roasted or baked until the outer skin is slightly charred. Seasonings like salt and pepper are often sprinkled on top, adding a crispy texture and a delicious flavor.

name: 烤豆皮
description: 烤豆皮是一道以豆皮为主要食材，通过烘烤而成的素食小吃。它通常需要先将豆皮浸泡、沥干后，再刷上一层调味汁，撒上适量的调味料，然后放入烤箱烤制，直至表面金黄酥脆。烤豆皮口感香脆，富含蛋白质，是适合素食者的美食。
description_en: Grilled Tofu Skin is a vegetarian snack dish that uses tofu skin as the main ingredient and is baked to achieve a crispy texture. Typically, the tofu skin is soaked, drained, brushed with a seasoning sauce, sprinkled with seasonings, and then baked in the oven until golden and crispy. It has a crunchy texture and is rich in protein, making it a great dish for vegetarians.

name: 烤方便面
description: 烤方便面是一种创新的小吃，将通常需要煮食的方便面以烤制的方式进行烹饪。这种做法通常需要将方便面先煮软，然后加入调料和配料，如蔬菜、肉类等，之后放入烤箱中烤制至金黄酥脆。
description_en: Baked Instant Noodles is an innovative snack that cooks instant noodles, which are usually boiled, by baking. This method typically involves boiling the noodles until soft, then adding seasonings and ingredients such as vegetables and meats, and finally baking them in the oven until golden and crispy.

name: 烤年糕
description: 烤年糕是一种传统的中式小吃，主要以糯米粉为主要原料制成，外皮烤至金黄酥脆，内里软糯香甜。通常在节日如春节时享用，寓意着年年高升。
description_en: Grilled Rice Cake is a traditional Chinese snack made primarily from glutinous rice flour. It is grilled to a golden brown and crispy on the outside while remaining soft and sweet on the inside. It is commonly enjoyed during festivals such as the Spring Festival, symbolizing prosperity and progress.

name: 烤豆腐
description: 烤豆腐是一道以豆腐为主要食材的菜肴，将豆腐切片后在烤盘上烤制，可搭配各种佐料如辣椒粉、孜然粉等，使其外焦里嫩，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Tofu is a dish that uses tofu as the main ingredient, sliced and grilled on a baking tray, often seasoned with various condiments such as chili powder and cumin, resulting in a crispy exterior and tender interior with a distinctive flavor.

name: 烤冻豆腐
description: 烤冻豆腐是一道以冻豆腐为主要食材的菜肴，经过冷冻后豆腐内部形成蜂窝状结构，烤制时能够吸收更多的调味料，使得豆腐外皮香脆，内里多汁且富有弹性。这道菜品通常辅以蔬菜和特制酱汁，口味独特，是一道适合于素食者的美味佳肴。
description_en: Grilled Frozen Tofu is a dish primarily made with frozen tofu. After freezing, the tofu develops a honeycomb-like structure inside, which allows it to absorb more seasonings when grilled, leading to a crispy skin and a juicy, elastic interior. This dish is often accompanied by vegetables and a special sauce, offering a unique taste and is a delicious option for vegetarians.

name: 烤馒头片
description: 烤馒头片是一道简单的家常小吃，将普通的馒头切成片，然后涂上蛋液，放入烤箱或平底锅中烤至金黄色。外皮酥脆，内里松软，适合作为早餐或小吃食用。
description_en: Grilled Mantou Slices is a simple home-style snack, where regular mantou (Chinese steamed bread) is sliced, coated with egg wash, and then grilled in an oven or pan until golden brown. The exterior is crispy while the inside remains soft, making it suitable for breakfast or as a snack.

name: 烤火腿肠
description: 烤火腿肠是一种以火腿肠为主料的小吃，通过烤制的方式烹调，使其外皮酥脆、内里多汁，风味独特。
description_en: Grilled Ham Sausage is a snack dish made from ham sausage as the main ingredient. It is cooked by grilling, resulting in a crispy exterior and juicy interior, with a distinctive flavor.

name: 烤奶酪片
description: 烤奶酪片是一种简单的西式小吃，通常由两片面包夹着奶酪，然后烤至奶酪融化，面包变得酥脆。这道菜品在欧美国家非常流行，尤其在寒冷的天气中，可以作为快速便捷的热食。
description_en: Grilled cheese slice is a simple Western snack, typically made from two slices of bread with cheese in between, grilled until the cheese is melted and the bread is crispy. This dish is popular in European and American countries, especially in cold weather, making it a quick and convenient hot meal.

name: 烤芝士年糕
description: 烤芝士年糕是一道将传统的糯米年糕与西式的奶酪相结合的独特小吃。年糕外层烤至微焦，内里软糯且充满芝士的浓郁奶香，口感层次丰富，是一道既有传统风味又不失创新的美食。
description_en: Grilled Cheese Rice Cake is a unique snack that combines traditional glutinous rice cake with Western-style cheese. The exterior is grilled to a slightly charred crisp, while the inside remains soft and glutinous, filled with the rich, creamy flavor of cheese. This dish offers a rich texture and is a culinary delight that maintains traditional flavors with a touch of innovation.

name: 烤蘑菇
description: 烤蘑菇是一道以新鲜蘑菇为主料，经过烤箱烤制的美味佳肴。蘑菇在高温下烤制后，水分略微蒸发，使得蘑菇的口感更加鲜美，同时保留了蘑菇原有的营养成分。
description_en: Grilled mushrooms is a delicious dish made from fresh mushrooms, grilled in an oven. The slight evaporation of moisture under high temperatures enhances the taste of mushrooms, while retaining their original nutritional components.

name: 烤油豆泡
description: 烤油豆泡是一道以油豆泡为主料，通过烤制的方式烹饪而成的小吃。油豆泡经过烤制后外皮金黄酥脆，内里软嫩多汁，口感层次丰富。
description_en: Roasted Tofu Puff is a snack dish made from tofu puffs, which are roasted to achieve a crispy exterior and tender interior, offering a rich texture and flavor.

name: 烤青笋
description: 烤青笋是一道以新鲜青笋为主料的烧烤类菜肴，通常经过简单的调味后烤制，保留了青笋的清脆口感和营养成分。
description_en: Grilled Asparagus is a grilled dish made with fresh asparagus as the main ingredient. It is typically seasoned simply and grilled to retain the crisp texture and nutritional value of asparagus.

name: 烤麻辣小土豆
description: 烤麻辣小土豆是一道以小土豆为主要食材，通过烤制的方式烹饪而成，辅以麻辣调料增加风味的小吃。这道菜品外皮酥脆，内部软糯，带有浓郁的麻辣味，是下酒或作为休闲小吃的不错选择。
description_en: Spicy Grilled Baby Potatoes is a dish made from baby potatoes which are cooked by grilling method, seasoned with spicy and numbing flavors. The dish has a crispy skin and a soft interior, with a rich spicy taste, making it a good choice for accompanying drinks or as a leisure snack.

name: 烤油条条
description: 烤油条条是一种将传统的油条通过烘烤的方式进行烹饪，使其外皮酥脆，内里柔软，带有独特的烘烤香气。
description_en: Grilled Fried Dough Sticks is a dish where the traditional deep-fried breakfast item, known as 'youtiao', is grilled to achieve a crispy exterior and a soft interior, with a distinctive grilled aroma.

name: 烤泡饼
description: 烤泡饼是一种独特的中式面点，外皮酥脆，内里柔软，常作为早餐或小吃食用。
description_en: Baked Bubble Pancake is a unique Chinese pastry with a crispy exterior and a soft interior, often served as a breakfast or snack.

name: 烤虎皮尖椒
description: 烤虎皮尖椒是一道以尖椒为主要食材，通过烤制至表皮起皱形成类似虎皮的纹理而得名。这道菜外皮微焦，内部肉质鲜嫩多汁，香辣可口，是很多人喜爱的下饭菜。
description_en: Grilled Tiger Skin Peppers is a dish primarily made with chili peppers, which are grilled until the skin wrinkles, resembling the texture of a tiger's skin. This dish has a slightly charred exterior with tender and juicy flesh inside, offering a spicy and delicious flavor that is loved by many as a side dish.

name: 烤凤爪
description: 烤凤爪是一道以鸡爪为主要食材，经过腌制、烧烤等工艺制作的风味小吃。它皮脆肉嫩，味道鲜美，是烧烤中受欢迎的下酒菜之一。
description_en: Roasted Chicken Feet is a popular snack dish made from chicken feet, marinated and grilled to achieve a crispy skin and tender meat, offering a delightful flavor and is a favored accompaniment to alcoholic beverages in barbecue settings.

name: 烤鸡爪
description: 烤鸡爪是一道以鸡爪为主料的小吃，通过腌制后烤制而成，口感酥软，味道香浓，是烧烤中比较受欢迎的一种小吃。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Feet is a popular snack made from chicken feet marinated and then grilled, with a soft texture and rich flavor, it is a favorite among barbecue lovers.

name: 烤牛肋排
description: 烤牛肋排是一种经典的西式烤肉，选用优质的牛肋排肉，经过腌制和慢烤，肉质鲜嫩多汁，外焦里嫩，香气四溢。通常搭配蔬菜和酱料一起食用。
description_en: Grilled Beef Ribs is a classic Western grilled meat dish, using high-quality beef rib meat, marinated and slow-roasted, with tender and juicy meat, crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, full of aroma. It is usually served with vegetables and sauces.

name: 烤牛仔骨
description: 烤牛仔骨是一道以牛仔骨为主要食材的烤肉菜式，其肉质鲜嫩多汁，口感丰富。牛仔骨经过腌制后，放入烤箱或炭火上烤制，外焦里嫩，是许多人喜爱的一道硬菜。
description_en: Grilled Beef Short Ribs is a barbecue dish that uses beef short ribs as the main ingredient, known for its tender and juicy meat with a rich flavor. After marinating, the ribs are grilled to achieve a crispy exterior and tender interior, making it a popular hearty dish for many.

name: 烤鸭胸
description: 烤鸭胸是一道经典的中国菜，采用鸭胸肉为主料，经过腌制、烤制等步骤烹饪而成，外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩多汁。
description_en: Roasted Duck Breast is a classic Chinese dish, made from duck breast meat. It is marinated and roasted until the skin is crispy and the meat is tender and juicy.

name: 蜜汁烤翅
description: 蜜汁烤翅是一道以鸡翅为主料，加入蜂蜜和各种调料腌制后烤制而成的美味佳肴。这道菜色泽金黄，外皮酥脆，内里鲜嫩多汁，甜中带咸，风味独特。
description_en: Honey Glazed Chicken Wings is a delicious dish made from chicken wings marinated with honey and various seasonings, then baked until golden brown and crisp on the outside with tender, juicy meat inside. It is characterized by its sweet and savory flavor.

name: 烤羊排
description: 烤羊排是一道以羊肋排为主料，佐以各种香料和调味品，通过高温烤制而成的美味佳肴。外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩多汁，是肉食爱好者的不二之选。
description_en: Roasted Lamb Chops is a delicious dish made from lamb ribs, seasoned with various spices and condiments, and baked at high temperature. The skin is crispy, and the meat is tender and juicy, making it a perfect choice for meat lovers.

name: 烤鸡软骨
description: 烤鸡软骨是一道以鸡软骨为主要食材的美味小吃。经过腌制和烤制，鸡软骨外焦里嫩，口感爽脆，是一道受欢迎的下酒菜。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Cartilage is a delicious snack dish made mainly from chicken cartilage. After marinating and grilling, the chicken cartilage is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a delightful crunchy texture, making it a popular dish to accompany drinks.

name: 烤鹌鹑
description: 烤鹌鹑是一道以鹌鹑为主料的烧烤类菜品，肉质细嫩，滋味鲜美，富含蛋白质和多种微量元素。
description_en: Grilled Quail is a barbecue dish made from quails. It is tender and savory, rich in protein and various trace elements.

name: 烤羊腰
description: 烤羊腰是一道以新鲜羊腰为主料的烧烤类菜式，通过烧烤的方式使羊腰表面焦脆，内里鲜嫩，搭配特制的调料，风味独特，营养丰富。
description_en: Roasted Lamb Kidney is a barbecue dish that uses fresh lamb kidneys as the main ingredient. Grilling makes the surface of the kidneys crispy while keeping the inside tender. It is distinctively flavored with special seasonings and is both nutritious and delicious.

name: 烤羊宝
description: 烤羊宝是一道以羊肾为主要食材的菜肴，通过炭火烤制的方式烹饪而成，口感外焦里嫩，味道鲜美。
description_en: Grilled Lamb Kidney is a dish that uses lamb kidney as the main ingredient. It is cooked by grilling over charcoal, resulting in a crispy outside and tender inside, with a delicious flavor.

name: 烤羊尾
description: 烤羊尾是一道以羊尾为主要食材的传统清真菜肴，其特点是外皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩，香气浓郁。在烹饪过程中，羊尾经过特殊腌制，再经过慢火烤制，使其表面形成一层美味的焦脆层，而内部保持多汁和嫩滑。
description_en: Grilled Mutton Tail is a traditional halal dish that features the tail of a lamb as the main ingredient. It is characterized by its crispy skin and tender meat, which carries a rich aroma. The dish undergoes special marination before being slow-roasted, resulting in a deliciously crispy layer on the surface while maintaining a juicy and tender interior.

name: 酱香烤肋排
description: 酱香烤肋排是一道以猪肋排为主料，通过腌制后烤制的美味菜肴，表面涂抹特制的酱料，使其色泽金黄，外焦里嫩，味道浓郁，带有独特的酱香风味。
description_en: Sauce-Flavored Roasted Ribs is a delicious dish made from pork ribs, marinated and then roasted. The ribs are coated with a special sauce that gives them a golden color and a crispy exterior with a tender interior. The dish is rich in flavor, exuding a unique sauce aroma.

name: 蜜汁烤猪颈肉
description: 蜜汁烤猪颈肉是一道以猪颈肉为主料，通过烤制的方式烹饪而成的美味佳肴。这道菜的特色在于其外皮焦脆，内里肉质鲜嫩多汁，搭配上甜而不腻的蜜汁，使得整道菜品风味独特，回味无穷。
description_en: Honey Glazed Pork Neck is a delectable dish made from pork neck meat that is grilled to perfection. The dish is characterized by its crispy skin and tender, juicy meat, complemented by a sweet yet not overly rich honey sauce, making it a truly unique culinary experience.

name: 烤土司片
description: 烤土司片是一道简单的小吃，通常由面包切片后在烤面包机或烤箱中烘烤至外脆内软，常作为早餐或是茶点食用。
description_en: Toasted bread slices are a simple snack made by toasting bread slices until they are crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, often consumed as breakfast or with tea.

name: 烤花卷串
description: 烤花卷串是一种将花卷串在竹签上并进行烤制的小吃，通常在街头小吃摊或烧烤店中常见。
description_en: Grilled Flower Roll Skewers are a type of snack where flower rolls are threaded onto bamboo sticks and grilled, commonly found at street food stalls or barbecue restaurants.

name: 鱼豆腐
description: 鱼豆腐是一道以鱼肉和豆腐为主要原料的江苏菜，口感细腻，营养丰富。鱼肉经过加工制成豆腐状，与豆腐一起烹饪，成菜后既有鱼肉的鲜美，又有豆腐的滑嫩。
description_en: Fish Tofu is a dish from Jiangsu Province, mainly made from fish and tofu. It has a delicate texture and is rich in nutrients. The fish is processed into tofu-like shapes and cooked with tofu, resulting in a dish that combines the freshness of fish with the smoothness of tofu.

name: 烤四季豆
description: 烤四季豆是一道简单却美味的蔬菜料理，通常将新鲜四季豆洗净后，用橄榄油、盐和胡椒等简单调料腌制，然后放在烤架上烤制至外皮微焦，内里保持脆嫩。
description_en: Grilled Green Beans is a simple yet delicious vegetable dish. Fresh green beans are washed, marinated with olive oil, salt, and pepper, then grilled on a barbecue rack until the skin is slightly charred and the inside remains crispy and tender.

name: 麻辣烤鸡脆骨
description: 麻辣烤鸡脆骨是一道以鸡肉脆骨为主料，通过烤制的方式烹饪而成的特色小吃。这道菜品以其独特的麻辣口感和脆骨的爽脆感而受到食客的喜爱。
description_en: Spicy Grilled Chicken Cartilage is a special snack dish made from chicken cartilage as the main ingredient, cooked by grilling. This dish is loved by diners for its distinct spicy taste and the crunchy texture of the cartilage.

name: 香辣烤虾仁
description: 香辣烤虾仁是一道将虾仁与辣椒等香辣调料混合后烤制的菜肴，香辣可口，肉质鲜嫩。
description_en: Spicy Grilled Shrimp is a dish that combines shrimp with spicy seasonings like chili and roasts them until the flavors meld, resulting in a spicy and tender dish.

name: 烤鲫鱼
description: 烤鲫鱼是一道以鲫鱼为主要食材的菜肴，经过腌制后用炭火或烤箱烤制而成，外皮酥脆、鱼肉鲜嫩。这道菜品通常伴随着调味料，比如孜然、辣椒粉等，使其味道更加丰富。
description_en: Grilled Crucian Carp is a dish that primarily uses crucian carp as the main ingredient. After marinating, it is grilled over charcoal or in an oven until the skin is crispy and the fish is tender. This dish is often accompanied by seasonings such as cumin and chili powder, enriching its flavor.

name: 烤猪脑花
description: 烤猪脑花是一道以猪脑为主料的菜肴，通过炭火烤制，使得猪脑外皮微焦而内里细腻，风味独特，口感丰富。
description_en: Grilled Pig Brain Flowers is a unique dish made from pig brains, grilled to perfection over charcoal to achieve a slightly charred exterior while keeping the inside tender and flavorful.

name: 黑椒烤牛舌
name_en: Grilled Beef Tongue with Black Pepper
description: 黑椒烤牛舌是一道以牛舌为主材，搭配黑椒等调料烤制而成的美食。牛舌经过腌制后，与黑椒的香味结合，肉质鲜嫩多汁，味道浓郁，是西餐中常见的一道美味。
description_en: Grilled Beef Tongue with Black Pepper is a dish primarily made of beef tongue and seasoned with black pepper. After marinating, the beef tongue is grilled to perfection, resulting in a tender and juicy texture with a rich, aromatic flavor, commonly found in Western cuisine.

name: 烤鸡皮
description: 烤鸡皮是一道以鸡皮为主要食材的街头小吃，通常将鸡皮腌制后串起来，放在炭火上烤制，使其外皮变得脆香，内里略带油脂和弹性，吃起来既香又可口。
description_en: Grilled Chicken Skin is a popular street snack made from chicken skin. The skin is marinated and then skewered to be grilled over charcoal. The outer skin becomes crispy while the inside retains its油脂 and elasticity, resulting in a fragrant and delicious snack.

name: 烤牛筋丸
description: 烤牛筋丸是一道以牛肉为主要原料，通过烤制烹饪而成的地方特色美食。牛肉经过特殊工艺加工后，肉质鲜嫩，富有弹性，烤制后外焦里嫩，香气四溢，是烧烤中的上佳选择。
description_en: Grilled Beef Meatballs is a regional specialty dish made primarily with beef as the main ingredient, cooked through grilling. The beef, processed through a special technique, has a tender texture and elasticity. After grilling, it becomes crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, with a fragrant aroma, making it an excellent choice for barbecues.

name: 烤鸭肠
description: 烤鸭肠是一种以鸭肠为主料的烹饪方式，通过腌制和烤制而成。鸭肠口感脆嫩，外皮微焦，内部多汁，常搭配特制的调料食用，增加了菜品的风味。
description_en: Roasted Duck Intestines is a dish made from duck intestines, which are marinated and then roasted. The intestines have a crispy texture and are juicy inside, often served with special seasonings to enhance the flavor of the dish.

name: 烤鸭舌
description: 烤鸭舌是一道以鸭舌为主要食材制作的美味佳肴。鸭舌经过腌制后，用炭火或烤箱烤制，外皮烤至金黄色，肉质鲜嫩多汁，口感细腻，味道鲜美。
description_en: Roasted Duck Tongue is a delicious dish made from duck tongues. After marinating, the duck tongues are roasted over charcoal or in an oven until the skin turns golden brown. The meat is tender and juicy, with a delicate texture and rich flavor.

name: 烤韭黄
description: 烤韭黄是一道以韭黄为主要食材的烹饪菜肴，通过将韭黄串在竹签上并放在炭火上烤制，搭配特制的调料，使其味道独特，口感鲜香，是一道深受喜爱的烧烤小吃。
description_en: Grilled Chive Flowers is a popular dish featuring the main ingredient of chive flowers, which are threaded on bamboo skewers and grilled over charcoal. Served with special seasonings, this dish offers a unique taste and fragrant flavor, making it a beloved barbecue snack.

name: 烤黄瓜
description: 烤黄瓜是一道以黄瓜为主料的创意菜肴，将黄瓜切片后放入烤箱烤制，搭配适量的佐料，使得黄瓜的口感更加独特，带有一股淡淡的炭烤香味。
description_en: Grilled Cucumber is a creative dish that uses cucumber as the main ingredient. After slicing the cucumber, it is baked in the oven and served with appropriate seasonings, giving the cucumber a unique texture and a subtle smoky aroma.

name: 烤木耳串
description: 烤木耳串是一道以木耳为主要食材的素食烧烤菜式，通常将木耳切成适当大小的片状，串在竹签或铁签上，撒上各种香料后烤制而成。口感爽脆，营养健康。
description_en: Grilled Wood Ear Mushroom Skewers is a vegetarian barbecue dish primarily made with wood ear mushrooms. Sliced mushrooms are threaded onto skewers and grilled with various spices, resulting in a crispy and nutritious dish.

name: 烤杏鲍菇
description: 烤杏鲍菇是一道以杏鲍菇为主要食材的素食菜肴。杏鲍菇经过烘烤，吸收了香料的味道，口感鲜嫩多汁，带有独特的香气。
description_en: Grilled Pleurotus eryngii is a vegetarian dish primarily made with Pleurotus eryngii mushrooms. After grilling, the mushrooms absorb the flavors of the spices, resulting in a tender and juicy texture with a unique aroma.

name: 烤海带
description: 烤海带是一道以海带为主要食材的海鲜小吃。海带经过简单的腌制后，放在火上烤制，使得海带表面微焦而内部依旧保持柔软。这道小吃口感独特，富含碘质，具有一定的营养价值。
description_en: Grilled Kelp is a seafood snack primarily made from kelp. After simple marinating, the kelp is grilled over fire, resulting in a slightly charred exterior while retaining a tender interior. This snack has a unique taste and is rich in iodine, offering certain nutritional benefits.

name: 烤香肠
description: 烤香肠是一道以猪肉或牛肉制成的香肠为主料，通过烤制的方式烹饪而成的美食。外皮酥脆，内里多汁，风味独特，是很多人喜爱的小吃。
description_en: Grilled sausage is a delicacy made from pork or beef sausages, cooked by grilling. It has a crispy skin and juicy inside, with a unique flavor, making it a beloved snack for many.

name: 烤鱿鱼
description: 烤鱿鱼是一道以新鲜鱿鱼为主料，经过腌制后用炭火烤制而成的海鲜小吃。其特点是肉质鲜嫩，口感劲道，味道鲜美，并带有独特的炭烤香气。
description_en: Grilled Squid is a seafood dish made from fresh squid marinated and then grilled over charcoal. It features tender and chewy texture, rich flavor, and a unique aroma of charcoal grilled.

name: 烤粉丝扇贝
description: 烤粉丝扇贝是一道以新鲜扇贝和粉丝为主要食材的海鲜菜肴。通常先将扇贝清洗干净，然后将泡软的粉丝放在扇贝上，加入蒜末、调味料等烤制至熟。这道菜色泽金黄，口感鲜美，是海鲜爱好者的佳肴。
description_en: Grilled Scallops with Vermicelli is a seafood dish featuring fresh scallops and vermicelli as the main ingredients. The scallops are first cleaned, then topped with soaked vermicelli and seasoned with garlic, condiments, and grilled until cooked. The dish has a golden color and a delicious taste, making it a favorite among seafood lovers.

name: 烤年糕串
description: 烤年糕串是将年糕切条状，串在竹签上，然后放在炭火上烤制，烤至外皮微焦金黄，内部软糯，再刷上一层甜面酱或辣椒酱，口感独特，风味十足。
description_en: Grilled Rice Cake Skewers are made by slicing rice cakes into strips, threading them on bamboo skewers, and grilling them over charcoal until they are slightly charred and golden on the outside, with a soft and chewy interior. They are then brushed with a layer of sweet bean sauce or chili sauce, creating a unique texture and flavor.

name: 十三香
description: 十三香是一种以数十种香料调配而成的调味品，多用于增加食物的香气和风味，尤其在烹饪肉类和海鲜时能够去腥增香。
description_en: Thirteen-spice is a condiment made from a mixture of dozens of spices, often used to enhance the aroma and flavor of food, especially effective in removing the gamey taste from meat and seafood.

name: 小米辣
description: 小米辣是一种用小米椒制作的调味品，在川菜中尤为常见。小米椒以其鲜辣味闻名，是制作辣椒油、蘸料或直接作为菜肴配料的重要食材。
description_en: Mi La Jiao, also known as small hot chili pepper, is a seasoning made from small chili peppers, particularly common in Sichuan cuisine. Known for its fresh and spicy flavor, it is an essential ingredient for making chili oil, dips, or as a direct ingredient in dishes.

name: 花椒粉
description: 花椒粉是一种常见的中式调味料，主要由花椒加工而成，具有麻而香的独特风味。在川菜中尤为常见，常被用于增加菜肴的香气和麻味。
description_en: Sichuan pepper powder is a common Chinese spice made from ground Sichuan peppercorns, known for its numbing and aromatic flavor. It is particularly popular in Sichuan cuisine and is often used to add fragrance and a tingling sensation to dishes.

name: 老抽
description: 老抽是一种颜色较深、味道微甜的酱油，常用作中式烹饪中的调味品，特别是在红烧、卤制等菜肴中，用于增加菜品的色泽和风味。
description_en: Dark soy sauce is a type of soy sauce with a darker color and a slightly sweet taste. It is often used as a condiment in Chinese cooking, especially in braised and stewed dishes, to enhance the color and flavor of the food.

name: 生抽
description: 生抽是一种常用于中式烹饪中的酱油，色泽较淡、味道鲜美，不同于老抽，它主要用于增加菜肴的咸鲜味，而不会让菜肴颜色变深。
description_en: A type of soy sauce commonly used in Chinese cooking, light in color and rich in flavor, different from dark soy sauce, it is mainly used to enhance the savory taste of dishes without darkening the color.

name: 豆瓣酱
description: 豆瓣酱是一种以蚕豆和辣椒为主要原料制成的调味品，在川菜中具有重要的地位。它味道醇厚、辣中带鲜，常用于炒菜、炖肉或作为蘸酱使用。
description_en: Doubanjiang is a condiment made mainly from broad beans and chili peppers, playing a significant role in Sichuan cuisine. It has a rich flavor that is spicy yet fresh, and is commonly used in stir-frying, stewing meat, or as a dipping sauce.

name: 豆豉
description: 豆豉是一种传统的中国发酵豆制品，由煮熟的大豆发酵制成，口感鲜美，常用于调味料和烹饪。
description_en: Fermented Soybean Paste is a traditional Chinese fermented bean product made from cooked soybeans and possesses a savory flavor that is often used as a seasoning and in cooking.

name: 甜面酱
description: 甜面酱是一种传统的中式调味品，以面粉为主要原料，加入黄豆、小麦粉等发酵而成，色泽红亮，味道甜中带咸，常用于烹饪肉类或作为蘸料。
description_en: Sweet bean sauce is a traditional Chinese condiment made from fermented flour, soybeans, and wheat flour, known for its bright red color and a taste that is sweet with a savory hint. It is commonly used in cooking meats or as a dipping sauce.

name: 豆腐乳
description: 豆腐乳是一种传统的中国发酵食品，由豆腐经过发酵制成，口感独特，味道鲜美。它可以直接食用，也可以作为调料使用。
description_en: Fermented Tofu is a traditional Chinese fermented food made from tofu that has been fermented, giving it a unique taste and flavor. It can be consumed directly or used as a condiment.

name: 腐乳汁
description: 腐乳汁是一道以豆腐乳为主料的特色小吃，豆腐乳经发酵后，加入特制的调料制成汁液，味道独特，咸香可口。
description_en: Fermented Tofu Milk is a distinctive snack made from fermented tofu, which after fermentation is mixed with special seasonings to create a liquid with a unique flavor, savory and delicious.

name: 香油
description: 香油是一种以芝麻为原料制成的调味品，色泽金黄，香味浓郁，常用于凉拌菜、热炒菜、火锅蘸料等，增加食物的香气和风味。
description_en: Sesame oil, made from sesame seeds, is a flavor enhancer with a golden color and rich aroma. It is commonly used in cold dishes, stir-fried dishes, hot pot dips, and more to add fragrance and flavor to food.

name: 麻椒油
description: 麻椒油是一种使用四川花椒制成的调味品，常用于增加菜肴的麻辣风味。
description_en: Sichuan Peppercorn Oil is a condiment made from Sichuan peppercorns, often used to add a spicy and numbing flavor to dishes.

name: 陈醋
description: 陈醋是一种传统的中国调味品，以高粱、麦麸等为原料，经过发酵和陈酿制成。它色泽深褐，味道醇厚，酸中带甜，是中华料理中不可或缺的调味品之一。
description_en: Aged vinegar, also known as Chen vinegar, is a traditional Chinese condiment made from sorghum and wheat bran through fermentation and aging. It has a deep brown color, a rich flavor, and a sweet-sour taste, making it an indispensable seasoning in Chinese cuisine.

name: 镇江香醋
description: 镇江香醋是中国江苏省镇江市出产的一种著名醋类，具有色泽红棕、酸而不涩、香而微甜的独特风味，常用于凉拌菜、蘸料或烹饪中以增加食物的风味。
description_en: Zhenjiang Vinegar is a famous type of vinegar from Zhenjiang City in Jiangsu Province, China. It is known for its red-brown color, mellow sourness without astringency, and a subtle sweetness, which is often used in cold dishes, dipping sauces, or in cooking to enhance the flavor of food.

name: 红油
description: 红油是一种常见的川菜调料，由辣椒面、植物油、花椒、葱蒜等原料制成，色泽红亮，味道香辣浓郁。
description_en: Red Oil is a common seasoning in Sichuan cuisine, made from chili powder, vegetable oil, Sichuan peppercorns, green onions, garlic, and other ingredients. It has a bright red color and a strong and spicy flavor.

name: 沙茶酱
description: 沙茶酱是一种源自中国南方的调味品，主要由花生、大蒜、辣椒、香辛料等多种食材制成，具有独特的香辣味道。
description_en: Satay Sauce is a condiment originating from Southern China, mainly made from a variety of ingredients such as peanuts, garlic, chili, and spices, with a unique spicy flavor.

name: 蚝油
description: 蚝油是一种以牡蛎为原料，经过熬煮、浓缩而成的调味品，色泽深褐，味道鲜美，带有浓郁的牡蛎风味。
description_en: Oyster sauce is a condiment made from oysters, which is boiled and concentrated, with a dark brown color and a rich, savory taste with a strong oyster flavor.

name: 五香粉
description: 五香粉是一种常用的中式调味品，由五种或更多香料混合而成，包括八角、桂皮、丁香、花椒和小茴香等。它常用于烹饪肉类、海鲜和蔬菜，赋予食物独特的香气和风味。
description_en: Five Spice Powder is a common Chinese spice made from a mixture of five or more spices, including star anise, cinnamon, cloves, Sichuan peppercorns, and fennel seeds, among others. It is often used in cooking meats, seafood, and vegetables to impart a unique aroma and flavor.

name: 味精
description: 味精，学名谷氨酸钠，是一种常用的食品添加剂，用于增强食物的鲜味。它在中餐中广泛应用，尤其在烹饪汤品和炒菜时，可提升菜肴的口感。
description_en: Monosodium Glutamate, commonly known as MSG, is a widely used food additive that enhances the savory flavor of food. It is extensively used in Chinese cuisine, especially for soups and stir-fries, to improve the taste of dishes.

name: 剁椒
description: 剁椒是一道以鲜辣椒为主要原料制作的调味品，常作为菜肴的佐料或直接食用。它色泽鲜红，味道鲜辣，能够增加菜肴的香气和风味。
description_en: Chopped Chili is a condiment primarily made from fresh chili peppers, often used as a seasoning in dishes or consumed directly. It features a bright red color and a fresh, spicy taste, adding aroma and flavor to dishes.
